title: Senior Project Manager - MEP background
description:
At MiCiM, we deliver end-to-end project management and construction solutions for the Data Centre and Mission Critical sectors, driving excellence through collaboration, innovation, and technical expertise.


We’re expanding our operations in multiple locations across Europe and we're looking for experienced Project Managers to play a critical role in delivering a high-performance Data Centre facilities . You’ll work closely with our senior project leadership, clients, and contractors to ensure the successful coordination and execution of complex project activities.


The Role:


  • You will provide overarching leadership throughout all project phases, from inception to handover, ensuring alignment with client goals and project objectives
  • Own and drive the project timeline, utilising advanced project management techniques to ensure timely and on-budget delivery
  • Develop and implement comprehensive project execution plans (PEPs), encompassing all aspects of project delivery
  • Manage the project team and lead performance evaluations of all project participants
  • Mentor and develop junior team members to foster a culture of excellence
  • Identify stakeholders; establish their needs and expectations; and plan and implement strategies to meet their needs
  • Take charge of the financial health of the project by managing budgets, payment applications, and providing strategic recommendations to the Client in terms of value for money
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, representing their interests with the Professional Team and Contractors


About you:


  • You will have already managed medium to large-scale construction projects from conception through to completion
  • Strong leadership skills with experience in guiding and mentoring junior project managers and teams
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Strong contract knowledge & financial acumen
  • Degrees Project Management, Construction Management or Engineering subjects are preferable, but we’d also like to hear from you if you are qualified by experience.
  • You may already have experience in the Data Centre/Mission Critical sector, but we are also keen to speak to Project Managers in other sectors such as Energy, Oil & Gas, Offshore and Maritime.


Why work for MiCiM?


  • Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive salary package with performance-based bonuses.
  • Enhanced Paid Time Off
  • Knowledge Sharing and Engagement: Share your expertise and engage with educational institutions and further education bodies to inspire the next generation.
  • Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge projects with a company that values creativity and innovation.
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability: Our clients are industry leaders which means the projects we work on are often at the forefront of engineering excellence with respect to Energy Efficiency and Sustainability.
  • Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your well-being with a supportive, family-focused culture that includes enhanced benefits for mental health, neurodiversity, maternity, paternity, and menopause.
  • Women in Construction: MiCiM is a proud co-founding member of FWD -Forum for Women in Data Centres, as well as provide enhanced pregnancy, maternity, return to work and menopause benefits for our employees.
  • Volunteering Leave: We encourage giving back to the community with a paid day of leave per year for a volunteering activity of your choice.
  • Comprehensive Training Programmes: Support your career progression with structured training programmes, including opportunities for chartership and professional memberships.
  • Multiple Network and Committee opportunities with MiCiM to get involved with should you wish.
  • Regular Leadership Engagement: Participate in regular communication opportunities with company leaders to stay informed and involved.

title: Systems, Integration and Software Engineer Intern
location: Atlantic City, New Jersey, United States
description:
Description

The Transportation Solution Division within the Leidos Homeland group is seeking Systems, Integration and Software Engineer Interns who will be a member of a dynamic team working on one of several Air Traffic Management programs including:


En-Route Automation Modernization (ERAM), the heart of the Next Generation Air Transportation System and the pulse of the National Airspace System, providing the foundation for NexGen functions


Time-Based Flow Management (TBFM), is a system used in air traffic control to manage the flow of aircraft into congested airspace by assigning a specific time for each aircraft to reach a certain point. It shifts the focus from managing separation distance to managing arrival times, allowing controllers to optimize the flow of traffic, reduce delays, and decrease fuel consumption.



Primary Responsibilities:

Tasks will include assistance with system architecture, system concept development, requirements engineering, operational and decision analysis, systems definition, system risk management, and requirements baseline management. The candidate will also support regression testing the development of design and coding of the program software, including Object Oriented Programming Concepts, XML, JavaScript, C, C++, Java, Redhat, and Python.

- Candidates must be enrolled in a degree program in a relevant discipline, for example, engineering, computer science.

- Exposure to system engineering, software engineering, artificial intelligence, or machine learning.

- Candidates must have the ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance

title: HR Transformation & Enablement Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure's HR Operations function is undergoing a major transformation—rebuilding workflows from first principles, centralizing into a Global Shared Services model, and deploying conversational AI and agentic automation to eliminate routine friction. As the HR Transformation & Enablement Manager, you will turn ambiguous operational challenges into scalable, human-centered solutions that modernize how our teams work. Operating at a senior individual contributor level, you will bridge the gap between rapid technological prototyping and organizational adoption. You will partner closely with HR Operations leads, technical teams, and global stakeholders to ensure every new tool and process delivers lasting, measurable productivity across Everpure.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Architect and prototype practical workflow solutions using AI, low-code/no-code platforms, and automation tools to eliminate manual friction for employees and HR teams.

  • Lead end-to-end enablement strategy across HR Operations initiatives, aligning training, communications, and operational readiness so global teams confidently adopt new ways of working.

  • Establish scalable enablement playbooks, standards, and feedback loops in partnership with HR leadership to drive consistent execution across our Global Shared Services model.

  • Analyze adoption, usage, and proficiency metrics across enterprise platforms—including ServiceNow, Workday, and Moveworks—to uncover friction points and continuously refine the employee experience.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Proven capability leading cross-functional business operations, organizational transformation, or technology enablement programs in fast-paced, evolving environments.

  • Hands-on proficiency building prototypes and workflow automations using AI tools, AI-assisted development, or low-code/no-code platforms.

  • Demonstrated success designing and delivering comprehensive change management, training, and readiness programs backed by clear adoption and productivity metrics.

  • Working knowledge of enterprise HR and project ecosystems such as ServiceNow, Workday, Moveworks, and Asana.

  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

#LI-ONSITE

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

$153,000—$230,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

title: EOI- Registered Early Childhood Educator
description:
Job Description


Title: Registered Early Childhood Educator

Reports to: Manager, Family and Community Health

Position Type: Contract, Part-Time 28 hours/week

Salary: $22.00 - $25.88

Vacancy Status: Existing Vacancy

Location: Kingston


Position Summary


The Registered Early Childhood Educator, EarlyON Programs is responsible for the delivery of high-quality EarlyON programing which is welcoming, inclusive, integrated, and community led. All EarlyON programming is to be delivered within the context of the Provincial Pedagogical Framework, including How Does Learning Happen? Ontario’s Pedagogy for the Early Years, and in accordance with the College of Early Childhood Educators Code of Ethics and Standards of Practice. Striving for the goal of best outcomes for children, their families, and Caregivers, EarlyON services must be delivered within the context of the Mandatory Core Services: Engaging Parents and Caregivers, Supporting Early Learning and Development, and Making Connections for Families.


Key Responsibilities


Education, Information, Programming, Client Support & Site Support

  • Design, promote, deliver, and evaluate high-quality programs for children and families, guided by How Does Learning Happen? Ontario’s Pedagogy for the Early Years and the provincial pedagogical framework
  • Provide full delivery of programs, including, but not limited to, the preparation and provision of healthy snacks, maintain a clean and safe program environment, performing administrative duties such as maintaining program records
  • Offer individual support to parents and children through supportive listening, crisis support, resources, identification of health challenges, and referrals to specialists or other available services
  • Work with colleagues and other community networks to identify community and systemic issues associated with quality-of-life as identified by community residents, and to design and implement relevant community development strategies


Organizational Responsibilities

  • Comply with all relevant legislation and KCHC policies, including privacy laws
  • Commits to acquiring an understanding of the importance of trauma responsiveness and the impact of Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs)
  • Commits to demonstrating an ongoing commitment to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, Indigenization and Accessibility (EDIIA) by representing the diverse nature of our communities, promoting and practicing inclusion
  • Supports consistent application and development of KCHC policies and procedures
  • Supports KCHC’s student and volunteer placement programs
  • Promotes awareness of and participation in KCHC activities
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and quality improvement
  • On occasion, perform other temporary duties as required


Basic Education and Experience Requirements

  • College diploma in either Early Childhood Education or Native Early Childhood Education with one year relevant experience
  • Current member in good standing of the College of Early Childhood Educators


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of parenting issues and experience working with families in a community setting
  • Strong understanding of the strengths and challenges of Kingston families, including parenting in communities facing barriers to health
  • Strong knowledge of Indigenous culture; including cultural competency and governance
  • Bilingual English/French or proficiency in Arabic and other languages (strong asset)
  • Skills with time management, organization, conflict resolution and multi-tasking
  • Superior interpersonal skills, and a commitment to being a team player
  • Proficiency in the use of computers and relevant software applications
  • Awareness of, an ability to support, provincial and federal privacy regulations
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and quality improvement


Other Requirements

  • Access to a vehicle as this position has multiple locations of work throughout Kingston
  • Valid Driver’s Licence, Driver’s Abstract and proof of vehicle liability insurance as this is a requirement under KCHC’s insurance provider (HIROC)
  • Ability to work outside normal business hours including regular weekend or evening work. Work during both regular and extended hours in locations identified by KCHC
  • Ability to attend work regularly and meet the physical demand of the position
  • Current Standard First Aid and CPR-C certification or willing to obtain
  • Up to date immunizations and TB test
  • Current and satisfactory Criminal and Vulnerable Persons Check


As a registered professional, to abide by and be accountable to the ethics and standards set out by the relevant regulatory body of the profession. All KCHC staff have a duty to understand and follow KCHC policies, uphold high ethical and professional standards, and maintain confidentiality and privacy, using tact and good judgment in all dealings with other staff and clients.

At Kingston Community Health Centres (KCHC), we understand that the work of Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, Indigeneity, and Accessibility (EDIIA) is ongoing. We are dedicated to being accountable, transparent, and responsive to the holistic needs of the communities we serve. We will continue to listen, learn, and take meaningful action to ensure that our policies, practices, and services create an environment where everyone, regardless of their identity or circumstances, can thrive.

We actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds, including but not limited to women, racialized groups, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, and those who identify as members of the 2SLGBTQI+ communities, to apply to KCHC. Our commitment to EDIIA is a living practice, one that evolves as we grow and learn together. We pledge to contribute to building a system that is equitable, diverse, inclusive, accessible, and welcoming for all.

KCHC is an equal opportunity employer, respecting and embracing the needs and diversity of our employees. If you require accommodation to fully participate in the hiring process, please notify Human Resources.

title: Project Manager - Power & Renewables
description:

title: Growth Advisor Lead
description:
About Sent

Sent is a developer tool for customer engagement. We help developers and agents deliver messages across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS through a single API. Our intelligent routing model automates channel selection, ensuring lower cost and global deliverability without channel-specific integrations. Our built-in multitenancy also enables our customers to deploy messaging and voice agents across their own customers.

We recently closed a $12M Series A backed by Companyon Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, UIF, and others. We're hiring the team to build reliable infrastructure that scales.

About the Role

We're hiring a Growth Advisor Lead to set the strategy for, and lead, the team that opens the door for Sent. Our Growth Advisors are the first conversation engineering teams, product teams, CTOs, and founders have with us. You'll decide who they talk to, how they approach those conversations, and how we measure whether the motion is working.

You’ll own the top of Sent’s funnel: which segments and accounts the team targets, how work is prioritized, what qualified means, and how opportunities move to our senior team. You’ll lead the Growth Advisors day to day, keeping the team aligned on priorities and accountable to results. Because Sent is a product developers can try for themselves, you’ll have real creative freedom and flexibility to figure out what gets the right people on the phone and how to engage developers where they already are. That might mean using product signals to time outreach, building in developer communities, running experiments on messaging and channels, or trying approaches nobody here has thought of yet. You’ll also work directly with Marketing, Product, and senior leadership to make sure what we learn in the market shapes how we go to market.

This role is a fit for someone with a strong outbound background who thinks in terms of systems, targeting, and conversion, and who wants to lead a team at a company where the product sells itself once people see it.

What You'll Do

Set Direction and Strategy

  • Define the team's target segments, ideal customer profile, and account prioritization

  • Run experiments across channels, messaging, and product-led touchpoints to find what drives developer engagement and gets qualified conversations booked

  • Decide where the team should focus based on pipeline data, market signals, and company goals

  • Design the outbound and inbound motion across email, LinkedIn, phone, events, and developer communities

  • Set the qualification criteria and handoff standards that determine what reaches our senior team

Lead the Team

  • Run the Growth Advisor team day to day, assigning accounts, territories, and priorities

  • Set weekly activity and conversion targets, and hold the team accountable to them

  • Run team meetings and 1:1s focused on pipeline, performance, and focus areas

  • Lead hiring for the team as we scale, and decide how to structure it as it grows

Own Pipeline Performance

  • Own pipeline generation and conversion for the team, from first touch to qualified handoff

  • Monitor funnel metrics, identify where conversion breaks down, and adjust the approach

  • Provide weekly reporting on pipeline, conversion, and team performance to leadership

  • Own CRM standards, including handover notes and pipeline data accuracy

Collaborate Across the Company

  • Partner with Marketing on campaigns, content, and inbound qualification

  • Bring market feedback, objections, and competitive intel to Product and leadership

  • Work with senior team members to make sure qualified opportunities move smoothly into technical evaluations and demos

Stay Close to the Market

  • Take part in first conversations with technical founders and engineering teams, especially on key accounts

  • Work a select set of strategic accounts yourself, so your decisions stay grounded in what's actually happening with buyers

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 3-5 years of experience in a customer-facing, outbound-heavy role (SDR/BDR, Growth, Sales Development, or similar), ideally at a startup

  • Experience selling a technical product or developer tool, and comfort holding credible conversations with developers and engineering leaders

  • Experience leading or directing others. Formal management experience is a plus but not required

  • A track record of hitting or exceeding pipeline targets

  • Analytical mindset, comfortable using funnel and conversion data to make decisions

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Genuine curiosity about developer tools, APIs, and how startups build products

  • Organized and disciplined about process, follow-through, and data hygiene

  • Comfortable with high-volume outreach, cold calling, and proactive relationship-building

  • Self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous startup environments

  • Located in NYC or willing to relocate

Nice to Have

  • Experience at an API-first, developer tools, or infrastructure company

  • Comfort reading API documentation and understanding basic integration concepts

  • Experience building outbound strategy, ICP definitions, or qualification frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and outreach tools

What Makes This Role Special

  • Ownership from day one: You'll shape how Sent engages the market and lead the team that executes it

  • Strategic seat: You'll work directly with senior leadership, Marketing, and Product on go-to-market decisions

  • Ground floor: Help define the motion at a company that just closed $12M and is scaling fast

  • Clear growth path: Grow into broader commercial leadership as the team and product expand

Our Commitment to You

  • Meaningful equity with high growth potential

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission

  • Top-tier medical, dental, vision fully covered

  • 401(k) with 100% match up to 4%

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Beautiful NYC workspace with daily meals and unlimited snacks

  • New MacBook Pro + Apple Studio Display

  • Wellhub Gold or Equinox stipend

Sent, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil or Argentina.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow.

The company builds software for commercial real estate. This isn't general cloud engineering, you will actually built agentic-platform infrastructure before, not just traditional cloud architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Model Design & Delivery
    • Design, train and ship production ML models for real estate and facilities decisions, such as forecasting for space, occupancy, headcount, rent and finances
    • Own each model end to end: problem framing, data and features, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and cost and latency budgets
    • Serve models as versioned, documented APIs that product features, agents and other systems call. Keep the serving layer portable across cloud platforms, for example by using containers
    • Contribute to embedding and retrieval work, and measure retrieval quality on real customer documents
    • Contribute to synthetic data pipelines, so teams can develop and test without production customer data. Measure how closely the synthetic data matches the real data, how well models trained on it perform, and whether it leaks private data
  • Evaluation, Quality & Trust
    • Own the evaluation of every model you ship: backtests, held-out datasets, metrics that fit the problem, and regression suites in CI that gate releases
    • Build them on the shared evaluation framework that the platform team provides
    • Find the root cause of quality failures, whether data drift, leakage, a feature defect, flawed ground truth, a retrieval miss or a model regression. Fix the layer that is at fault
    • Monitor production models for accuracy, drift, silent degradation and cost
    • Retrain or roll back based on evidence
    • Own model-level safety behavior: keep customer data within each tenant’s access rules, handle PII correctly, test for privacy leakage, and disclose uncertainty clearly
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with Product to turn accuracy thresholds and confidence disclosure into shipped behavior
    • Agree on API contracts, accuracy bars and failure behavior with the teams that build AI agents on your models. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment and with Data Platform on the curated datasets and features your models read
    • Feed model performance and usage data into the warehouse, so model quality is measurable next to product analytics
    • Support the domain teams that build on your models, contribute to the shared quality standard for models and agents, and mentor engineers on ML practice

Requirements:

  • You have taken at least one ML model from problem framing to production, and kept it accurate through retraining and drift. Typically 5+ years of professional engineering experience and a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Python and SQL, including the ML stack (scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent, pandas or equivalent) and the service stack (FastAPI, Pydantic or equivalent) Testing, code review, CI/CD and production ownership. You use AI coding assistants and verify their output
  • Hands-on experience with ML evaluation: time-aware validation and backtesting against simple baselines, holdout design, metric selection, interval coverage and calibration, error analysis, and using results to gate releases. This is central to the role
  • Production experience with forecasting models, with a working knowledge of statistics and probability. You can quantify uncertainty, for example with prediction intervals
  • Model serving and MLOps: reproducible deployment, monitoring and retraining, for example with experiment tracking, a model registry, containers,
    and batch or online inference
  • Judgment about failure modes such as data leakage, drift, distribution shift, bias, privacy leakage and silent degradation. You can tell acceptable failures from unacceptable ones, and explain model behavior and uncertainty to Product and to people who are not engineers

Desirable:

  • Embeddings and retrieval systems, including how to measure retrieval quality
  • Synthetic data generation, privacy attack evaluation (for example membership inference), and familiarity with differential privacy
  • Geospatial or location data modeling
  • Experience building models that LLM agents call as tools, with an agent framework such as LangGraph and LLM tracing tools
  • Batch pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions or equivalent) and self- hosted model inference
  • Experience in real estate, facilities, finance or another data-heavy enterprise domain

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Systems Engineer L4
description:
Overview

Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is seeking a highly qualified and motivated Systems Engineer L4 to lead and support a cohesive engineering team in the design, development, and implementation of advanced computer systems, software, and networks. This role is critical in managing the design, production, and testing of space systems while ensuring they operate securely and efficiently to meet project and customer requirements.

The ideal candidate will bring deep systems engineering expertise combined with program management experience to support planning, risk management, and program execution. This individual will demonstrate technical leadership, foster collaboration, and represent the company with professionalism through effective communication and stakeholder engagement.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead systems engineering efforts across the design, development, integration, and testing of space systems

SOSi is seeking an Effects Planner. The Effects Planner facilitates and coordinates all aspects of operational-level planning, synchronization, and integration. They provide planning support encompassing analytics, assessments, target development, and planning advocacy for subordinate commands. title: Zero Trust Engineer, Lead
description:
Zero Trust Engineer, Lead

The Opportunity:

The Department of War (DoW) relies on resilient, secure, and intelligently architected networks to execute its mission at speed and scale. As a senior Zero Trust Engineer lead, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for shaping, governing, and advancing enterprise‑wide security and network architecture. You will guide the transformation of complex, distributed environments toward mature Zero Trust capabilities that strengthen mission readiness and safeguard national security.

In this senior leadership role, you will lead cross-functional engineering and architect teams, define the architectural vision, establish technical standards, and steer multi‑year modernization initiatives across mission and enterprise systems. You will partner with executive stakeholders and program leadership to align network and cybersecurity investments with evolving operational requirements. Your expertise will influence enterprise policy, design authorities, and long‑term strategic planning across DoW organizations.

You will oversee the full lifecycle of secure network architecture—from conceptual design through implementation, sustainment, and continuous improvement—ensuring solutions are scalable, interoperable, and compliant with DoW directives. As a senior ZT engineer, you will drive the adoption of Zero Trust principles, lead integration efforts across cloud and on‑premises environments, and ensure alignment with DoW Zero Trust strategy and reference architectures.

This is an opportunity to lead at the highest levels of technical strategy, shaping how modern defense networks are secured and operated. You will help drive enterprise change, mentor technical teams, and advance mission resilience in an increasingly complex threat landscape. Additionally, you will apply expertise as a results-oriented technical leader to help shape new capabilities, applications, and services to the market and developing new business.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in network engineering and cybersecurity within DoW or federal environments, including leadership roles influencing enterprise architecture and strategic transformation
  • 2+ years of experience architecting, driving adoption of, and overseeing Zero Trust implementations at scale
  • Experience developing and governing Zero Trust enterprise architectures aligned with DoW Zero Trust strategy and target‑level frameworks
  • Experience leading teams in the documentation, communication, and approval of complex architectures supporting defense programs and mission‑critical operations
  • Experience in technical leadership spanning Identity and Access Management, micro‑segmentation, endpoint security, data-centric environments, virtualization, and secure network or cloud architecture
  • Experience operating within classified environments and advising senior stakeholders on secure design decisions
  • Knowledge of DoW security standards, RMF or ATO processes, and compliance frameworks
  • Ability to guide programs through accreditation activities
  • Top Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience steering modernization of DoW networks in mission or tactical environments, including PACOM or Pacific operational theaters
  • Experience guiding organizations through transitions from legacy perimeter-based designs to mature Zero Trust operating models
  • Experience with network and security technologies such as Palo Alto, Cisco, Juniper, Dell, HPE, VMware, Elastic, or F5
  • Experience architecting and governing security for commercial and DoD cloud environments
  • Experience applying STIGs, conducting enterprise system hardening, and defining associated governance
  • Experience with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and policy enforcement workflows
  • Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and policy-as-code approaches to enterprise security
  • CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP, or CCNA Certifications

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required.

title: People Safety & Resilience Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a People Safety & Resilience Manager at GitLab, you'll help protect team members working from home, in Labs, and in coworking spaces. You'll turn GitLab's safety and resilience strategies into practical programs that work across countries, both day to day and when a crisis disrupts how people work.

What you’ll do

  • Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001. Put the global policy into practice through hazard identification, risk and ergonomic assessments, incident reporting and investigation, performance measurement, internal audits, and management reviews.
  • Identify and meet each country's legal safety obligations with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, and local vendors. Track changes in the law and keep records of required appointments, assessments, committees, training, and medical surveillance. Manage vendor agreements and keep safety and resilience services within budget.
  • Coordinate required consultation with works councils and team members before GitLab makes a decision or contacts affected team members outside the consultation process. Prepare consultation materials, participate in health and safety committees where they exist, and retain the consent, hearing, and anonymized reporting records each jurisdiction requires.
  • Run the workplace violence prevention program. Coordinate the threat management team, train managers, and keep case records and legally required local plans up to date.
  • Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.
  • Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.
  • Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.
  • Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience delivering safety and resilience programs across several countries, covering occupational health and safety plus either crisis management or business continuity.
  • Knowledge of when to consult team members or works councils, hold hearings, or make decisions jointly, and how to document each step. To handle GitLab's legal obligations in Germany, you'll need direct experience applying the Betriebsverfassungsgesetz and Arbeitssicherheitsgesetz.
  • Ability to apply ISO 45001, ISO 22361, ISO 22301, the ANSI/ASIS workplace violence prevention standard, and the European Union framework directive on safety and health at work when drafting policies and procedures with legal and compliance partners and external advisers.
  • Experience managing programs across teams, including assigning owners and deadlines, tracking regulatory changes, and preparing records for audits.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to draft materials, score assessments, and update records, and checking their results against the standards. Ability to keep that work repeatable by tracking changes to prompts and workflows in GitLab.
  • Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time to support company events, run exercises, and attend health and safety committee meetings in person. These commitments can fall in the evenings or on weekends.
  • Availability outside standard working hours as part of a scheduled on-call duty rotation and when the crisis management plan is activated, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Experience managing consultations across Germany, the Netherlands, and France is strongly preferred because you'll work under each country's rules. Safety or business continuity credentials, ISO 45001 or ISO 22301 lead implementer or auditor qualifications, and works council or labor relations training are also helpful.

About the team

We work with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, the crisis management team, team member representatives, and external partners. You'll bring these partners together through plans with named owners and deadlines. Our People Safety & Security scorecard tracks how well we meet safety standards and legal duties and which consultations, exercises, and incident reviews we've completed. It also tracks whether we've reviewed continuity plans in the past twelve months and closed audit findings by their deadlines.

Job Summary

Employees of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia (Assembly) provide professional non-partisan services to support the democratic institution of Parliament and its members through procedural advice, administrative support and information services. The Assembly is an autonomous employer, separate from the administrative framework of B.C. government ministries and agencies.


The Information Technology Department is seeking a strategic, innovative and collaborative individual for the regular full-time position of Director, Information Technology.


The Information Technology department has significantly matured over the past five years. We have addressed technical debt, built cybersecurity resiliency, implemented Workday, and modernized infrastructure to provide the organization with a modern digital core. We are looking for the right senior leader to maintain momentum for the department. This leader will continue to optimize a substantially modernized technology environment that supports Members of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia in their respective roles in our parliamentary democracy, continue to build strong information and process governance, deliver service excellence to all client groups, and ensure trusted cross-departmental partnerships that enable the Legislative Assembly Administration’s Strategic Plan.


Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Director, Information Technology (Director) provides operational and strategic leadership for the Information Technology Department. Through the Director’s leadership, the ITD enables the Legislative Assembly Administration to deliver on its strategic pillars of supporting Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs), engaging people, modernizing the workplace and strengthening public engagement. As a member of the Extended Leadership Team, the Director advises the Chief Information Officer and senior leadership on technology risk, investment priorities and emerging digital opportunities.


The Director leads a management team focused on IT operations, business operations, cybersecurity, information management and artificial intelligence, and digital platforms to deliver service excellence and secure, reliable infrastructure at the Legislative Precinct and constituency offices across the Province. Working with business sponsors across the Administration, the Director maintains a Digital Strategy, applies business-driven governance and prioritization, oversees cybersecurity, and champions responsible information management, data and artificial intelligence practices, supporting the efficient and effective operation of the Legislative Assembly.


Qualifications

Applicants must be/have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or Business with 7+ years of progressive technology experience or equivalent. An equivalent combination of related education, training, and experience may be considered. Related experience should include some or all of the following:
    • All facets of information technology and information systems strategies and solutions to support and achieve operational and strategic outcomes.
    • Strategic planning, business transformation and implementing best practices.
    • Leading, coaching and developing cross-functional teams.
    • Developing and managing operating and capital budget through monitoring and projections.
    • Working in a complex, distributed IT environment including hybrid and cloud platforms.
    • Leading implementation of IT service management best practice frameworks.
    • Leading cybersecurity programs, including vulnerability management and incident response.


Preference may be given to candidates with the following:

  • Certifications in IT Service Management, Project Management and Enterprise Architecture.
  • Certifications in IT Governance, Risk Management and IT Security.
  • Experience with Workday or similar ERP systems.
  • Experience in a public sector or parliamentary environment.


Please refer to the job description for a full list of duties and qualifications.


Who We Are

Our values ground our work and reflect the beliefs and principles that are important to how we work with others.

  • Impartiality – We are non-partisan and objective in the performance of our duties.
  • Integrity – We build trust through responsible actions and respectful relationships.

Management employees are eligible for Time Off in Lieu, which is an additional 12 days off per year for time worked in excess of the regular hours required for their position.

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | Hands-on | Equity-Based
description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | Hands-on | Equity-Based

BioXion | Switzerland | Early-Stage Venture

Help build the next generation of biopharmaceutical development intelligence.

BioXion is an early-stage Swiss technology venture developing an integrated digital platform for biopharmaceutical companies and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations (CDMOs).

Our vision is to transform how pharmaceutical development programs are managed, how industry partners collaborate, and how quality, analytical, regulatory, and operational intelligence supports better decision-making.

The first functional version of BioXion has already been developed. We are now entering the next stage of development, expanding the platform into a scalable, API-first enterprise solution with advanced intelligence and collaboration capabilities.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, hands-on Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who is excited about building and scaling an innovative technology platform.

Your role:

You will work directly alongside the founder, combining technical leadership, hands-on software development, and entrepreneurial involvement.

Key responsibilities include:

- Develop BioXion's next-generation platform, contributing directly to software engineering and implementation.
- Lead technical architecture, backend and frontend development, API integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
- Build scalable, secure enterprise capabilities, including advanced partner collaboration, data intelligence, and AI-enabled workflows.
- Define and implement technical standards for security, scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
- Contribute to the product roadmap and future engineering strategy.
- Actively support fundraising activities, including investor outreach, technical presentations, pitch preparation, and due diligence.
- Help establish relationships with potential investors, strategic partners, and relevant technology networks.
- Build and lead the engineering team as the company grows.

What we're looking for

Essential qualifications

- Strong hands-on software engineering experience, ideally including full-stack development and enterprise software architecture.
- Demonstrated experience building and delivering complex B2B software products.
- Solid expertise in modern web technologies, cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, and software security.
- Experience integrating AI-enabled functionality into software platforms.
- Previous startup or early-stage venture experience.
- Practical fundraising experience, including involvement in investment rounds, direct investor engagement, and fundraising preparation.
- Strong entrepreneurial mindset, ownership mentality, and willingness to contribute directly to product development.

Particularly valuable

- Established relationships within the Swiss or European angel investor and venture capital ecosystem.
- Experience taking technology products from early-stage prototypes to commercial launch.
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CDMO, or other regulated industries.
- Experience with Azure, Python, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and enterprise integration architectures.
- Experience building and leading technical teams.

Equity, compensation and commitment

This is an early-stage, equity-based CTO opportunity, not an immediately salaried position.

We are looking for a committed technology leader who believes in BioXion's potential and is prepared to contribute time, expertise, and technical leadership in exchange for an equity stake, with terms to be mutually agreed.

- Initial stage: Equity-based participation, without salary.
- Fundraising: Active involvement in securing investment and supporting the company's development and growth.
- Future compensation: A salaried arrangement is envisaged once BioXion begins generating commercial sales revenue, subject to the company's financial position and mutual agreement.

The objective is to establish a long-term CTO role with meaningful technical responsibility and a direct stake in the company's success.

Why join BioXion?

- Build on an existing functional platform rather than starting from a blank page.
- Play a central role in shaping the architecture, technology, and future of the business.
- Work directly with a founder bringing extensive pharmaceutical industry and quality-management experience.
- Help address real challenges in biopharmaceutical development and CDMO collaboration.
- Participate in the development and growth of an internationally scalable enterprise technology business.

Interested?

We welcome applications from experienced software engineers, technology leaders, and entrepreneurs who combine practical development expertise with startup experience.

Please share your LinkedIn profile, examples of platforms you have personally built, and a brief description of your fundraising and investor engagement experience.

We are looking for a CTO who can build, lead, and help turn BioXion's vision into a commercially successful technology platform.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Cloud Security Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how to secure it. As a cloud security architect, you know how to assess and implement requirements that ensure the safety of information systems and protect them against intentional or inadvertent access or destruction. What if you could use your advanced cloud security skills to improve the security of cloud-based applications, powering critical communications and situational awareness for thousands of agencies across the country? We need you to guide the development of cloud-based security architectures for some of public safety's most critical systems.


As a cloud security architect on our team, you’ll define, communicate, and implement security architecture to support mission-critical operations for Sit(x), a Booz Allen product. You’ll recommend tools and capabilities based on your research of the current environment and knowledge of various on-premise, cloud-based, and hybrid resources to address the risk management framework (RMF). Your technical expertise will be vital as you work with developers to ensure standards are met with information assurance and security requirements.


This is an opportunity to use the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to secure your customer’s environment. You’ll continue to strengthen your skills in cloud-based security in AWS while mentoring tomorrow’s cloud security experts.


Help us transform and secure tactical communications networks with cloud technology.

Join us. The world can’t wait.


You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience building and administering cloud environments and utilizing cloud-native functionality, COTs, GOTs, and open-source tools to meet objectives
  • Experience with security architecture evaluations, guidance development, and troubleshooting
  • Experience with the Risk Management Framework (RMF)
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure, IAM, VPC networking, security controls, and troubleshooting
  • Experience implementing STIGs, Linux security hardening, and building and maintaining custom STIG-hardened AMIs
  • Experience with Splunk or AWS-native OpenSearch-based security analytics, centralized logging, threat detection, and integration with AWS security services such as Security Hub, GuardDuty, and CloudTrail
  • Experience with POA&Ms, vulnerability management and remediation, security documentation, continuous monitoring, and improving overall security posture
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM field

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with the software development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with cloud technologies
  • Knowledge of multicloud governance and automation in Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Product, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud, or other cloud providers
  • Possession of excellent interpersonal skills
  • Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • DoD 8570 IAT Level III Certification such as SecurityX, CCNP Security, CISA, CISSP, GCED, GCIH, or CCSP Certification
  • DoD 8570 Cybersecurity Service Provider-Infrastructure Support Certification (CSSP-IS), including CEH, CySA+, GICSP, SSCP, CHFI, CFR, Cloud+, or CND Certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.


Work Model
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

description:
Company Overview

We are a world-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50+ locations world-wide. Much of our work contributes to innovative research in the fields of sensor science, signal processing, data fusion, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and augmented reality (AR).

QinetiQ US’s dedicated experts in defense, aerospace, security, and related fields all work together to explore new ways of protecting the American Warfighter, Security Forces, and Allies. Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. Partnering with our customers, we help save lives; reduce risks to society; and maintain the global infrastructure on which we all depend.

Why Join QinetiQ US?

If you have the courage to take on a wide variety of complex challenges, then you will experience a unique working environment where innovative teams blend different perspectives, disciplines, and technologies to discover new ways of solving complex problems. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. QinetiQ US will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Position Overview

Qinetiq US is looking for a Project Task Manager. This is an opportunity to lead and influence IT modernization at the Federal Highway Administration's (FHWA) Office of Information Technology Services (OITS). As a Project Task Manager, you will plan, coordinate, and report on IT projects across FHWA's application development, operations and maintenance (O&M), and development, modernization, and enhancement (DME) portfolio.

You will support FHWA's IT governance structures, seeking to strengthen program management practices through standardized processes, SOPs, and executive reporting. Agile experience is highly valued.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and monitor assigned IT projects across the software development life cycle (SDLC), including O&M and DME efforts. Manage scope, schedule, cost, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules, risk and issue logs, action item trackers, and decision logs.
  • Prepare executive-ready status reports, quad charts, dashboards, and briefings for FHWA IT leadership.
  • Support development of Program/Project Management Plans covering scope, schedule, financial, quality, resource, communications, risk, and change management.
  • Develop, update, and maintain SOPs, SDLC documentation, templates, and other governance artifacts. Coordinate stakeholder review and signature routing.
  • Plan and facilitate status meetings, working sessions, governance reviews, and Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily scrums). Capture minutes, decisions, and action items and drive them to closure.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), cutover, knowledge transfer, and transition activities for system migrations and platform changes.
  • Maintain project inventories and support project intake, prioritization, and portfolio-level reporting.
  • Prepare materials and analysis for the Technology Review Board, Investment Review Board, and Architecture Review Board.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and support implementation of program and project management tools for resource, cost, risk, and work tracking.
  • Monitor performance, analyze trends and issues, and advise on corrective actions to keep cost, schedule, and scope within allotted funding. Conduct performance assessments and lessons-learned sessions.
  • Coordinate with FHWA staff, DOT OCIO, and other contractors responsible for interfacing applications and infrastructure.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT project or program management
  • Experience managing IT projects across the SDLC
  • Experience developing and maintaining project schedules, risk/issue registers, and status reports for senior leadership
  • Experience using at least one project management or work-tracking tool (e.g., Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, JIRA, Smartsheet, Planview)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOT Public Trust
  • This is a hybrid position with potential regular on-site presence at U.S. DOT Headquarters in Washington, DC.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe certification
  • Experience supporting the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) or FHWA
  • Experience using Azure DevOps and/or JIRA to support Agile delivery
  • Experience supporting an enterprise collaboration platform migration (e.g., Google Workspace or Microsoft 365)
  • Experience supporting robotic process automation (RPA), data analytics, or AI initiatives
  • Knowledge of the Federal Information Technology Acquisition Reform Act (FITARA), the Clinger-Cohen Act, and OMB Circular A-130
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including briefing senior leaders

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this role is $105,000 - $120,000USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. This position supports leadership by managing schedules, travel, and communications; and facilitates program-related logistics, data & compliance tracking, and contract support. Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities

Program Coordination & Quality

External Relations & Representation

  • Oversee referral, eligibility verification, authorization, and enrollment workflows across managed care plan, Develop and maintain strategic relationships with local providers, community organizations, managed care plans, and other partners to strengthen referrals, expand services, and support program goals.

The Hardware Engineer will provide the Long-Range Radar System Support team support with designing, developing, testing, and maintaining hardware systems and components to ensure performance, reliability, and compliance with operational requirements. You will also be involved in system integration efforts, troubleshooting hardware-related issues, and working with cross-functional teams to support system design, validation, and deployment activities.


This position in onsite at MMAC in Oklahoma City, OK.


To be successful in this role, you will need strong knowledge of hardware engineering principles, system integration, and lifecycle management, along with the ability to work across multiple technical domains.

  • Design, develop, and support hardware systems and components--including circuit boards, processors, and embedded systems—to keep ARSR-4 and CARSR long-range radar systems fully operational.
  • Perform hardware integration, testing, and validation to ensure systems meet performance and reliability requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware issues across development, test, and production environments.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, system engineers, and documentation teams to seamlessly integrate hardware solutions, driving the design, testing, and deployment of modifications for obsolescence, compliance, and threat mitigation.
  • Develop and execute test plans, procedures, and documentation for system validation and verification.
  • Analyze system requirements and translate them into hardware specifications and design solutions.
  • Support configuration management, system upgrades, and lifecycle sustainment activities.
  • Provide technical input to system architecture, design reviews, and engineering discussions.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable FAA, industry, and safety standards.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including design documents, test reports, and user guides.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Hardware Engineering or a related technical field and 4+ years of prior relevant experience. Additional years of experience or education may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience designing, integrating, and testing hardware systems or components.
  • Experience troubleshooting hardware and system-level issues and performing root cause analysis.
  • Working knowledge of embedded systems, circuit design, or related hardware components.
  • Experience developing and executing test procedures and validating system performance.
  • Ability to interpret technical requirements and translate them into effective engineering solutions.
  • Experience working in a collaborative, multi-disciplined engineering environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation and supporting configuration management processes.
  • Understanding of the hardware development lifecycle, including design, integration, testing, and sustainment.
  • Ability to obtain & maintain public trust suitability.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience supporting FAA or other federal government programs.
  • Experience with systems integration in operational or mission-critical environments.

  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid engineering environments.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity considerations for hardware systems.
  • Experience supporting fielded systems, sustainment, or modernization efforts.

description:
Ready to Inspire the Next Generation? Join UMF as an Admissions Counselor! 🎓 The Vibe

Are you energetic, natural at building great connections, and passionate about the life-changing power of higher education?

The University of Maine at Farmington (UMF) is looking for a high-energy, culturally competent, and driven Admissions Counselor to join our Enrollment Management powerhouse. In this role, you won't just recruit students—you will be the face of UMF, guiding first-year, transfer, adult, and graduate learners (and their families) through one of the most exciting milestones of their lives!

If you love a dynamic mix of strategic independent territory management, high-impact teamwork, and hitting the road to share the UMF story, this is your ultimate career launchpad.

Based on the qualifications and experience of the successful applicant, the anticipated annual salary for this position is $45,300.32 plus an employer contribution to the UMS retirement plan. Additional benefits include medical, dental, vision, and tuition waiver programs for employees and dependents.

Your Impact (The Day-to-Day)

As an Admissions Counselor, your primary mission is to spark interest, build meaningful relationships, and champion access to education. Your calendar will be vibrant, varied, and fast-paced:

  • Be the Ultimate Guide: Educate prospective students, parents, and school counselors about UMF's incredible academic programs and vibrant community.
  • Champion Diversity: Design and implement proactive recruitment strategies to smash goals and increase awareness among diverse and underrepresented student populations.
  • Own Your Territory: Take the reins of your assigned geographic region and plan and execute recruitment activities that put UMF on the map.
  • Shape the Future Class: Review applications and conduct detailed evaluations to help select the next generation of UMF students.
  • Bring the Energy to Campus: Play a starring role in creating unforgettable experiences during high-energy on-campus events like Open Houses and Accepted Student Days.
  • Counselor of the Day: Step into the spotlight during our staff rotation to welcome daily campus visitors and answer their burning questions.

Are You the Perfect Fit?

What you must bring to the table (Required Qualifications):

  • The Degree: A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
  • The Wanderlust: A genuine enthusiasm and ability to travel extensively, including flexibility for evening and weekend events.
  • Cultural Competency: A deep understanding of the unique challenges facing diverse populations and a commitment to advocating for students with marginalized identities.
  • Superb Communication: Rock-solid public speaking, writing, and interpersonal skills.
  • Tech Savvy: A quick learner who is completely at ease adapting to modern software and university tech platforms.

Bonus points if you have (Preferred Extras):

  • One (1) to Three (3) years of experience in admissions, higher education, or a closely related professional field.
  • A proven track record of connecting well with high school or college-bound students and their families.
  • Digital savvy and a knack for leveraging social media platforms to engage an audience.

Why UMF?
