title: Product Manager, AI Trip Planning
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

The Guest product team owns and builds the end-to-end journey guests take to travel with us, from the first idea through the trip itself. Trip planning is where that journey becomes intelligent: a team of engineers, applied researchers, designers, and data scientists building an AI planning agent that can understand what guests are looking for, and reason across homes, experiences, services and more to assemble a real trip. We're building toward a future where Airbnb feels like a knowledgeable travel companion that plans alongside you.

The Difference You Will Make:

As Product Manager for AI trip planning, you will own the strategy and execution for this agent — one of Airbnb's most ambitious bets on an AI-native product. You'll define what it means for an agent to plan a trip well: how it asks the right questions, reasons about tradeoffs guests care about, and turns intent into a bookable trip spanning homes, experiences, and services. You’ll take the product from a demo to a system millions of guests rely on, and the work will be measured in bookings across categories and guest satisfaction at global scale. You’ll communicate these new AI features to the world by distilling the complex ideas into simple, delightful, and well-received products.

A Typical Day:

  • Define and drive the roadmap for a multi-turn agent that can plan trips with guests along their travel journey
  • Set the quality bar for agent behavior: what a good plan looks like, where the agent should defer to the guest, and how it recovers when it's wrong
  • Own the cross-category planning problem and sequence work with Homes, Experiences, Services, and Hotels so the agent can plan across the full inventory
  • Work with ML engineers and applied researchers on model strategy, evaluation frameworks, and experiment design
  • Make prioritization calls when guest trust, planning quality, latency, cost, marketplace health, and revenue pull against each other
  • Keep cross-functional partners such as Search & Discovery, Relevance & Personalization, Trips, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, Legal, and Privacy aligned on shared goals and sequencing
  • Design A/B experiments and offline evals, including proxy metrics for planning quality and measurement of long-term effects
  • Turn complex technical tradeoffs into clear decisions for engineering teams and concise narratives for leadership
  • Stay close to guests: synthesize user research, planning-session data, and competitive signals to sharpen your intuition and refine strategy
  • Partner with marketing and communications to bring each release to market, and craft the product narrative that explains it to leadership internally and to guests externally

Your Expertise:

  • 10+ years of consumer product management experience, including meaningful time on AI/ML, search, recommendations, or conversational products at scale
  • A track record of owning strategy, setting direction for technically complex systems, and making tough prioritization decisions
  • Experience shipping LLM-based products in production, including the evaluation, latency, cost, and guardrail work that stands between a good demo and a launch
  • Fluent in experimentation: you can evaluate A/B test results and offline eval honestly, and reason about proxy metrics versus long-term outcomes
  • Strong judgment of consumer product quality; you can tell the difference between an agent that sounds impressive and one that’s useful
  • Experience working on two-sided marketplaces or platforms where you balanced supply-side and demand-side tradeoffs
  • Ability to earn the respect of Staff and Principal-level engineers and researchers
  • Clear, structured communicator who can distill complex technical tradeoffs for executives and translate strategic intent into actionable guidance for engineers
  • Experience with agentic systems: tool use, planning and orchestration, retrieval, or multi-turn state management (preferred)

Your Location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in San Francisco, CA to be able to conduct their work.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range
$232,000—$282,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ or @ email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Director, Mergers & Acquisitions
description:
Director, Mergers & Acquisitions

About Hansen Technologies

Hansen Technologies (ASX: HSN) is a global software provider to the energy, utilities, water, and communications and media industries, with more than 50 years serving customers and software in use in 80+ countries. Hansen's product suite spans BSS/OSS, including billing, customer care, meter data management, supporting energy and utilities end-customers and communications subscribers worldwide.

Acquisitions are a core pillar of Hansen’s growth strategy. We are seeking an experienced corporate development leader to identify, cultivate, and execute acquisition opportunities that advance Hansen's strategic objectives across the Americas.

The Role

The Director, Mergers & Acquisitions will be responsible for identifying, developing and executing strategic acquisition opportunities across North and South America, with a particular emphasis on established software companies operating within Hansen’s existing industry ecosystem.

The primary objective is to build a sustainable pipeline of high-quality acquisition targets that strengthen Hansen's market position, expand its product capabilities, increase recurring revenues and create long-term shareholder value.

This is a hands-on, commercially driven origination role, requiring direct engagement with founders, owners and management teams rather than reliance on investment banks or intermediaries.

Key Responsibilities

Origination & Relationship Development

  • Proactively identify, research, and prioritise potential acquisition targets that align with Hansen’s strategic and financial objectives.
  • Build and maintain a database of company founders, CEOs, and senior executives of potential targets.
  • Develop and manage a network of relationships with investment banks, corporate finance advisers, venture investors, and other market participants to maintain a steady pipeline of opportunities.
  • Represent Hansen in external discussions with professionalism and credibility.

Evaluation & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end deal processes including valuation, financial modelling, business case preparation, and due diligence coordination.
  • Assess strategic fit, financial attractiveness, and integration feasibility of potential acquisitions.
  • Work closely with internal teams (finance, legal, technology, HR, operations) and external advisers to execute transactions efficiently.
  • Drive negotiation of transaction terms and documentation in partnership with internal and external counsel.

Integration & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate with business leaders to plan for integration and ensure acquired businesses are effectively onboarded.
  • Provide insights to refine Hansen’s M&A and broader corporate strategy based on market trends and deal flow.
  • Support periodic reviews of M&A performance and strategic pipeline reporting to executive leadership.

About You

  • Experience: 10+ years in mergers & acquisitions, corporate development, or investment banking, with deep exposure to sourcing and executing transactions.
  • Deal Origination: Demonstrated ability to build networks, uncover opportunities, and develop relationships that lead to successful transactions.
  • Industry Insight: Exposure to enterprise software, energy & utilities, or communications sectors an advantage.
  • Strategic Assessment: Assess acquisition candidates against Hansen's strategic priorities, including evaluating product functionality, customer base, competitive positioning, financial position, market growth opportunities and valuation
  • Communication & Influence: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills, able to engage confidently with founders, boards, and senior executives.
  • Mobility: Willingness to travel internationally, primarily across North and South America.
  • Work Authorization: Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why Join Hansen Technologies?

At Hansen, you’ll have the opportunity to shape and execute a core component of the company’s global growth strategy. You’ll work directly with senior executives, drive strategic acquisitions across key markets, and play a leading role in Hansen’s continued evolution as a global software leader.

title: Cybersecurity Information Systems Security Engineer, SME
description:
Overview

Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is seeking a Cybersecurity Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE), Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support mission-critical operations within classified DoD environments.

In this role, you will provide cybersecurity engineering support for classified networks and systems, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of critical information assets supporting U.S. Space Force missions. You will assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of security solutions that protect against evolving cyber threats.

You will support cybersecurity program activities by conducting reviews, tracking action items, and providing recommendations in accordance with Department of the Air Force (DAF), DoD, and Intelligence Community (IC) cybersecurity policies and standards. You will also help ensure compliance with information security requirements and support risk management efforts.

As a cybersecurity SME, you will collaborate with program leadership, government stakeholders, and technical teams to ensure security solutions are effectively integrated into existing environments. You will support configuration management processes, evaluate security impacts of system changes, and help maintain compliance while supporting mission objectives.

  • Provide expert cybersecurity engineering and strategic guidance in support of mission-critical DoD and U.S. Space Force programs

  • Strong knowledge of NIST, DoD, Department of the Air Force (DAF), and Intelligence Community (IC) cybersecurity policies, standards, and best practices

Required

The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

title: Lead Engineer (Building Services)
description:
The opportunity

Take a leading role in delivering mechanical engineering projects, and help shape how they are delivered.


JCPS Mechanical is looking for an experienced Lead Engineer (Building Services) to provide technical leadership across the planning, coordination, installation and handover of mechanical services projects.


You will work closely with project teams, consultants, suppliers and subcontractors to translate technical requirements into well-coordinated installations. From reviewing drawings and resolving technical queries to supporting procurement and commissioning, you will play a central role in keeping projects moving safely, efficiently and to the required standard.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership, solving practical challenges and supporting the development of others. Based at our head office in Ballycoolin, Dublin 11, you will combine office-based engineering coordination with project-site involvement.


About JCPS Mechanical

JCPS Mechanical delivers mechanical services packages for major main contractors and specialist clients across Ireland and Northern Ireland.


From our head office in Ballycoolin, Dublin 11, our teams deliver HVAC, ductwork, plumbing and public health installations across commercial, industrial, healthcare, hospitality, aviation and aerospace projects. Dedicated Maintenance and Renewables divisions support our wider service offering.


We are certified to ISO 45001, ISO 14001 and ISO 9001. As the business grows, we are looking for people who take pride in their work, collaborate effectively and want to contribute to the development of our projects and teams.


What you will lead

Technical delivery. Lead the mechanical engineering input across assigned projects, helping ensure systems meet the agreed specification, programme, quality and budget requirements.


Design review and coordination. Review drawings, technical specifications and scopes of work, identifying gaps, clashes and buildability issues before they affect installation.


Project collaboration. Coordinate with consultants, architects, main contractors, subcontractors and internal teams to resolve technical queries and maintain clear information flow.


Procurement and technical submissions. Support equipment and material selection, prepare and review technical submittals, and coordinate approvals in line with project requirements.


Programme support. Plan engineering deliverables around procurement and installation milestones, flagging risks and helping project teams resolve delays.


Site assurance. Carry out site inspections to review installation quality, compliance with approved information and progress against project requirements.


Problem-solving. Provide practical technical guidance during installation, testing and commissioning, working with site teams to resolve issues.


Commercial awareness. Support cost estimates, budget monitoring and the assessment of technical changes, identifying their potential impact on cost and programme.


Team development. Guide and mentor junior engineers and project staff, encouraging consistent standards and effective ways of working.


Handover and close-out. Support testing, commissioning, snag resolution and the preparation of complete technical handover documentation.


Reporting. Keep project leadership informed of engineering progress, outstanding decisions, technical risks and required actions.


What you will bring

We are looking for an engineer who combines strong technical knowledge with the ability to coordinate people, information and priorities.


You will have:


A degree in Mechanical Engineering or Building Services Engineering.


At least five years’ relevant experience within the mechanical, electrical and plumbing industry, with substantial involvement in mechanical building services delivery.


Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, plumbing and piping systems.


Experience reviewing engineering drawings, specifications and technical submissions.


An understanding of how design coordination, procurement, installation and commissioning connect throughout a project.


Experience coordinating with contractors, consultants, suppliers and site teams.


The ability to identify technical risks, resolve problems and communicate clear recommendations.


Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing deadlines.


The confidence to guide junior colleagues and work independently while contributing to the wider project team.


A practical commitment to safety, quality and cost-effective delivery.


Experience that would be useful


The following would strengthen your application but is not essential:


Experience working for a mechanical or M&E contractor.

Experience delivering commercial, industrial, healthcare, hospitality, aviation or aerospace projects.

Familiarity with BIM coordination and digital drawing-review tools.

Experience supporting testing, commissioning and mechanical systems handover.

description:
Work Arrangement

This is an onsite position.

Job Overview

The Material Planning Manager is responsible for leading material planning activities to ensure uninterrupted production and on-time customer delivery. This role oversees demand planning alignment, material availability, and inventory optimization while driving continuous improvement across planning processes and systems. The Material Planning Manager partners closely with Manufacturing, Procurement, Engineering, Finance, and Program Management to balance cost, service, and operational efficiency.

title: Infrastructure Integration Engineer
description:

Job Description:

Infrastructure Integration Engineer

Location: Chandler, Arizona (Hybrid)

Role Overview

This organization is seeking a senior-level engineer to design and lead complex technical integrations across network services. The successful candidate will drive the creation of robust connectivity patterns, interface designs, and automation frameworks that enable artificial intelligence and automation solutions to interact securely with enterprise tools. Project Supervisor

Location: Hook, Hampshire

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

The Opportunity

We are seeking a practical, organised and customer-focused Project Supervisor to support the delivery of construction projects across London and the South-East.

The intention is to recruit someone into a Project Supervisor role, with the opportunity to progress into Project Management once they have developed the required technical knowledge, site experience and project management capabilities.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a construction or trade background who wants to develop their skills, take on greater responsibility and build a long-term career in project management.

Salary of £29,500–£33,000, depending on experience and skill set.

*

Company bonus scheme offering an additional 3% of salary, subject to annual turnover targets.

*

Company-branded Transit Connect van for site visits.

*

Company mobile phone and laptop.

25 days' annual leave, plus eight UK bank holidays.

*

Auto-enrolment pension scheme and on-site parking.

Career development and progression into Project Management.

Carry out pre-installation surveys, assessing site readiness, access, storage and programme requirements.

Identify site constraints, risks, missing information and potential delays, communicating these promptly.

Coordinate labour, deliveries, materials, tools and consumables to support efficient installations.

Check installations against drawings, specifications and required quality standards.

Report defects, damage, variations, delays and non-conformances promptly.

Take on increasing responsibility, working towards promotion into Project Management.

Confident communicating with customers, site teams and installation operatives.

Good practical measuring skills, attention to detail and an understanding of quality control.

Strong written and spoken English, with good numeracy skills.

Relevant CSCS card or willingness to obtain one.

title: Group Reserving Actuary
description:
The Role

The Group Reserving Actuary supports the Group Reserving Lead in coordinating quarterly Group reserving, rolling up Group results (GAAP and IFRS17) and preparing materials for the Group Reserving Management Forum (RMF) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), while helping shape Group-wide reserving process and strategy with Finance, Underwriting Global Product Heads and the regional and entity reserving teams.

Responsibilities

Reserving and reporting

  • Provide commentary, rationale and exhibits supporting quarterly Group reserving results for presentation at Group RMF.
  • Support and provide technical peer review of quarterly reserving across all entities and relevant bases to enable Group consolidation.
  • Understand emerging experience and clearly explain results, key movements and uncertainties to stakeholders.
  • Facilitate the processing and reporting of Management Allowance, as set by the RMF.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work with Finance FP&A to monitor experience against plan (IFRS17 basis) and understand how reserving estimate changes affect Finance’s earned results.
  • Support internal stakeholder management, including explaining earned Underwriting results to Underwriting Global Product Heads.
  • Support external stakeholder discussions as required, including with Regulators, External Audit, SAO providers and capital providers across the Group.

Process and Governance

  • Co-ordinate the Group reserving timetable, oversee regional delivery and deliver Group outputs to Finance: ultimate and earned estimates, cashflow analysis and translation to IFRS17 basis.
  • Help ensure a consistent reserving approach and basis across the Group through periodic peer reviews promoting consistency and best practice.
  • Keep abreast of technical and non-technical market developments, and understand and investigate emerging trends and issues affecting the Canopius Group portfolio.
  • Seek continual improvements to Group reserving processes and associated MI to support clear, concise communication and KPIs for stakeholders.
  • Perform duties in accordance with the applicable Canopius Policies.

People Development

  • Manage and develop junior members of the reserving team.

Skills and Experience

  • Newly qualified actuary (strong nearly qualified candidates may be considered for a slightly adjusted role)
  • Experience preparing or reviewing Lloyd’s/London Market reserving estimates

  • Understanding of standard reserving techniques

  • Understanding of market practice for GAAP and IFRS17

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong Microsoft suite skills and a good understanding of how database and programming languages are used across the actuarial team and wider business
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Proactive, with strong personal commitment and drive

  • Adaptable, open-minded and able to use own initiative

  • Ability to think creatively about related issues

  • Team player

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to timely, high-quality work, including thorough self-review and error checking

title: Salesforce Solution Architect | Public Health Exp Required
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL / TRIBAL / STATE / FEDERAL / NON-PROFIT). IF YOU HAVE THAT EXPERIENCE IN ADDITION TO SALESFORCE SKILLS, PLEASE ENSURE IT IS CLEAR ON YOUR RESUME.

About Us

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Health; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer who thrives in collaborative environments and wants to build technology that makes a real difference in public health. You'll work within our SAFe Agile framework alongside architects, consultants, and fellow developers to deliver Salesforce solutions for health departments nationwide.

This role is ideal for someone who values teamwork over solo heroics, enjoys iterating on solutions with input from colleagues and clients, and finds satisfaction in building systems that help communities flourish.

How You'll Work

You'll be part of an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions where you'll help shape the technical roadmap alongside the full team
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives
  • Cross-functional Teams: You'll collaborate closely with architects, business analysts, and quality engineers rather than working in silos
  • Continuous Improvement: You'll have regular opportunities to reflect on what's working and suggest improvements to our processes

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow
  • Collaborate with architects on solution design and implementation approaches
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives
  • Write clean, well-documented, testable code that follows our team standards
  • Partner with QA to ensure high-quality deliverables
  • Contribute to code reviews with constructive, supportive feedback
  • Help translate public health requirements into technical solutions
  • Support the development of our PH360 platform

Experience Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • 1-3 years of work experience in governmental public health (local, state, federal, tribal, or non-profit)
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe environments
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required

Technical Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation tools
  • Understanding of Salesforce data modeling and security model
  • Familiarity with integration patterns and REST/SOAP APIs
  • Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks and test-driven development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification
  • Experience with Service Cloud or Health Cloud
  • Familiarity with HIPAA compliance requirements
  • Experience with SAFe Agile methodology
  • Background in public health data systems or epidemiology workflows

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step. We've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

How we work: Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us. Success is measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work). We view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

The natural rhythm of consulting: Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds. They should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Willingness to adhere to our no-drug workplace policy. You must agree to undergo eVerify for employment status at hiring.

No 3rd Party Recruiters.

We value initiative. If you're genuinely interested in this role, show us. (However, please do not use the "Schedule a Meeting" feature on our website. You will be disqualified.) We notice candidates who take the extra step to express real interest. Demonstrate the value that you will add to F&T Labs.

At Flourish and Thrive Labs, we believe in the unique value each candidate brings. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and experiences, even if you don't meet all listed qualifications

title: Business Continuity Officer P&C
description:
We are seeking a proactive and analytical **Business Continuity Planning Officer** to join our team. In this role, you will support the development, implementation, and maintenance of business continuity plans, assess potential risks, and coordinate preparedness initiatives to strengthen organizational resilience. If you're passionate about risk management, problem-solving, and ensuring business readiness, we'd love to hear from you.

About Guardian General Insurance Limited
Guardian General Insurance Limited is a leading property and casualty insurance company dedicated to providing comprehensive coverage and exceptional service to our clients. With a commitment to integrity and innovation, we strive to protect what matters most to our customers and communities.

JOB OVERVIEW:
The Business Continuity Planning Officer is responsible for coordinating and managing the implementation of the Business Continuity Management Program throughout the Property and Casualty Territories - Trinidad, Barbados, Grenada and Jamaica.

The position exists to maintain critical operations during and after a disruptive event, minimizing financial loss, protecting its reputation, and ensuring compliance with regulations.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Business Continuity Governance – Design & Maintenance
• Develop, implement and maintain the organisation’s Business Continuity Planning (BCP) framework, including the Emergency Preparedness Plan, so that critical business services can continue during a disruption and be restored after it.
• Establish and maintain a Business Continuity Management System that is aligned to relevant standards (eg ISO 22301)
• Ensure the health, safety and welfare of employees during a Business Continuity Event (BC)
• Minimize the risk of interruption or negative impact on delivery of Critical Business Services
• Continue to deliver products and services at an acceptable predefined capacity during a disruption
• Minimize disruption and enable full restoration of services in the event of unavoidable interruption of those services.
• Minimize the financial impact of any disruption
• Minimize the reputational risk and adverse brand impact arising out of a BC Event.

2. Embedding Business Continuity & Emergency Preparedness

title: Executive Director, Global Forecasting
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Vice President, Global Analytics & Insights, the Executive Director, Global Forecasting will lead the global forecasting function across disease areas and the portfolio, from preclinical and Phase 1 assets through commercialization. The role directly manages three Senior Directors spanning disease area forecasting and portfolio forecasting methods, systems and analytics, and develops the teams and capabilities needed to support an expanding portfolio.

This leader will integrate forecasts and scenarios into a coherent view of opportunity, demand and risk, informing development, lifecycle, investment and commercial decisions. Working with global and regional partners, the Executive Director will establish shared forecasting standards, align priorities and translate uncertainty into clear recommendations for senior leadership. This position is based at our headquarters in Redwood City, CA.

Responsibilities

  • Set the global forecasting strategy, operating model and priorities across early products, later-stage programs and commercial assets. Align resources and delivery with critical business decisions and planning cycles.

  • Directly manage, coach and develop three Senior Directors and their teams. Establish clear accountabilities across disease area forecasting and portfolio methods, systems and analytics; build leadership capacity and manage functional budgets and vendors.

  • Oversee global patient-based, revenue and demand forecasts, integrating regional inputs into a consistent portfolio view. Agree with regional leaders, Finance and Supply Chain the ownership, review and approval of forecasts for each planning purpose. Challenge key assumptions and ensure analytical rigor, with transparent regional perspectives and unresolved differences.

  • Lead forecasting contributions to cross-portfolio scenario planning with Disease Area Insights and Data & Analytics. Assess overlapping populations, treatment sequencing, combinations, launch timing and product interactions to quantify incremental opportunity and avoid double counting.

  • Establish a shared global and regional framework for methodologies, core assumptions, scenarios, documentation and review, agreed with regional forecasting leaders. Ensure meaningful differences are reconciled or clearly explained with evidence and implications for planning, with an agreed process for justified local adaptations.

  • Oversee forecasting model design, methodologies, consolidation logic and analytical requirements. Partner with Data & Analytics and Information Systems on shared data infrastructure and platform delivery. Guide adoption of probabilistic methods, sensitivity analyses and decision frameworks where they improve assessment of uncertainty, interdependencies and decision thresholds.

  • Partner with Finance and Supply Chain to provide forecasts and scenarios for long-range plans, budgets, launch readiness, supply and capacity planning, and ongoing commercial and demand planning. Ensure transparent translation of patient, treatment duration and utilization assumptions into revenue and demand, with clear bridges explaining differences between strategic, operating and supply planning views.

  • Provide forecasting leadership for early product assessments, development and lifecycle options, portfolio prioritization and go/no-go decisions. Quantify scenarios and value drivers using commercial evidence led by Disease Area Insights and analytical inputs from Data & Analytics, contributing to the integrated A&I recommendation led by the Vice President. Support Business and Corporate Development and Commercial Partnerships with business cases, scenarios and independent assessment of assumptions.

  • Partner with Disease Area Insights, Data & Analytics, Commercial, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Market Access and Portfolio Strategy to incorporate evidence, competitive developments and market dynamics into forecasts and strategic recommendations.

  • Coordinate with regional forecasting leaders to agree priorities, ownership, support and transitions based on local capabilities and needs. Provide expertise and practical support through the team, strengthen local capabilities and facilitate reuse of tools and effective practices. Agree capacity, service expectations and readiness criteria for transitions, maintaining continuity of support.

  • Establish forecast review and quality assurance processes, including model validation, version control, assumption traceability and analysis of forecast changes. Incorporate actual performance and emerging evidence to improve forecasts over time, evaluating forecast accuracy and bias at appropriate horizons and explaining their drivers.

  • Present integrated forecasts, ranges, risks and strategic implications to senior leadership. Resolve cross-functional differences where possible and elevate material tradeoffs and unresolved assumptions for decisions.

  • Travel domestically and internationally as needed, typically up to 25–30%.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of progressive experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals or consulting, including substantial experience leading forecasting in oncology.

  • Experience managing senior leaders and managers, developing teams and scaling forecasting capabilities in a growing organization.

  • Deep expertise in patient-based forecasting, portfolio scenarios and risk analysis across early development, launch and commercial stages, including interactions among multiple products and indications.

  • Experience translating forecasts into long-range plans, supply requirements, portfolio investment decisions and business opportunity assessments.

  • Experience establishing shared methods, governance and systems across global and regional teams while accommodating justified market differences.

  • Strong analytical judgment and business acumen, with the ability to challenge assumptions, communicate uncertainty and influence senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

  • Ability to prioritize competing needs, work effectively through ambiguity and combine functional leadership with direct contributions to critical business questions.

Preferred Skills:

  • Advanced degree in a quantitative, scientific or business discipline.

  • Experience launching targeted oncology therapies globally and supporting business development or commercialization partnerships.

  • Experience applying advanced analytics and probabilistic methods to portfolio forecasting and decision making.

description:
Company Description

Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SOSi is a private defense and government solutions business specializing in advanced technology systems and mission support. Its capabilities include data science, software development, network engineering, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and logistics.

Job Description

**This position is contingent upon award of contract**

SOSi is seeking an Effects Planner. The Effects Planner facilitates and coordinates all aspects of operational-level planning, synchronization, and integration. They provide planning support encompassing analytics, assessments, target development, and planning advocacy for subordinate commands. Planners refine and align priorities with national-level objectives, ensuring operational goals are nested within strategic directives. They draft special operations related documents, including plans, orders, and authoritative guidance, and advise military staff on their interpretation and application.

Essential Job Duties

  • Rally cross-functional planning teams to orchestrate effects into a cohesive operational plan that actually works.
  • Facilitate working groups to untangle resource conflicts, timing misalignments, and competing objectives between different subordinate commands and staff sections.
  • Dig into analysis to uncover key vulnerabilities and critical nodes within a target system that, when addressed, will deliver the desired effect.
  • Develop Measures of Performance (MOPs) and Measures of Effectiveness (MOEs) that tell the real story of whether an operation is hitting its intended targets.
  • Champion the operational-level target development process, nominating specific targets or actions that directly support the overall campaign plan.
  • Analyze ongoing operations and deliver formal assessments to leadership that cut through the noise and show what's actually working.
  • Translate national-level strategic guidance into operational reality, ensuring all plans and priorities ladder up to and support strategic directives.
  • Refine, prioritize, and champion the plans and resource requirements of subordinate commands during higher-level planning conferences.
  • Craft and staff major special operations documents—think CONPLANs, OPORDs, and formal planning guidance—that are clear, compelling, and actionable.
  • Become the go-to subject matter expert on published plans, guiding military staff and subordinate units through interpretation, application, and intent.
  • Prepare and deliver briefings to senior leaders that break down proposed or current plans, highlighting intended effects and synchronization in ways that resonate.
Qualifications

Working at SOSi

title: Technical Writer
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Company Overview

We are a world-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50+ locations world-wide. Much of our work contributes to innovative research in the fields of sensor science, signal processing, data fusion, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and augmented reality (AR).

QinetiQ US’s dedicated experts in defense, aerospace, security, and related fields all work together to explore new ways of protecting the American Warfighter, Security Forces, and Allies. Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. Partnering with our customers, we help save lives; reduce risks to society; and maintain the global infrastructure on which we all depend.

Why Join QinetiQ US?

If you have the courage to take on a wide variety of complex challenges, then you will experience a unique working environment where innovative teams blend different perspectives, disciplines, and technologies to discover new ways of solving complex problems. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. QinetiQ US will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Position Overview

QinetiQ US is looking for a Technical Writer. This is is an excellent opportunity to provide direct technical writing and communications support to the Federal Highway Administration's (FHWA) Office of Information Technology Services (OITS). You will develop clear, accessible IT communications and documentation, including agency-wide IT notices, SOPs, user guides, job aids, FAQs, and presentations.

You will work hand in hand with IT project teams and leadership, translating technical content for non-technical audiences, often on short timelines. Every product you deliver must conform to Section 508 accessibility standards.

Responsibilities

  • Write, edit, and format agency-wide IT communications, including advance notices, outage and upgrade notices, and change announcements.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), user guides, job aids, checklists, and FAQs in FHWA's standard formats.
  • Develop and maintain SDLC documentation and control-gate artifacts (requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance), and make sure final versions are uploaded to the document repository.
  • Create announcements, flyers, and slide decks for IT Office Hours and other outreach sessions and edit presentations for FHWA IT leaders.
  • Make sure all deliverables conform to Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act (36 CFR Part 1194). Remediate Word/Google Docs, PowerPoint/Google Slides, and PDF files.
  • Advise and coach FHWA staff on creating accessible documents.
  • Review intranet, SharePoint, and Google Sites content for accuracy, usability, and accessibility, and recommend improvements.
  • Support change management communications by tracking drafts through the review and approval chain and incorporating stakeholder feedback.
  • Maintain a documentation status tracker and a library of templates.
  • Gather information from subject matter experts by attending project meetings, trainings, and working sessions.
  • Capture user questions and feedback from office hours and inquiries to identify recurring issues and improve future communications.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 2 years of technical writing experience
  • Experience producing Section 508-conformant documents
  • Experience writing procedural documentation (e.g., SOPs, user guides, job aids) for IT systems or processes
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 productivity applications
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOT Public Trust
  • This is a hybrid position with potential regular on-site presence at U.S. DOT Headquarters in Washington, DC.

Preferred Qualifications

  • DHS Section 508 Trusted Tester certification
  • Experience remediating PDFs with Adobe Acrobat Pro
  • Experience applying federal plain-language guidelines (Plain Writing Act of 2010)
  • Experience writing IT change management or release communications
  • Experience supporting an enterprise IT platform migration (e.g., Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace)
  • Experience authoring content in SharePoint or Google Sites
  • Experience supporting a federal agency, preferably DOT
  • Familiarity with responsible use of AI writing tools (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) in a federal environment
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this role is $68,000 - $78,000USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. QinetiQ US considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Company EEO Statement

Accessibility/Accommodation:

If because of a medical condition or disability you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to staffing@us.QinetiQ.com or call (540) 658-2720 Opt. 1 and let us know the nature of your request and contact information.

QinetiQ US is an Equal Opportunity employer. All Qualified Applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, age, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.

title: Junior Enterprise Watch Officer
description:
Overview

Junior Enterprise Watch Officer

St. Louis, MO

Are you ready to enhance your skills and build your career in a rapidly evolving business climate? Are you looking for a career where professional development is embedded in your employer’s core culture? If so, Chenega Military, Intelligence & Operations Support (MIOS) could be the place for you! Join our team of professionals who support large-scale government operations by leveraging cutting-edge technology and take your career to the next level!

Chenega Agile Real-Time Solutions (CARS) was created with the purpose of providing integrated enterprise IT support to Federal customers both CONUS and OCONUS. CARS employs Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with decades of experience working in the Federal marketplace.

The Junior Enterprise Watch Officer services encompass delivering proactive collection, dissemination, and monitoring of mission system and site status, as well as leadership, coordination, and collaboration for critical and high priority incident resolution that provides NGA executives and CIO-T leadership with situational awareness located in St. Louis, MO.

Responsibilities

  • Manage Critical Priority 1 tickets to resolution
  • Monitor operational activities of all cells within the ESC (e.g., PSOC, CSOC) to maintain centralized situational awareness of the overall health of NGA IT services.
  • Communicate the status of the operational infrastructure
  • Provide briefings to senior leadership on the status of the IT enterprise
  • Prepare and deliver the Daily Operations briefs
  • Collect, coordinate, and brief upcoming days AOs
  • Recommend appropriate mitigation activities to minimize down time, minimize mission impact and restore services as soon as possible.
  • Assist in assessing the impact of events and incidents on mission capability, prioritizing service restoration activities, and providing final assessment of mission impacts prior to conducting authorized outages.
  • Coordinate with any impacted mission partners during unscheduled outages to advise of outage status, remediation actions, and projected restoral times.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree and 2+ years relevant experience or
  • Associate’s degree and 4+ years relevant experience or
  • 6+ years relevant experience
    • Operational experience with ServiceNow
    • Experience in the Intelligence Community
  • TS/SCI Clearance
  • Successfully pass background and drug screening

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree
  • Active CompTIA Security + Certification

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to obtain CI Poly Clearance
  • Ability to work Panama Day or Night Shift hours. Would be considered the “Floater” on the team
  • Ability to work nights / weekends / holidays
  • Ability to work independently and yet be effective within a team setting
  • Must be capable of managing multiple efforts with time related constraints in a fast-paced contracting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with diverse internal and external stakeholder groups and individuals
  • Friendly presence, helpful attitude, good interpersonal skills, and ability to work well with others.
  • Excellent skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, and other Office applications
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Applications, and experience working in a home office setting as well as the ability to train end users on frequently asked technical issues.
  • Ability to provide technical assistance and support over the phone; good phone skills, professional demeanor, previous customer service experience strongly desired.
  • Good problem-solving skills; ability to visualize a problem/situation and think abstractly to solve it

How you’ll grow

At Chenega MIOS, our professional development plan focuses on helping our team members at every level of their careers to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn.

We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their careers.

Benefits

At Chenega MIOS, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our team members and offer them a broad range of benefits.

Learn more about what working at Chenega MIOS can mean for you.

Chenega MIOS’s culture

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our team members to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and continuously look for new ways to maintain a culture where we excel and lead healthy, happy lives.

Corporate citizenship

Chenega MIOS is led by a purpose to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our team members, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.

location: Edinburgh - Central Area, Midlothian, United Kingdom
description:
Grade UE07: £41,885 - £ 49,798 per annum

College of Arts, Humanities and Social Science / School of Philosophy, Psychology and Language Sciences

Full-time: 35 hours per week

Fixed-term: for 12 months

Unlocking your career. Be part of something bigger.

Here at the University of Edinburgh there’s a career for everyone. We can offer opportunities for you to develop in your career and make a real difference in the communities around us whilst contributing to the world at large. Our people come from a wide range of backgrounds, each bringing their abilities and experiences to our organisation.

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We look for the best in the field across all disciplines and provide a working environment where academics can develop their careers and passion for their chosen subject area. We offer the full range of academic roles and have a genuine focus on our student’s performance and wellbeing.

The Opportunity:

Professor Simon Kirby is seeking a Postdoctoral Research Associate to contribute to his research project, “The Evolution of Multi-Agent Communication in LLMs: Emergence, Transmission, and Interpretability”.

This project is a short time-scale and high intensity project tackling an urgent issue of wide-ranging industrial, scientific, and societal importance regarding the safety of multi-agent AI systems.

We are looking for a candidate with extensive experience in both human experiments and agent-based simulation models of the cultural evolution of language. The postholder will conduct research into cultural evolution of language using experiment and model techniques in populations of human and AI agents, contributing to the development of a new software platform for the study of evolution of multi-agent communication.

This post is a full-time (35 hours per week), fixed-term post for 12 months available from January 2027. Please note the project has a fixed funding period until 31/12/2027, so a delayed start date may impact on overall contract duration.

title: Technical Manager (Fluid Dynamics) in Bristol
description:
Technical Manager – Defence - Bristol

We are working on behalf of a successful defence development, engineering and manufacturing company who are seeking a Technical Manager to support their Structural and Fluid Dynamics capability across the company.

Office based in Bristol and with hybrid working, the successful candidate will join the senior management team and will be responsible for the development and management of the Structural and Fluid Dynamics capability, ensuring that the team has the right technical capabilities and tools and processes in place to meet the various project requirements, both now and in the future. The Technical Manager is the focal point for technical excellence, resource planning for the capability and ensuring continuous improvement within the domain.

The Structural and Fluid dynamics group provides detailed analysis for loads and flight physics projects covering:

Flight loads
Ground loads
Aeroelastics
Vibration
Test support
The group also contains the CFD capability, which conducts analysis for:

External aerodynamic flow for support to new aircraft and aircraft modifications
Internal aerodynamic flows
Hydraulic flow for the support in the design of hydraulic equipment
Thermal analysis
Acoustics
The modelling toolsets that are currently used by the group include:

Matlab
Nastran
Ansys Fluent
As Technical Manager you should have industrial experience in some of these above areas and a good appreciation and understanding of the others. You will also be expected to balance hands-on technical work and leadership together with the management activities of capability development, resource planning and line management.

Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will be responsible for the Structural and Fluid Dynamics capability, including day to day management and longer-term strategy. This is a varied role covering the below areas:

Technical

Provide technical leadership or support on projects where required
Ensure appropriate technical support is available for customer interactions, either through team members or personal involvement
Manage external suppliers within the technical area, including tendering and quality audits
Facilitate the team’s ability to deliver by ensuring the right people, tools, and processes are in place
Act as the focal point for tools within the technical area
Evaluate current toolsets and identify needs for new tools or upgrades, developing business cases where new tools are required and leading their implementation
Ensure tools are used effectively to support delivery and innovation
Process

Allocation of the Structural and Fluid Dynamics team members in line with the project requirements
Define and manage annual budget needs for internal development of capabilities and processes in line with company objectives
Support business development activities
Contribute to project proposals and bids, including technical solutions and estimated quantity of work
Hold technical checks and/or approvals for the capability area in line with the delegated authority
Act as the process owner for the technical domain, identifying missing or outdated processes and leading updates
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and push for process change where needed
Own and manage bench tasks to support capability development and delivery readiness
Collaborate with other Technical Managers to ensure cross-functional alignment and consistency
Support the capability team members to ensure that they have continued development in line with the individual's and company's needs
Qualifications:

Educated to degree level (or equivalent) - post-graduate qualification to a Master’s degree or Doctorate in a relevant specialisation (desirable)

Membership of an Engineering Body (desirable)

Chartered Engineer Status (desirable)

Due to security restrictions on some of their projects, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain SC (UK or existing SC holders only).

Your CV will be forwarded to Jonathan Lee Recruitment, a leading engineering and manufacturing recruitment consultancy established in 1978. The services advertised by Jonathan Lee Recruitment are those of an Employment Agency.

In order for your CV to be processed effectively, please ensure your name, email address, phone number and location (post code OR town OR county, as a minimum) are included

title: Senior Data Scientist - Cobrand & P+C Optimization
description:
The Senior Data Scientist - Advanced Measurement will be expected to operate with minimal supervision and mentor other data scientists to complete analytical tasks and produce model-driven solutions. As a member of a cross-functional team developing data science solutions for Marketing Measurement and overall Advanced Measurement, the

In this role, you will collaborate with data engineers and other subject matter experts to deliver results which support directional action by business teams across the Marketing, Revenue Management, Loyalty, Sales, Operations and Technology functions.

The Senior Data Scientist may partner with other data scientists to establish best practices and thought leadership for a machine learning and measurement platform to serve all of IHG.

Your Day to Day

  • Develop a thorough understanding of business problems through interviewing stakeholders and subject matter experts.

  • Address complex business problems using data science, Marketing Measurement and overall Advanced Measurement to drive insight and data-driven decision making.

  • Analyze and model structured data using advanced machine learning methods and implement algorithms and software needed to perform analyses.

  • Derive what is critical and what is extraneous to solving the business problem. Understand the data requirements for formulating the solution.

  • Research new data sets and determine their quality and feasibility.

  • Manipulate data to support various statistical techniques.

  • Effectively tell stories with data. Interpret and communicate analytic results to analytical and non-analytical business partners and executive decision makers.

  • Identify trends or patterns in complex data sets and recommend courses of action or solutions.

  • Effectively communicate to audiences of various sizes and levels, including senior and executive leadership, in both verbal and written formats.

Cobrand & Points + Cash Focus

In addition to the responsibilities above, this role will:

  • Design and evaluate Cobrand and Points + Cash experiments.

  • Build the measurement datasets and frameworks needed to quantify downstream outcomes, connecting digital behavior with loyalty, acquisition, booking and revenue data.

  • Measure incremental acquisition, booking displacement, customer lifetime value and Loyalty Driven Revenue impact to understand the broader economic impact of experience changes.

  • Use these insights to accelerate optimization of experiences that drive loyalty growth and revenue.

What We Need from You

  • Master's Degree or Ph.D. in a relevant field of work or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

  • Typically a minimum of 7+ years of progressive work-related experience with demonstrated proficiency in advanced quantitative analysis.

  • Excellent understanding of Measurement Methodologies, Design of Experiment, machine learning techniques and algorithms, such as Marketing Mix Modeling, Multi-Touch Attribution, Incrementality testing, Universal and Synthetic Control groups, XGBoost, Random Forest, etc.

  • Applied statistics skills, such as distributions, statistical testing and regression.

  • Experience with common data science toolkits in R and Python.

  • Proficiency in query languages such as SQL.

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau.

  • Experience working with very large datasets. Knowledge of distributed computing tools such as Spark is a plus.

  • Strong structured coding skills.

  • Ability to confidently utilize MS Word, MS Excel, MS SharePoint and MS Visio.

  • Ability to maintain discretion and confidentiality.

Travel: 10%

Location: Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in the ATLANTA office. This expectation may be adjusted with the changing needs of the business.

title: Training Facilitator
description:
Training Facilitator

The Opportunity:
As a trainer, you’re passionate about developing differentiated instruction and delivering it in exciting ways. You know that learning styles vary, and you thrive in helping people grasp new information. Bring your passion for developing and delivering a varied group of training programs to our Army client.

As a trainer on our team, you’ll provide in-person hybrid instruction for our government partners through live, virtual, and gaming instruction. You’ll showcase your technical expertise and industry knowledge to collaborate and devise creative solutions for mission-critical problems. In this role, you will be armed with the resources needed to excel, including tools, systems, sites, and customer support.

Be empowered to tap into your creative thinking, influencing, technology, intuition, leadership experience to develop, manage, and deliver training using the Instructional Systems Design (ISD), Design Thinking, ADDIE model, and Merrill’s Principles of Instruction process to create learning objectives, ensuring a variety of learning styles for learners' needs.

Use training materials, resources, media, technology, delivery, and inclusion of audience to cultivate a learning environment that actively promotes learner engagement. We value the skills you bring to ensure we deliver the best quality of instruction. This position is located in Ravenna, OH.

What You'll Work On:

  • Large Scale Combat Operations (LSCO), Counter Explosive Hazard, and Counter Unmanned Aerial System Training Developer and Facilitator supporting the Army mission.
  • Ensure unity of command in supporting Training Readiness Authority (TRA) by developing and executing home station individual and collective training strategies incorporating multiple assets and delivery methodologies.
  • Provide stand-up classroom instruction.
  • Apply advanced advisory skills or extensive technical expertise.
  • Develop innovative solutions to complex problems and work without considerable direction.
  • Coordinate with Garrison and State activities to improve training facilities, ranges and employ Training Aids, Devices, Simulators, and Simulations (TADSS), including Army Games for Training (GFT).
  • Assess, update, and deliver training & associated products.
  • Coordinate with commanders and assist units with planning virtual and live training.
  • Execute specialized education and training when needed for Cyber and Electromagnetic Activities (CEMA), biometrics, explosive hazards, homemade explosives (HME), site exploitation, intelligence support, Counter-small Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-sUAS), and movement and maneuver.
  • Understand the interrelationship between hybrid, asymmetric, and War Fighting Functions.
  • Synchronize arrival, sustainment, and prioritization for standard and non-standard equipment and training resources.
  • Assist with planning virtual and live training across multiple sites.
  • Provide continuity and expertise that enables awareness and effective use of assets to support training.
  • Understand how to develop and deliver training integrating the War Fighting Functions into Major Combat Operations with a hybrid threat model.

Join us. The world can't wait.


You Have:

  • 10+ years of experience with the U.S. Army
  • 4+ years of experience leading training
  • 4+ years of experience developing exercises
  • 4+ years of experience delivering exercise support
  • 2+ years of experience utilizing Games for Training such as VBS3
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
  • Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Battle Staff, training Warfighting Functions, and Games for Training (GFT)
  • Experience deployments in OIF, OEF, OND or OIR
  • Experience with CEMA
  • Experience as Observer and Controller (OC)
  • Experience with military exercise design, delivery, and conducting After Action Review (AAR)
  • Experience in training exercise operational support
  • Experience and understanding of MDO or LSCO
  • Experience in Counter-Explosive Hazard (C-EH) and C-sUAS training training
  • Bachelor's degree

title: Start-up Proposition & Founder Experience Lead
description:
Following Nationwide’s acquisition of Virgin Money, we’re building an ambitious, relationship-led Business Bank with the scale and purpose to make a meaningful difference to businesses and communities across the UK.

As Start-up Proposition & Founder Experience Lead, you’ll play a key role within Nationwide’s Entrepreneurial Support Team, shaping how we support entrepreneurs from the earliest stages of starting a business through to their next meaningful step.

This is a proposition and customer-focused role, combining insight, innovation and delivery. You’ll take what we learn from founders, the market and our own research and turn it into a compelling national proposition that gives entrepreneurs relevant, practical and accessible support when they need it.

You’ll shape the programmes, learning, tools and experiences that bring Nationwide's Entrepreneurial Support to life, working across Business Banking and with external partners to create an experience that founders value and that differentiates Nationwide in the market.

This is an opportunity to help shape something different.

As we grow our Business Bank, we have the chance to combine Nationwide’s scale, mutual purpose and trusted brand with an ambition to support more businesses and entrepreneurs across the UK.
You’ll be joining at an important point in that journey, with the opportunity to shape what Nationwide offers founders, how they experience our support and how we continue to evolve that proposition as their needs change.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to combine customer insight, proposition development and entrepreneurship, and want to create experiences that make a tangible difference to people starting and building businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Flexible base location, with occasional travel mainly to London.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll lead the development and evolution of our national start-up proposition and founder experience, creating a clear roadmap for how Nationwide supports entrepreneurs across different stages and needs.
You’ll be responsible for:

• Developing our national start-up proposition and roadmap, identifying different founder needs and defining the outcomes we want to achieve.
• Leading proposition development from initial concept through to implementation, evaluation and continuous improvement.
• Creating practical learning, guidance, tools and support that help founders build their confidence, capability and readiness to take their business forward.
• Using founder research, customer feedback, market intelligence and performance insight to identify opportunities and continually improve our proposition.
• Defining how the proposition should work across digital, regional and partner channels, creating a consistent experience while recognising that founders will engage with us in different ways.
• Setting clear standards for programme and content quality, accessibility and customer outcomes.
• Developing business cases and recommendations for proposition investment, prioritisation and future enhancements.
• Bringing together multiple teams and capabilities to turn proposition ideas into experiences that work for founders in practice.
• Connecting closely with our regional, partnership, investment and growth activity to create effective pathways for founders as their businesses develop.
• Using customer outcomes and performance measures to understand what’s working, where we can improve and where we can create greater value for entrepreneurs.

About you

You’ll bring significant experience in proposition development, customer experience, service design or programme development, alongside a strong understanding of start-ups, small businesses and the challenges entrepreneurs face.

You’re likely to have:

• Significant experience developing customer propositions, services, programmes or experiences from initial insight through to implementation.
• A strong understanding of start-ups and small businesses, with an appreciation of the practical challenges founders face when starting and growing a business.
• Experience turning research, customer insight and market intelligence into propositions and experiences that deliver measurable customer value.
• Strong proposition and customer-experience judgement, with the ability to balance founder needs, commercial priorities, accessibility and operational considerations.
• Experience developing compelling business cases and recommendations for investment and proposition enhancement.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use evidence and customer feedback to make clear decisions and prioritise effectively.
• The ability to influence senior stakeholders and bring together teams across product, digital, operations, marketing, risk and other disciplines.
• Experience leading multiple proposition, programme or content capabilities and creating clarity across complex delivery environments.
• A genuine interest in entrepreneurship and creating support that makes starting and building a business simpler and more accessible.

About your rewards

We continually review and evaluate our offering to ensure we have a broad range of market competitive benefits available for our colleagues. When you put a lot in, it’s only fair to expect a lot out. So, when you help us do the right thing for our customers, we want to reward you.

There are all sorts of employee benefits available at Nationwide, including:

• 30 days holiday
• Access to private medical insurance
• A highly competitive pension to help you build a strong foundation for retirement
• Access to an annual performance-related bonus
• Training and development to help you progress your career
• A great selection of additional benefits through our salary sacrifice scheme
• Life assurance to provide peace of mind for you and your loved ones in the event of your death
• Wellhub – access to a range of free and paid options for health and wellness
• Up to 2 days of paid volunteering a year

Banking – but fairer, more rewarding, and for the good of society
We forge our own path at Nationwide.

As a mutual, we’re owned by our members — those customers who bank, save or have a mortgage with us. We challenge the financial sector status quo. We don’t see customers as the engine of profit. We put their needs first. Always.

If you’re inspired by fairer finances, passionate about making a meaningful impact, and truly care about customers, you’re one of us.

At Nationwide, you are challenged to grow and rewarded for doing so. Valued. Recognised. Inspired to be your best.

We are purpose driven. Uncompromisingly customer. Unstoppably Nationwide.

What to do next
To apply, simply click the ‘Apply Now’ button. Please ensure you attach your CV and complete a few short application questions.
