title: Principal Solution Architect, Commercialization and Corporate Systems
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead integrated technology design across Commercial, Medical Affairs and General & Administrative (G&A) functions. This leader will shape architecture across the evolving business application portfolio, connecting processes, data and platforms to support commercialization, global expansion and efficient operations. The role will guide solution decisions from business intake through implementation and operational readiness, working closely with functional leaders, Information Technology (IT), control owners and delivery partners. This is a Director-level individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities across cross-functional teams and external partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Define target architecture and inform investment roadmaps across current and future Commercial, Medical Affairs and G&A capabilities, translating business strategy into integrated solutions that support product launches, international expansion and enterprise growth.

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to shape requests, clarify outcomes and dependencies, assess options, and recommend solutions based on business value, risk, scalability and total cost of ownership.

  • Provide architecture leadership across the G&A portfolio, including Finance, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, corporate services and enterprise operations. Connect workflows across these functions and with Commercialization, Supply Chain, and other business areas, extending architecture patterns as new business capabilities emerge.

  • Provide architecture leadership for critical cross-platform integrations, new capabilities and key technology decisions across Commercial and Medical systems, partnering with Medical, Omnichannel, Field and Data Solutions leads who own solution design within their respective areas. Assess enterprise platform scalability, including enterprise resource planning (ERP), for growth in legal entities, products, users and transaction volumes. Guide global templates and local requirements for language, currency, tax, statutory reporting and business practices.

  • Architect connected planning, forecasting and external partner ecosystems as business needs evolve. Examples include linking commercial and financial plans with supply operations and integrating third-party logistics (3PL) providers, distributors and manufacturing partners.

  • Evaluate artificial intelligence (AI), automation and emerging technologies against business needs. Reuse existing enterprise tools where suitable and define integration, data access, human oversight and measurable outcomes for new capabilities.

  • Inform buy-versus-build recommendations, assessing how advances in AI change the feasibility, speed and cost of developing and maintaining custom solutions relative to commercial platforms, while considering security, compliance, integration, scalability and long-term support.

  • Define reusable application, data and integration patterns using application programming interfaces (APIs), integration platforms and events. Establish authoritative data sources, master data ownership, reconciliation and exception handling with the relevant domain owners.

  • Partner with enterprise Data teams to design reliable information flows, consistent business definitions and reporting dependencies across operational systems, analytics and decision support.

  • Establish design standards and architecture reviews. Document decisions, system boundaries and dependencies, and resolve cross-platform trade-offs while keeping delivery teams accountable for implementation quality.

  • Provide technical leadership from discovery and vendor selection through design, implementation, testing, deployment and operational acceptance. Define performance, availability, recovery and support requirements early in the lifecycle.

  • Design for global delivery and support, with clear ownership, monitoring, knowledge transfer and handoffs across time zones. Ensure solutions transition to internal teams and managed service providers with agreed readiness criteria.

  • Partner with Security, Quality, Privacy, Finance and control owners to embed applicable Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Good Practice (GxP), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and local requirements into designs, including access, segregation of duties, validation, audit trails and retention.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, consolidate overlapping systems and reduce integration and support costs. Define the growth, risk and performance thresholds that trigger a different platform or operating approach.

Partner with platform owners, domain specialists, engineers and architects across internal and external teams to develop solution designs and integrations across systems, drawing on their expertise while maintaining overall architectural coherence. Challenge designs constructively, communicate recommendations to senior leaders, and ensure vendor solutions meet RevMed architecture standards and agreed commercial scope.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 12+ years of progressive technology experience, including 5+ years in solution architecture or comparable technical leadership across complex enterprise programs.

  • Experience in life sciences or another regulated industry is required; biotech or pharmaceutical experience is highly preferred.

  • Demonstrated architecture experience spanning Commercial or Medical platforms and enterprise G&A systems, with depth in one or more domains and the ability to lead design decisions across the broader portfolio.

  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate technology shifts and apply AI and automation to solution design and delivery, challenging established approaches and introducing practical new ways of working that improve speed, quality and business outcomes.

  • Strong experience with cloud and software-as-a-service platforms, integration architecture, enterprise data flows, security and nonfunctional requirements such as performance, reliability and recovery.

  • Experience translating business requirements into architecture options, roadmaps and technical designs, and guiding delivery through implementation and transition to support.

  • Working knowledge of applicable SOX controls, regulated-system lifecycle practices, privacy and data protection requirements, and experience partnering with the accountable specialists to implement controls.

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs in business terms, resolve competing priorities and lead internal and partner teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting oncology commercialization, multiple product launches, new legal entities or expansion across the United States, Europe and Asia Pacific.

  • Experience architecting solutions across enterprise platforms such as Veeva CRM, Oracle NetSuite, SAP, Workday, Ironclad Contract Lifecycle Management, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Databricks, or comparable platforms. Depth in one or more of these ecosystems, combined with experience integrating solutions across business functions, is preferred.

  • Experience with external commercial, distribution or manufacturing integrations, master data management, or regulated content and review workflows.

  • Practical experience deploying AI or automation with enterprise controls, and improving platform reuse, delivery speed or total cost of ownership.

  • Enterprise or solution architecture certification, or equivalent demonstrated architecture practice.

Betterment’s mission is to empower people to do what’s best for their money so that they can live better. You will be accountable for driving the next chapter of incredible growth in Betterment’s advisor business with expanded & improved workflows and tools.

You will be expected to navigate multiple concurrent projects from a high level and be able to also quickly dive into the weeds with engineers as needed to address technical, project-specific roadblocks. You’ll need to roll up your sleeves and work shoulder-to-shoulder with both highly technical and non-technical teams across the organization throughout the entire product development lifecycle. You’ll need to prioritize effectively in order to ensure that our Betterment Advisor Solutions team is building best-in-class solutions for our advisor clients.

This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range we would offer for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.

  • New York City: $145,000 - $170,000

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.

A day in the life

  • Understand the workflows and business practices of investment advisors in our target market and serve as their advocate within the organization
  • Speak directly with advisor clients to explore ways that Betterment Advisor Solutions can continue to improve their practices and client relationships
  • Work collaboratively with multiple squads to create new capabilities to support (and delight!) our advisor clients
  • Ensure that the needs of our advisors are taken into consideration in the roadmaps of the platform teams who support our operations & money movement capabilities
  • Partner with design and engineering leads to help shape the product requirements for new releases into our advisor toolset
  • Attend standups, planning meetings, and retros to support the Advisor Experience engineering team
  • Coordinate with advisor-facing teams to navigate complex client situations and oversee successful rollouts
  • Regularly communicate project goals, milestones, and progress to business stakeholders and executive leadership
  • Use AI tools across your own workflow, from synthesizing advisor feedback and drafting requirements to prototyping ideas and analyzing data, so the team can make better decisions sooner and get value into advisors’ hands faster

What we’re looking for

  • 5-7 years of product management experience at a financial services or financial technology company with a focus on trading and/or portfolio management preferred
  • Strong analytical abilities with a passion for data-inspired decision making
  • Self-starter and demonstrated success at communicating, prioritizing, and balancing needs cross-functionally
  • Obsessive attention to detail and strong organization skills in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to build strong relationships across functions within an organization
  • Creative problem solving skills that balance complying with regulatory realities and a commitment to innovation
  • Ability to think connect abstract or complicated back-end builds to delightful customer experiences
  • The story-telling capabilities that can help the organization see the long term vision of our advisor toolset
  • Experience shipping, or a strong point of view on shipping, AI-powered features, including how to evaluate output quality and manage risk

Join a team built on these core values

We change lives

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.

We set audacious goals

We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.

We value all perspectives

When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.

We simplify financial services

We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.

  • Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.

What happens next

We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.

In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. title: Outreach Program Manager
description:
Job Title: Outreach Program Manager

Department: Outreach

Reports To: Senior Director of Community Wellness

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Employment Type: 40 hours weekly

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 9:00 am to 5:00 pm

Pay Range: $28.00 - 39.00 hourly

Location: Onsite

This position will close for review on November 30, 2026.

Overview:

Share provides a wide range of services including street outreach, hunger response, emergency shelter, housing, and asset building to help people experiencing poverty, hunger, and homelessness move toward stability, housing, and self-sufficiency.

Our employees are at the heart of this work. Every role contributes essential skills, knowledge, and expertise to our mission and makes a meaningful difference in the lives of the people we serve. At Share, we value the unique strengths and potential each person brings, and we are committed to a workplace grounded in collaboration, inclusivity, growth, and opportunity.

If you are looking for meaningful work where your skills can make a real difference, we invite you to join our mission-driven team. Share offers a generous benefits package, including four weeks of PTO, a wellness program, a 401(k) with employer match, and health, dental, and life insurance.

DEI Statement:

Share wants to be part of a community that brings about change. We are committed to actively working to dismantle racist systems, focusing on sustainable solutions to structural racism, police violence, and inequitable economic, health care, and education systems. It requires all institutions, including ours, to ask what more we can and should do to live our commitments to diversity, equity, and inclusion – and we must be brave enough to make changes.

EEO Statement:

We value and are actively seeking to create a diverse work environment because teams are stronger with different perspectives and experiences. We encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, older members of society, and others from minority groups and diverse backgrounds to apply.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sex, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of Share are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.


Job Summary:

The Outreach Program Manager provides field-based leadership and operational support to outreach teams. The Program Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management, coordination, and oversight of Share’s outreach and injury prevention programs, which are supported through three distinct grants with separate program requirements, deliverables, and reporting expectations.

Essential Functions:

Supervision and Staff Engagement – 50%

  • Provide supervision of the Outreach Team including task assignments, meeting facilitation, coaching, and documenting as needed or required.
  • Model trauma-informed engagement and maintain strong professional boundaries with participants.
  • Provide on-site leadership and peer support to Outreach Care Coordinators, interns, and volunteers.
  • Address performance concerns, workplace conflicts, attendance issues, and other staff-related concerns in coordination with the Senior Director of Community Wellness and Director of People and Culture as appropriate.
  • Complete employee performance evaluations and participate in goal setting and professional development planning.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, orientation, training, and ongoing development of outreach staff.
  • Ensure staff understand and consistently follow program expectations, agency policies, safety procedures, and professional boundaries.
  • Oversee contract deliverables and monitor progress toward funder requirements and performance expectations in collaboration with the Senior Director.
  • Manage contract deliverables ensuring that we are meeting the requirements and performance expectations of program funders.
  • Monitor progress toward grant deliverables, identify gaps in performance, and implement corrective actions when needed.
  • Meeting with program funders, community partners, and establishing new relationships with potential funders in collaboration with the Senior Director of Community Wellness.
  • Prepare and provide regular program updates, performance information, and recommendations to the Senior Director of Community Wellness.
  • Participate in planning and implementation of program goals, work plans, and performance objectives for assigned contracts.
  • Provide leadership and decision-making support for the Community Wellness Department in the absence of the Senior Director of Community Wellness, as assigned.

Field Supervision – 25%

  • Coordinate daily outreach operations and ensure teams are equipped and deployed effectively.
  • Support crisis response and de-escalation in the field when needed.
  • Ensure all field activities reflect the mission and values of Share’s program.
  • Adjust program operations and field response in accordance with severe weather guidelines, safety considerations, and changing community needs.
  • Observe staff performance in the field and provide real-time coaching, guidance, and support.
  • Ensure field activities are conducted safely and in accordance with established protocols, program expectations, and applicable contractual requirements.
  • Support staff in responding to complex participant needs, community concerns, and situations requiring additional leadership or intervention.

Administrative Support – 25%

  • Use Share’s equity lens as new policies are developed and implemented.
  • Ensure adherence to protocols including field safety, injury prevention programming, safety protocols, programmatic workflows, and program spending processes.
  • Assist the Senior Director of Community Wellness with development, implementation, and revision of program policies, procedures, workflows, and quality improvement processes.
  • Assist in managing supplies, tracking distribution, and maintaining accurate field logs.
  • Promote collaboration and problem-solving with community members, local businesses, and external partners including public health and law enforcement.
  • Review program documentation and data for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with funder requirements in collaboration with the Senior Director.
  • Coordinate required reporting and ensure program data is submitted accurately and within established timelines.
  • Identify operational barriers and develop or recommend changes to improve program efficiency, service delivery, and participant outcomes.

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s degree in public health, social work, healthcare, human services, behavioral health, or a related field, with at least three (3) years of relevant professional experience; OR five (5) years of relevant professional experience in a related field.
  • Previous experience supervising, leading, or managing staff.
  • Experience managing programs with multiple contracts, grants, funding sources, or program deliverables.
  • Knowledge of Housing First philosophy, injury prevention, trauma-informed care, and the challenges faced by individuals experiencing homelessness.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage diverse populations, individuals with persistent mental illness, substance use disorders, homelessness, and complex health and social needs.
  • Ability to provide crisis intervention, constructive feedback, and appropriate accountability while maintaining supportive relationships with staff and clients.
  • Ability to review documentation for accuracy, quality, and compliance.
  • Awareness of and respect for cultural differences and health disparities.
  • Basic computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or Google Workspace.
  • Valid driver’s license when necessary to fulfill program responsibilities.

Preferred Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Master’s degree in public health, social work, healthcare, human services, behavioral health, or related field preferred.
  • Experience with Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) systems, data entry, and documentation.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and confidentiality practices.
  • Experience developing or implementing program policies, procedures, and workflows.
  • Experience working with public health agencies, local government, or community-based organizations.
  • Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use disorders, behavioral health needs, or complex health and social needs.
  • Bilingual proficiency

What we offer:

  • Mission driven work, focused on success for those we serve as well as the success of our staff.
  • Kaiser Medical & Vision plans, Guardian Dental, Life Insurance and Employee Assistance Program, WEX FSA and HRA, Wellness Plan worth up to $900 per year, and a 401 K plan with a 4% match.
  • Opportunities for personal advancement, robust trainings, and a People & Culture Newsletter to keep you informed.
  • We also support several employee-led committees focused on building connections, fostering inclusion, and strengthening our workplace culture in support of Share’s mission.


Potential new hires will require a background check, which could include:

  • Valid Driver’s License/ Motor Vehicle record
  • Criminal Background History
  • Sex Offender Registry
  • OFCCP Registry
  • Drug Testing

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact Becky West @ rwest@sharevancouver.org

title: Digital Analyst, iCasino
description:
Veikkaus is a gaming company for everyone, striving to be better in every aspect. Our passion is to drive better gaming so that our customers can enjoy every moment. Caring, teamwork, and courage are the values that guide everything we do. Responsibility is a core of our operations. Our goal is to be a respected and successful international money gaming group that continuously improves while always putting both customers and employees first. For a better game — and working life.

The future of gaming in Finland is changing – and we’re recruiting. In 2027, the Finnish license market will open, bringing a new era for iGaming. At Veikkaus, we’re preparing for this transformation - and we’re looking for passionate professionals to join us on this exciting journey.

We’re strengthening our Betting and iCasino teams with true iGaming experts: people with international experience, a hunger for success, and a persistent drive to win. If you’re ready to help shape the future of responsible, competitive money gaming, now is the time to join us.

Digital Analyst

We’re looking for a Digital Analyst, iCasino to join our Digital Channels Analytics & Insight team and contribute to elevating customer engagement across our digital web and app channels. You’ll agree analytics priorities and requirements with iCasino Business Product Owner and the business team, coordinating with central data and technology teams on tracking implementation and data quality. You’ll maintain and develop web and app analytics, deliver reporting, and help translating customer behavior and digital performance data into actionable insights. Working closely with product, design, and CX teams, you’ll measure engagement, conversion, and the performance of iCasino products and features.

The position is located at Veikkaus’ headquarters in Pohjois-Haaga, Helsinki. We work flexibly in a hybrid model with three on-site days per week. This position can also be located in Malta or Stockholm, Sweden.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Business Product Owners to gather and document digital analytics and tracking priorities and requirements.
  • Deliver timely, accurate, and relevant reporting and insights that support business decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Communicate tracking requirements to central data and technology teams for implementation, and validate tracking accuracy and data quality across digital journeys.
  • Monitor engagement, usage, and retention across web and app channels, analyzing user actions, clickstream data, and behavioral patterns.
  • Analyze digital funnels, conversion paths, and customer journeys to identify abandonment, drop-off points, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Measure the performance of iCasino products and features, helping product and design teams assess success and prioritize improvements.
  • Track search engines visibility and landing page performance to identify opportunities to improve digital discovery and conversion.
  • Analyze A/B test results and assess the impact of experiments, new features, and releases.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and CX teams to analyze success metrics and customer feedback and support tracking best practices.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 3+ years of international experience in a similar digital analytics role.
  • Hands-on experience in digital analytics across mobile and desktop web as well as native app channels.
  • Practical experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Power BI; experience with other digital analytics tools is an advantage.
  • Experience coordinating analytics work and tracking requirements with business, data, and technology teams.
  • Ability to analyze customer journeys, funnels, engagement, feature performance, and experimentation results, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong reporting and communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to different stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver against agreed priorities.
  • Experience collaborating with CX, UX, and design teams is an advantage.
  • Experience in the iGaming industry is highly valued

We offer you

  • A workplace where the game evolves – and so do you. You’ll face meaningful challenges and gain new skills while contributing to shared success – in Finland and beyond. We value curiosity and create the space for it to thrive.
  • Inspiring and supportive teammates you can rely on. The best ideas and world-class entertainment are built together – and Veikkaus thrives because of its people.
  • Balanced and inspiring work life. At Veikkaus, we believe a good job adds something to life – but isn’t all there is to it.
  • Excellent employee benefits. You can read more about us and our benefits from here.

It is important to us that everyone can come to work as their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, skills, and perspectives, and believe that success comes from working in diverse teams. We encourage individuals from various backgrounds to apply for our jobs.

Our headquarters are located in Helsinki, Finland but the position can be located in any Veikkaus location. We work flexibly in a hybrid model.

Interested? Awesome! Please send your application with CV and salary request no later than 9.12.2026. We are excited to hear from you!

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to reach out to Fatemeh Daneshzadeh, VP of Digital Channels at firstname.lastname@veikkaus.fi.

The Opportunity:

Critical decisions are made every day in our government. What if you could use your technical skills to help them make informed decisions? As a Foreign Instrumentation Signals Intelligence (FISINT) Analyst, you will be responsible for examining emissions, signals, and electronic data to identify and assess electronic capabilities. You will use advanced signal processing tools and techniques to collect, interpret, and analyze data, providing critical insights into potential threats and strategic developments.


You will conduct thorough analyses of signal data, preparing detailed reports and briefings that communicate your findings and recommendations to key stakeholders. You will work closely with other intelligence professionals, military personnel, and government agencies to share information and support joint intelligence operations. Staying abreast of advancements in electronic systems and signal processing technologies, you will contribute to the development of new analytical tools and methodologies to enhance our capabilities.


This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills, and share your insights with other technical specialists. You can interact with collection managers, collection operators, and analysts on new analytic methods, technologies, and collection strategies, and collaborate with national and tactical collection and operations elements to advance target development efforts, recommend collection strategies, and support strategic and operational requirements. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of the intelligence community (IC).


Join us. The world can’t wait.

title: Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer
description:
Description

​​Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?


​At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

​

​Your greatest work is ahead!

​

​Leidos’ Defense Systems Electrical Systems department is seeking a talented Embedded Firmware Developer to join our team. The Electrical Systems Department is a design-focused group of engineers specializing in advanced hardware-based products. The individual selected for this position will be an embedded design engineer with varied technical interests and demonstrated engineering and leadership skills. The individual must be a self- starter with experience working with inter-disciplinary teams to solve challenging technical problems. The engineer will lead efforts on and develop architectures for embedded systems integrated into a diverse range of aerospace and military systems including manned/unmanned ground/air vehicles, missiles, defensive radars, and space systems.


​The selected candidate will be a key technical leader in a fast-paced, environment through all phases of the product life cycle from concept development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support. The candidate will be responsible for architecting, implementing, and testing embedded firmware and software on a variety of platforms, including FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs. Additional skills such as communications data-link design, digital-signal processing (DSP) design, system design, experience with technical trade studies, and evaluation of technology improvements are a plus.


​With a product focus, the individual is also expected to actively partner with other engineers, project managers, technicians, and the customer to develop solutions that adhere to a diverse set of requirements. This includes architecture decisions from requirements that help inform and drive hardware implementations and working closely with hardware engineers. Additionally, the engineer will support resolution of technical issues that are discovered during the manufacture and test of deliverable products. This will include troubleshooting board-level issues, assessing failures for root cause, and identifying corrective actions. The ideal candidate will thrive in a learning environment that encourages leadership and technical growth.

​

​If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

​

​Leidos Defense Systems Sector provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

​

​Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!

​

​Primary Responsibilities

  • ​Key technical leader in a fast-paced, environment.
  • ​Responsible for all phases of the product life cycle from concept development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support.
  • ​Responsible for architecting, implementing, and testing embedded firmware and software on a variety of platforms, including FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs.
  • ​Additional skills such as communications data-link design, digital-signal processing (DSP) design, system design, experience with technical trade studies, and evaluation of technology improvements are a plus.
  • ​Support resolution of technical issues that are discovered during the manufacture and test of deliverable products.
  • ​Troubleshooting board-level issues, assessing failures for root cause, and identifying corrective actions.

​Basic Qualifications

  • ​Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • ​Candidate must have at least 4+ years of experience in embedded system design and test or 2+ years with MS degree.
  • ​Understand trade-offs of embedded system targets (such as FPGA, SoC, microcontroller, RTOS, bare-metal) for developing best cost/option architectures
  • ​Proven experience with embedded software/firmware programming in languages such as C, C++, or assembly languages
  • ​Experience with common communication protocols such as: UART, Ethernet, SPI, I2C, CAN bus, etc.
  • ​Hands-on laboratory experience with instrumentation, test equipment, and debug/test methods
  • ​Position requires candidates to be capable of performing in a collaborative engineering environment working closely with multi-disciplinary teams
  • ​Candidate must be a resident of the North Alabama area or willing to relocate to the Huntsville - North Alabama, AL area
  • ​Candidate must be a US Citizen and possess (and be able to maintain) a Final Secret Clearance or meet the eligibility to obtain (and maintain) a Secret Clearance.

​Preferred Qualifications

  • ​Developing overall firmware/software architecture for embedded systems
  • ​Embedded operating systems (Linux, VxWorks, Integrity, FreeRTOS, uC/OS-II)
  • ​GNU/Linux and development of kernel drivers
  • ​Experience with hardware description languages such as VHDL, Verilog, or SystemVerilog.
  • ​Utilizing modern Xilinx FPGA and SoC families and design tools (Xilinx IP Cores, AXI4, AXI-Stream)
  • ​Software or FPGA test and verification experience (unit testing, FPGA simulation testbenching, HWIL)
  • ​RISC microprocessors architectures (ARM Cortex, Microblaze, PowerPC, RISC-V)
  • ​Memory architectures, types, and caching
  • ​Experience with high speed interfaces (PCIe, Aurora, 100GbE, JESD204B)
  • ​Electronics and PCBA design

title: Senior Manager, Commercialization Contract Operations
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Senior Manager, Commercialization Contract Operations is a member of the Commercialization Contract Operations team within Commercialization Effectiveness & Operations (CE&O), supporting U.S. Commercial, Global Medical Affairs, and Global Commercial teams. The role partners with business owners, Legal, Finance, Procurement, as well as other cross-functional partners to enable timely, consistent contracting operations in support of business priorities.

The Senior Manager independently manages a complex portfolio of contracting requests and leads designated operational workstreams and cross-functional improvements. The role exercises judgment in resolving ambiguous operational issues, aligns stakeholders on priorities and solutions, and provides recommendations to team leadership to strengthen contracting effectiveness and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a complex portfolio of SOWs, CDAs, and MSAs through intake, review, approvals, signature routing, and PO follow-through, coordinating interdependent requirements across business owners and functional partners.

  • Ensure assigned requests follow established contracting policies and approval requirements; coordinate resolution of complex operational exceptions with the appropriate Legal, Compliance, Finance, or Procurement partner.

  • Develop and apply contracting prioritization approaches with team leadership and functional partners; recommend tradeoffs and escalate unresolved capacity, timing, or approval constraints.

  • Oversee lifecycle coordination for assigned contracts, including renewals, amendments, and terminations; anticipate dependencies and initiate timely action with business owners.

  • Serve as an operational escalation resource for complex contracting and payment inquiries within assigned scope; align stakeholders on solutions and present recommendations to leadership when decisions exceed delegated authority.

  • Maintain accurate contract records and operational trackers; identify recurring bottlenecks and use available operational data to recommend improvements and inform planning.

  • Lead defined cross-functional improvements to contracting workflows and systems, including assessing issues, recommending solutions, coordinating implementation, and evaluating adoption and results.

  • Develop and improve process guidance and training materials; guide business owners and mentor colleagues on complex operational issues and effective contracting practices.

  • Partner with cross-functional operations colleagues on evolving business needs, including designated ex-U.S. contracting workflows, and recommend practical adaptations within established policies.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • BS/BA degree in a related discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience in contract operations, procurement, purchasing, vendor management or a related operational role in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex contracting workflows, resolve ambiguous operational issues, and exercise sound judgment on escalation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Proven experience leading cross-functional process or system improvements from issue identification through implementation and adoption.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence business partners and management without direct authority, communicate recommendations, and gain alignment on competing priorities.

  • Proven ability to build effective partnerships with business owners and colleagues in Legal, Finance, and Procurement in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage concurrent requests and communicate priorities, dependencies, and timelines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and a commitment to collaboration, integrity, and RevMed’s corporate values.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams, with experience using contract management systems and operational tracking tools such as Smartsheet.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting Commercial or Medical Affairs contracting during launch preparation or organizational growth.

  • Experience improving contract-to-PO workflows, vendor management approaches, implementing contract lifecycle systems, or developing operational guidance and training.

  • Experience mentoring colleagues and sharing expertise on complex operational processes.

  • You will assist in the full spectrum of actions required to award contracts and contract modifications to other Contractors that may include pre-award documentation, assistance in support of source selection activities, and post-award support requirements.

You will assist in pre-acquisition and acquisition strategy planning and implementation.
  • You will assist in the review and analysis of prime and sub-contractor earned value management systems.
  • You will assist in developing and analyzing key program metrics.
  • You will assist in developing and integrating risk management plans and strategies and supporting program briefings.

In this freelance role, you will act as the primary linguistic quality expert and key contact for client stakeholders on quality matters, arbitration, and escalations. You will guide the reviewer community, translate client expectations into practical standards, and strengthen alignment across UI, marketing, product, legal, informational, and support content. Through coaching, quality analysis, and structured reporting, you will help improve review performance and reduce recurring errors. Working with international teams, you will contribute to continuous improvement and maintain a reliable, evidence-based approach to localization quality. Accountabilities

  • Build and maintain an effective working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, tracking expectations and helping reduce quality discrepancies over time.

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), senior language lead positions, or quality governance roles.
  • Proven experience managing client and stakeholder relationships, ideally as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers.
  • Hands-on experience managing formal arbitration and escalation processes, facilitating discussions, and resolving linguistic disagreements.
  • Strong practical knowledge of localization quality evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping.
  • Ability to analyze style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and understand differing quality requirements across content types such as marketing, legal, and UI.
  • Experience facilitating one-to-one coaching, reviewer shadowing, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to track error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and translate findings into actionable improvements.
  • Native-level Belarusian proficiency and professional-level English.
  • Excellent communication, organization, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to mission‑critical federal programs and build a rewarding technical career. The Asset Manager will own the full lifecycle of hardware, software and other IT assets across the NASA JPL enterprise level program ensuring accurate inventory, financial transparency, and IT compliance in 24x7 operations environment.


As an Asset Manager supporting this opportunity, you will be responsible for the asset management cycle, security, and optimal use of IT hardware, software, and services within the NASA enterprise level program, ensuring compliance, cost efficiency, and operational readiness. You will help shape GDIT’s NASA JPL account by aligning customer priorities, driving innovation, and ensuring technical solutions meet NASA’s mission, enterprise, and security requirements. The successful candidate will be a seasoned Asset Manager with prior experience supporting NASA JPL or similar federal environments. Exceptional communication skills are essential to convey technical concepts to both engineers and non‑technical stakeholders.

Ensure assets are properly tracked, secure, compliant, cost-effective, and available for use. You must be able to build trusted relationships with internal and customer stakeholders.


Responsibilities Include:


Track Full Asset Lifecycle

• Manage asset procurement → deployment → assignment → maintenance → transfer → disposal.

• Maintain accurate inventory of all IT assets.

• Monitor hardware refresh cycles and recommend replacement schedules.

• Ensure proper disposal, recycling, and data destruction of retired equipment.

• Develop, lead and enforce asset management policies and procedures.

• Use IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Configuration Management Database (CMDB) tools to maintain asset records.


Technical Quality, Compliance, and Oversight

• Ensure all equipment and software comply with NASA, NIST, federal IT, and cybersecurity standards.

• Support audits and ensure compliance with company policies and software licensing requirements.


Operational Support

• Coordinate with IT operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to ensure assets are available and functional.

• Prepare reports on asset inventory, costs, utilization, compliance, and lifecycle status.


Cost & Resource Optimization – Reducing waste, controlling costs, and aligning IT resources with program demands

• Help reduce unnecessary IT spending by identifying unused, duplicate, or underutilized assets.

• Establish controls to protect company technology from loss, theft, or unauthorized use.


Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration

• Engage with the NASA customer, program partners, internal, and external teams to understand requirements, constraints, and program objectives.

• Build trust by consistently delivering thoughtful, scalable, and high‑quality architectural recommendations.


Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of five (5) years of experience in IT asset management, IT operations or related experience.

• Demonstrated knowledge of ServiceNow.

• Knowledge of hardware, software licensing, procurement, and IT inventory processes.

title: Credit Research Analyst
description:
Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

The ideal candidate will be able to generate actionable investment research for the EFGAM Fixed Income Team and contribute directly to our fixed income strategies across investment grade and high yield.

In this role, you will work independently to develop investment ideas, lead research in assigned market sectors, and translate your analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for Fund Managers. You will apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills within a fixed income portfolio context, considering portfolio construction, market dynamics, constraints and risk sizing.

You will also support portfolio implementation and analysis, providing operational support to Lead Fund Managers, and play an active part in achieving the team’s short- and medium-term objectives through research, reporting, process improvement and collaboration across Investment teams, Operations, Middle Office, Risk, Compliance and Technology.

Main Responsibilities

Credit Analysis

  • Work independently to identify investment opportunities and recommend portfolio sizing based on bottom-up fundamental credit analysis, across both High Yield and Investment Grade issuers.
  • Lead sector-level idea generation and research for your assigned sectors.
  • Assess business risk, financial risk, capital structure, liquidity, covenant protection, event risk, ESG-related credit considerations and downside scenarios.
  • Evaluate relative value across issuers, instruments, maturities, currencies and capital structures, incorporating market technicals and portfolio constraints.
  • Prepare concise, decision-useful credit notes, issuer updates and monitoring alerts, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions, risks and investment judgement.
  • Maintain research coverage, financial models and watchlists, and promptly escalate material deterioration, rating actions, controversies or changes to the investment thesis.
  • Contribute actively to investment discussions and present research conclusions to portfolio managers and relevant internal forums.

Portfolio Operations & Risk

  • Provide portfolio recommendations to Fund Managers to support cash and risk-based portfolio rebalancing.
  • Prepare investment reporting, including commentaries, performance attribution and research-coverage statistics.
  • Apply the Risk Management Framework, policies, standards and procedures, including the Three Lines of Defence Standard, and promptly report incidents, breaches, control weaknesses or elevated risks.
  • Monitor and manage market, counterparty, operational, conduct, regulatory, reputational and strategic risks relevant to the role.

Skills and experience

  • Strong credit-analysis capability, including financial statement analysis, bond mathematics, cash-flow and leverage assessment, scenario analysis and relative-value evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of fixed income markets, macro drivers, risk and the operational aspects of portfolio implementation.
  • Working knowledge of UK regulatory requirements relevant to the role, including FCA Conduct Rules, Best Execution, Market Abuse Regulation, conflicts of interest and record keeping.
  • Ability to work independently on well-defined activities and smaller projects, using judgement to adapt processes and escalating complex or novel issues appropriately.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to adapt style for portfolio managers, control functions, operations, technology teams and external counterparties.
  • High attention to detail and composure under time pressure; disciplined prioritisation and reliable delivery to deadlines.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Preferred: degree in finance, economics, accounting, mathematics, engineering or another quantitative discipline.

Professional Certification

  • IMC or an equivalent qualification meeting applicable FCA requirements, or the ability to obtain the required qualification within an agreed period.
  • CFA or progress towards CFA is advantageous and preferred.

Professional Experience

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in credit research or fixed income portfolio management.
  • Fixed income, credit markets and derivatives; trade lifecycle and settlement; fundamental credit analysis; performance attribution; risk and control frameworks.
  • Experience with Bloomberg, order and portfolio management systems, and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Power BI and Python knowledge is advantageous.

Languages

  • English fluent.
  • Additional languages are an advantage.

Our Values

  • Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.
  • Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence.
  • Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.
  • Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

    • Experience in payment integrity, claims auditing, hospital billing, focused claim review, DRG review, overpayment recovery, utilization management, or vendor-supported audit programs.
    • Experience coordinating audit inventories, vendor and internal-team follow-up, case status, financial reconciliation, and recovery or avoidance reporting.
    • Experience working with healthcare vendors and cross-functional teams such as Claims, Provider Relations, Contracting, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Clinical Review, and Customer Service.
  • Licensure/ Registration/ Certification:

    • None

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
    • Knowledge of HealthPartners products, claims systems, provider contracts, reimbursement methodologies, and operational workflows, including how these affect audit handling, claim adjustment coordination, and financial outcomes.
    • Familiarity with hospital billing, itemized bills, medical records, claim edits, coding concepts, DRG reimbursement, and post-payment audit processes, sufficient to understand audit findings, identify needed supporting information, and route questions to the appropriate subject matter experts.
    • Knowledge of audit-related claim adjustment and overpayment recovery workflows, including vendor-managed provider responses, disputed findings, internal-team follow-up, and the information needed to reconcile cases through closure; ability to use this knowledge to recognize recurring missing documentation, delayed handoffs, unresolved adjustments, or reporting discrepancies and recommend practical process improvements.

    • Advanced spreadsheet skills and familiarity with case management, workflow tracking, data visualization, or reporting tools to compare vendor and internal data, identify discrepancies, and prepare operational and financial summaries for leadership and vendor reviews, including audit inventory, volume, aging, turnaround times, savings, recoveries, fees, and outstanding issues requiring follow-up.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

(35%) Audit Workflow Coordination

  • Coordinate day-to-day operations for hospital bill audit, focused claim review, inpatient DRG audit, and future Payment Integrity audit programs, keeping cases moving from intake through final reconciliation and closure.

    • Submit audits and related claim information to external audit vendors for review.
    • Track each case’s current status, outstanding requirements, the vendor or internal team responsible for the next action, and next steps; maintain accurate documentation of decisions, key dates, follow-up activities, and case-level financial outcomes in designated tracking or workflow systems.
    • Monitor audit inventories, aging cases, turnaround times, and deadlines. Follow up with vendors and internal teams to address outstanding items, resolve delays, and escalate barriers requiring leadership involvement.
    • Coordinate audit-related claim adjustment requests with Claims and other appropriate internal teams, provide supporting audit documentation, monitor processing status, follow up on outstanding requests, and confirm completion before final reconciliation and case closure.
    • Maintain operational checkpoints to confirm that intake requirements, assigned actions, and handoffs are completed for each audit case.

(25%) Claims Research, Documentation & Analysis

  • Research claim details, payment history, and adjustment activity in internal systems to answer audit-related questions and provide needed claim information to vendors and internal teams.

    • Review audit submissions and vendor findings for complete and consistent claim information and supporting audit documentation, identifying missing information or discrepancies that need clarification before internal follow-up.
    • Reconcile individual audit cases by comparing vendor audit findings with completed claim adjustments and recovery information, identifying differences, researching their cause, and coordinating resolution with the vendor or appropriate internal team.
    • Identify recurring issues in claim information, audit documentation, or adjustment activity and summarize findings for Payment Integrity leadership to support resolution and process improvements.
    • Maintain complete and accurate supporting audit records and protect confidential information in accordance with organizational requirements.

(20%) Vendor & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational contact for external audit vendors, maintaining effective working relationships through clear, timely communication, collaborative problem-solving, and consistent follow-through.

    • Coordinate communication between audit vendors and Claims, Provider Relations, Contracting, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Clinical Review, Customer Service, and other internal teams as needed; clarify requests and next steps, provide needed information, and route audit-related questions and operational issues to the appropriate team for resolution.
    • Prepare case updates, outstanding issues, and supporting materials for vendor meetings, operational reviews, and quarterly business reviews; participate in discussions and document decisions and follow-up actions.
    • Track vendor requests, agreed-upon deliverables, commitments, and unresolved issues, follow up on completion, and escalate significant delays, recurring concerns, or decisions requiring Payment Integrity leadership.
    • Communicate workflow changes, processing updates, and internal decisions to vendors and affected internal teams, ensuring they understand how the changes affect audit activity while maintaining confidentiality.

(10%) Financial Tracking, Reporting & Controls

  • Track and validate audit savings, recoveries, cost avoidance, and vendor fees using approved definitions and reporting methods, ensuring reported amounts are supported by audit and claim information.
    • Reconcile consolidated program-level vendor financial reports with internal claim adjustment and recovery information, identify missing or inconsistent amounts, and coordinate resolution with vendors and appropriate internal teams.
    • Maintain dashboards and recurring consolidated operational and financial reports, and prepare accurate, current summaries of audit volume, aging, turnaround times, savings, recoveries, vendor fees, trends, and unresolved discrepancies for Payment Integrity leadership and vendor reviews.
    • Prepare and validate group-level audit reports and supporting documentation for SI business, and submit the required information to the SIBS area for rate application and group billing in accordance with established procedures.
    • Prepare and provide group-specific audit reports to Sales, ensuring reported results are accurate, complete, and appropriate for the group.
    • Perform reporting quality checks to identify duplicate entries, missing information, incorrect amounts, and unsupported results, and document corrections or outstanding issues before reporting is finalized.

(10%) Training, Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, job aids, process maps, templates, and audit program documentation that clearly describe audit steps, intake requirements, responsibilities, handoffs, required information, and follow-up expectations.

    • Provide process guidance and support training for internal teams and audit vendors when audit workflows, systems, or procedures are introduced or changed.
    • Recommend practical improvements to audit workflows, tracking tools, reporting, and communication based on recurring issues and day-to-day experience, and support implementation of changes approved by Payment Integrity leadership.
    • Participate in projects to implement new audit programs or improve existing programs, including documenting processes, coordinating operational setup, and tracking assigned implementation tasks.
    • Perform other duties as assigned by the leader.

description:

The Senior Techno-functional Engineer works within the HR IT function and will own the design, build, test and deploy of Compensation solutions within our Human Capital Management system (Oracle HCM), plus either Recruiting or Absence Management modules, with the final assignment made based on prior candidate experience. This also includes the annual cycles that run through these modules. The Senior Technical Engineer also enables AI and Visual Builder Studio (VBS) delivery for these modules. Description

The Transportation Solution Division within the Leidos Homeland group is seeking Systems Integration and Test Engineer who will be a member of a dynamic team working on one of several Air Traffic Management programs including


En-Route Automation Modernization (ERAM), the heart of the Next Generation Air Transportation System and the pulse of the National Airspace System, providing the foundation for NexGen functions


Time-Based Flow Management (TBFM), is a system used in air traffic control to manage the flow of aircraft into congested airspace by assigning a specific time for each aircraft to reach a certain point. It shifts the focus from managing separation distance to managing arrival times, allowing controllers to optimize the flow of traffic, reduce delays, and decrease fuel consumption.


Primary Responsibilities:

We're seeking a Systems Integration and Test Engineer to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate to apply their skills in a real-world setting, as you'll be responsible for testing key components of our air traffic control system. This role involves performing regression tests and developing Red Hat scripts to automate and streamline processes. The ideal candidate will have recently earned a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field and possess a strong understanding of software development life cycles and testing methodologies. Proficiency in Red Hat/Linux environments and scripting is essential, as are strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Knowledge of cloud computing, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), or digital engineering would be a significant plus. Tasks will include assistance with system architecture, system concept development, requirements engineering, operational and decision analysis, systems definition, system risk management, and requirements baseline management. Tasks will also include the development of scripts and test automation tools.

title: Learning Experience Designer
description:
Position Summary

The Learning Experience Designer designs, develops, implements, and evaluates engaging learning experiences that build employee capability and improve performance across LAGOS. This role manages the end-to-end learning design and development lifecycle, including needs analysis, learning strategy, curriculum and experience design, content development, stakeholder review, testing, deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

The position creates instructor-led, virtual, blended, and self-paced learning experiences supporting onboarding, product education, sales enablement, leadership development, compliance, and functional capability building. The Learning Experience Designer also supports the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring employees have access to learning experiences that are intuitive, accurate, accessible, engaging, scalable, and aligned with organizational priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Learning Experience Design & Development

  • Conduct learning needs analyses and performance-gap assessments to identify learner needs, desired behaviors, business outcomes, and appropriate learning solutions.
  • Define learning objectives, learner journeys, instructional strategies, delivery methods, assessment approaches, and measures of success.
  • Apply ADDIE, adult learning principles, backward design, scenario-based learning, and performance-based design to create effective, learner-centered experiences.
  • Design curricula, course maps, learning paths, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, and structured learning experiences.
  • Develop eLearning modules, facilitator guides, participant materials, presentations, videos, simulations, scenarios, assessments, job aids, and microlearning.
  • Translate product information, policies, procedures, systems, and business processes into clear, practical, visually engaging learning experiences.
  • Use tools such as Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, Microsoft 365, Canva, and video-editing applications to create digital learning experiences.
  • Incorporate realistic examples, customer scenarios, demonstrations, practice activities, reflection, and knowledge checks that reinforce application on the job.
  • Apply accessibility, inclusive-design, brand, usability, and visual-quality standards across learning experiences.

Stakeholder Partnership & Project Management

  • Partner with subject matter experts and business leaders to identify learning requirements, gather and validate content, and design solutions that address performance needs.
  • Guide stakeholders through design and development reviews, including learning strategy, storyboard, prototype, content validation, and launch readiness.
  • Manage multiple learning design projects, including timelines, milestones, dependencies, feedback cycles, scope, version control, and approvals.
  • Pilot new learning experiences with representative learners, facilitators, and stakeholders; analyze feedback and refine solutions before launch.
  • Prepare facilitators to deliver new and revised programs through train-the-trainer sessions, facilitation resources, and implementation support.

Learning Technology & Content Management

  • Configure, test, publish, and maintain courses, curricula, learning paths, certifications, assessments, and assignments within the LMS.
  • Ensure digital learning experiences function effectively across platforms, including course launches, assessment scoring, completion tracking, mobile responsiveness, and reporting.
  • Support learner profiles, permissions, learning groups, and other LMS administration while maintaining data integrity and system reliability.
  • Troubleshoot learner and course-delivery issues and support vendor coordination, system upgrades, integrations, and testing.
  • Maintain an accurate inventory and lifecycle of learning content, including ownership, versions, approval status, review dates, and update cycles.
  • Conduct content reviews and update learning experiences as products, policies, systems, learner needs, and business priorities evolve.

Learning Evaluation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop assessments that measure knowledge, decision-making, skill application, confidence, and readiness to perform.
  • Evaluate learning experiences through assessment results, learner feedback, completion and engagement data, manager input, and relevant performance indicators.
  • Apply evaluation methodologies such as the Kirkpatrick Model to assess learner reaction, knowledge acquisition, behavior change, and business results where measurable.
  • Use learner and performance data to continuously improve content, instructional strategies, delivery methods, assessments, and the overall learning experience.
  • Develop reusable design standards, templates, checklists, and style guides that improve learning quality, consistency, accessibility, and development efficiency.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Priority learning experiences delivered on schedule
  • Learning design and development cycle time
  • Learning experiences passing quality review before launch
  • Learning content reviewed and updated by scheduled dates
  • Assessment performance and knowledge improvement
  • Learner satisfaction, engagement, and relevance scores
  • Manager-reported application of learning
  • Compliance with accessibility and LAGOS brand standards
  • Time to proficiency for priority roles
  • LMS course-launch and tracking accuracy
  • Certification completion and compliance rates

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning Experience Design, Education, Educational Technology, Learning and Development, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Three to five years of experience designing and developing learning experiences, training programs, or organizational learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the end-to-end learning design lifecycle, including analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
  • Portfolio demonstrating eLearning, instructor-led learning, learning paths, assessments, job aids, video, multimedia, or comparable learning experiences.
  • Proficiency with Articulate 360, including Storyline and Rise, or comparable eLearning authoring tools.
  • Working knowledge of ADDIE, adult learning principles, learner-centered design, assessment design, SCORM, accessibility standards, and learning evaluation.
  • Experience administering or supporting an LMS, including content publishing, testing, assignments, tracking, and reporting.
  • Strong writing, editing, visual communication, consultation, project management, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to simplify complex information, manage multiple projects, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience in retail, luxury goods, consumer products, sales enablement, or a multi-channel organization preferred.
  • Instructional design, learning experience design, or learning and development certification, such as an Association for Talent Development credential, preferred.

Success Profile

Success in this role is demonstrated by the consistent delivery of engaging, accessible, and effective learning experiences that enable employees to build capability, apply new skills, and improve performance. Learning solutions are delivered on schedule, meet established quality and brand standards, and provide meaningful opportunities for employees to practice and demonstrate proficiency.

The successful Learning Experience Designer combines strong instructional design expertise with creativity, technology, and an understanding of the learner experience. This individual builds productive partnerships with subject matter experts, translates complex information into intuitive and practical learning, and uses learner and performance data to continuously improve learning across Retail, Wholesale, Ecommerce, Customer Experience, and Corporate Functions.

Equal Employment Opportunities

LAGOS is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, national origin, or citizenship. We are committed to a diverse workforce. We value all employees’ talents and support an environment that is inclusive and respectful.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Jr. Software Engineer - MX
description:
Junior Full Stack Engineer (React, Node.js)Neumo - RemoteAbout Neumo

Neumo builds the software that runs local government: records, tax and licensing, courts, DMV, and payments. We serve communities across the country, and our platform is the shared foundation every Neumo product is built on. Build something here and it ships to dozens of applications and the governments and citizens who depend on them.

About The Role

We're hiring early-career engineers for our Platform team. Platform builds the shared services every Neumo application consumes: reporting, payments, search, authentication, messaging, file handling, and more. Our guiding principle is build once, use everywhere. When three products need the same capability, Platform owns it.

You’ll work across the stack - React on the front end, Node.js services and PostgreSQL behind them. On any given day you might build a component against our design system, add an endpoint to an existing service, write the tests that cover it, or trace a bug back through the stack to find where it actually started.

This is a first or second engineering job, and we’ve written it that way on purpose. You’ll take on well‑scoped pieces of larger features, with a senior engineer close at hand and review on everything you ship. We don’t expect you to arrive knowing our stack or how county government works. We expect you to learn both fast, ask questions early, and own what you’re given.

We move fast, we own what we ship, and we use modern tools (including AI) aggressively to do it.

What You’ll Do
  • Build features across the stack: React components on the front end, Node.js endpoints and the PostgreSQL queries behind them.
  • Write clean code that follows the patterns already in the codebase, and the tests that go with it. Untested code isn’t finished code.
  • Track down and fix defects in the code you’ve written, and pull in help when a problem turns out to run deeper than your change.
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow, and learn to review what they produce as critically as you’d review your own work.
  • Build to our accessibility and responsive standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, using the shared design system rather than rebuilding components from scratch.
  • Take part in design reviews and code reviews. Listen first, then start contributing. Sprint estimates and blockers are yours to raise, early and honestly.
  • Treat security as part of the definition of done, and build an understanding of how SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR shape what we do on sensitive paths.
  • Learn the domain. Our users are clerks, courts, and citizens, and knowing what they’re actually trying to do will make you a better engineer here than any framework will.
What We’re Looking For
  • 0-2 years of professional software development experience. Internships, apprenticeships, boot-camp work, open-source contributions, and a portfolio you can walk us through all count.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, plus HTML and CSS fundamentals.
  • Exposure to a modern front-end framework. React preferred; Angular or Vue.js also fine.
  • Exposure to Node.js or another back-end language, and a grasp of what a RESTful API is and how it gets consumed.
  • Foundational SQL and an understanding of relational data — how tables relate, how a query returns what it returns. We use PostgreSQL.
  • Comfort with Git: branching, pull requests, and resolving the occasional merge conflict.
  • A methodical approach to problems you haven’t seen before, and the judgment to ask for help before a day disappears.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. Much of our team is distributed, so clear async communication matters.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Bonus points for
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Jest.
  • Any exposure to AWS, or to CI/CD pipelines and containers.
  • Experience working with AI-assisted development tools on something real.
  • Anything you’ve built and shipped that people other than you have used.
  • An interest in civic technology, or any experience with how local government actually works.
How We Work

We build reliable, fast, shared software that the whole company depends on. We bias toward action, we own our work end to end, and we hold ourselves to being a model for the rest of the engineering org. We’re remote-first and we work in two-week sprints.

We hire early-career engineers because we intend to grow them. This role sits at Software Engineer 1 in Neumo’s engineering career framework, and what it takes to reach Software Engineer 2 is written down rather than left to guesswork: delivering your work predictably, debugging on your own, giving your peers code review feedback worth having, and understanding how a request travels through our stack from end to end. Your manager will use that framework in your growth conversations from your first month, not your first review.

title: BC Legislative Intern
description:
HOW TO APPLY

Competition: LA262750
