title: Growth Investment & National Impact Lead
description:
Following Nationwide’s acquisition of Virgin Money, we’re building an ambitious, relationship-led Business Bank with the scale and purpose to make a meaningful difference to businesses and communities across the UK.

As Growth, Investment & National Impact Lead, you’ll play a key role within Nationwide's Entrepreneurial Support Team, helping us create better pathways for entrepreneurs to access the funding, support and connections they need to start, grow and scale.

This is a broad and externally facing role spanning investment, funding readiness, accelerators and financial inclusion. You’ll bring together our work with investors, government, industry bodies and strategic partners, turning our ambitions into practical programmes that deliver measurable outcomes for founders.

You’ll also play an important role in Nationwide’s support for the Invest in Women Taskforce, helping to advance its mission and strengthen access to investment and opportunity for female entrepreneurs across the UK.
This is an opportunity to help shape something different.

As we grow our Business Bank, we have the chance to combine Nationwide’s scale, mutual purpose and trusted brand with an ambition to support more businesses and entrepreneurs across the UK.

You’ll be joining at an important point in that journey, with the opportunity to influence how we support founders, build partnerships and direct investment towards areas where it can create meaningful and measurable impact.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to connect investment, entrepreneurship and inclusion, and want to help build an approach with genuine national reach, we’d love to hear from you.

Flexible base location, with some travel to London

What you’ll be doing

You’ll lead the development and delivery of our investment, scale-up and national impact agenda, creating a clear roadmap that connects Nationwide's Entrepreneurial Support Team ambitions with the wider priorities of Business Banking.

You’ll be responsible for:

• Developing investment and funding-readiness pathways that help entrepreneurs navigate debt, equity, grants, accelerators and other sources of finance and support.
• Shaping our approach to scale-up accelerators, including the proposition, partner model, eligibility principles, outcomes and evaluation.
• Identifying opportunities to advance the ambitions of the Invest in Women Taskforce and turning these into credible investment initiatives and programmes.
• Leading relationships with investors, funders, government, industry bodies and strategic partners connected to investment, inclusion and programme delivery.
• Overseeing investment content, data, deployment reporting and agreed projects, working closely with the CEO Office and Company Secretariat on high-quality governance and reporting.
• Championing entrepreneurship inclusion, ensuring accessibility is embedded across our propositions, partnerships and programmes.
• Bringing together performance, risk, partner outcomes and investment recommendations to provide senior leaders with clear insight and support effective decisions.
• Leading and developing a small team while coordinating complex programmes and relationships across Business Banking and the wider Society.

About you

You’ll bring strong experience from the investment, SME finance, entrepreneurship, funding, accelerator or business growth ecosystem, combined with the confidence to operate across complex internal and external stakeholder groups.

You’re likely to have:

• Significant experience in investment, SME finance, funding programmes, accelerators or strategic proposition development.
• A strong understanding of what entrepreneurs and scaling businesses need to access finance, investment and wider growth support.
• Experience working with senior governance, external commitments and complex partnerships.
• The credibility to build strong relationships with investors, government, industry bodies and senior internal stakeholders.
• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to balance founder outcomes, commercial considerations, inclusion, risk and reputation.
• Experience translating strategy into deliverable programmes, with clear measures of success.
• A strong track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and bringing different teams and organisations together around a shared outcome.
• A genuine interest in widening access to entrepreneurship and investment, particularly for founders who have historically faced barriers to funding.

About your rewards

We continually review and evaluate our offering to ensure we have a broad range of market competitive benefits available for our colleagues. When you put a lot in, it’s only fair to expect a lot out. So, when you help us do the right thing for our customers, we want to reward you.

There are all sorts of employee benefits available at Nationwide, including:
• 30 days holiday
• Access to private medical insurance
• A highly competitive pension to help you build a strong foundation for retirement
• Access to an annual performance-related bonus
• Training and development to help you progress your career
• A great selection of additional benefits through our salary sacrifice scheme
• Life assurance to provide peace of mind for you and your loved ones in the event of your death
• Wellhub – access to a range of free and paid options for health and wellness
• Up to 2 days of paid volunteering a year

Banking – but fairer, more rewarding, and for the good of society
We forge our own path at Nationwide.
As a mutual, we’re owned by our members — those customers who bank, save or have a mortgage with us. We challenge the financial sector status quo. We don’t see customers as the engine of profit. We put their needs first. Always.
If you’re inspired by fairer finances, passionate about making a meaningful impact, and truly care about customers, you’re one of us.
At Nationwide, you are challenged to grow and rewarded for doing so. Valued. Recognised. Inspired to be your best.
We are purpose driven. Uncompromisingly customer. Unstoppably Nationwide.

What to do next
To apply, simply click the ‘Apply Now’ button. Please ensure you attach your CV and complete a few short application questions.

The Systems Engineer will work in a matrixed organization, which supports multiple programs at once in a variety of engineering fields with all different team environments. A candidate with experience in other engineering areas such as Test, Model-Based Systems Engineering, Risk Management, and Reliability Analysis will be treated preferentially. Success in this organization often leads to leadership positions in Model-Based Systems Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Systems Engineering Integration and Test (SEIT).

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop, create, and modify computer application software for embedded consumer electronic devices.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, including New Product Introduction (NPI), to support products from prototype through mass production and post-deployment support.
  • Design, develop, test, and validate software across the full product lifecycle, including system architecture, design, implementation, integration, and performance optimization.
  • Design and develop software features and functionality for embedded streaming media devices, including system architecture, implementation, integration testing, and performance optimization.
  • Perform low-level system development activities, including board bring-up, hardware initialization, bootloader development, device driver integration, and hardware-software interface validation.
  • Develop, modify, and maintain Linux kernel components, including device drivers, kernel modules, and system-level functionality.
  • Design and develop multimedia applications and pipelines, including video and audio processing, codec integration, media playback systems, and audio/video synchronization.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in embedded systems; conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to engineering teams.
  • Analyze system performance and stability; identify and implement improvements to enhance system reliability and efficiency.
  • Conduct initial triage of system-level issues and coordinate resolution with appropriate engineering teams.

You are required to have

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in the position, as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, or a related occupation.
  • Must have at least 1 year of prior work experience in the following:
    1. Embedded systems development, including Linux kernel development and programming in C/C++.
    2. Low-level programming including board bring-up, device drivers, bootloaders, and hardware-software integration.
    3. Development of video and audio applications for consumer electronics with industry standards including HDMI.
    4. Software development for resource-constrained environments, including low-power systems, multi-threaded applications, and systems with limited memory and storage.
    5. Development of Networking protocols, including TCP/IP, RTP.
    6. Working in an Agile development environment.

Up to one (1) day per week telecommuting may be permitted.

Qualifications & Experience
* An HNC, HND, or Degree in a relevant engineering discipline (or equivalent qualification).

Other Requirements

* Safety Critical: This position involves the potential use of Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA) and requires passing relevant site medical and face-fit testing.
* Logistics: The ability to independently attend the site is essential. The facility is situated in a rural Northamptonshire setting and is not served by public transport; access to your own vehicle is required.

Our client is looking for the absolute best global talent to join this centre of excellence. To support the right candidate, full visa sponsorship and comprehensive relocation assistance are on offer for professionals transferring from overseas or within the UK

title: CQV Project Manager
description:

The role provides overall leadership of the C&Q delivery, ensuring that project objectives are achieved in accordance with approved scope, budget, schedule, quality standards and client expectations.

title: Senior CMP Module Engineer
description:
onsemi is seeking a Senior CMP Module Engineer at our Hopewell Junction, NY site. The 300mm CMP Module Engineer is responsible for sustaining, improving, and optimizing the performance of Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) equipment in a high-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. This role focuses on maximizing tool availability, reducing equipment-related defects, improving process stability, driving cost reduction initiatives, and supporting continuous improvement activities across the CMP sector.

The engineer partners closely with Process Engineering, Manufacturing, Maintenance Technicians, Facilities, Quality, Planning, and equipment vendors to ensure stable and efficient fab operations while meeting safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives.

Equipment Sustaining & Reliability

  • Own and sustain 300mm CMP equipment performance across assigned toolsets.
  • Drive improvements in: Tool availability, MTBF, MTTR, OEE, PM compliance, Repeat failures
  • Troubleshoot and resolve equipment failures using systematic problem-solving methodologies.
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities for chronic equipment issues.
  • Develop corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate recurring downtime.
  • Monitor tool health indicators and equipment fingerprints.

Preventive & Predictive Maintenance

  • Develop, optimize, and standardize PM procedures. Reduce PM variability and improve maintenance quality. Implement predictive maintenance strategies using equipment trends and SPC data. Define spare parts strategy and critical spare inventory requirements. Support maintenance technician training and certification programs.

Continuous Improvement (CIP)

  • Lead continuous improvement projects focused on:
  • Availability improvement, Cost reduction, Throughput optimization, Defect reduction, Cycle time improvement. Utilize Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. Perform Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and downtime analysis. Identify bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve fab performance.

Technical Troubleshooting

  • Support troubleshooting of: Polish modules, Transfer robots, Slurry delivery systems, Pad conditioning systems, Vacuum systems, Chemical delivery systems, Endpoint systems, PLC and automation interfaces. Work closely with vendors on escalated technical issues and hardware upgrades. Support tool recoveries after major failures, power events, or maintenance activities.

Process & Production Support

  • Partner with Process Engineers to improve process capability and defect performance.
  • Support engineering experiments, qualifications, and tool matching activities.
  • Assist with recipe setup, equipment qualifications, and production ramp activities.
  • Support line yield and excursion investigations related to CMP equipment.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze equipment performance data and generate actionable insights.
  • Track and report sector KPIs, including availability, Utilization, MTBF, MTTR, Cost of ownership, Defectivity, PM completion rates, and present technical updates and improvement plans to leadership.

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all work is performed in compliance with semiconductor safety standards, LOTO procedures, Chemical safety requirements, and environmental regulations
  • Fab contamination control standards. Participate in safety audits and risk assessments

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering

Experience

  • Education: BS degree in Engineering or a technical field. An MS degree is a plus
  • Experience: 5 + years of relevant experience years in semiconductor processing or a similar industry
  • Knowledge of tools such as Applied Materials Reflexion. Ebara CMP platforms, Similar CMP toolsets
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams to achieve goals and metrics
  • Experience with FMEA risk analysis is a plus
  • Intermediate-level data analysis skills, specifically in Excel or JMP, using formulas, pivots, and charts, are required
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint
  • Strong communication skills with experience in presenting technical project details
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented
  • Fluency (written and oral) in English is required

Salary: onsemi is excited to share the base salary range for this position is $101,700 to $172,700 exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. The final pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on geographic location, skills, education, experience, and/or consideration of the internal equity of our current team members. We also offer a competitive benefits package.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

RBI(Retail Business Issue)팀은 리테일 영업 조직과 긴밀하게 협업하며 가격 관련 리스크를 최소화하고 가격 경쟁력 및 비즈니스 성과 향상을 지원하는 조직입니다. 본 포지션은 비즈니스에서 인입되는 가격 관련 이슈를 분석하고 해결하며, 카테고리별 가격 정책의 수립부터 운영 및 개선까지 전반을 담당합니다. 또한 비즈니스 영향도가 높은 이슈에 대한 우선순위를 관리하고, 데이터 기반 분석을 통해 운영상의 문제를 진단하고 프로세스를 고도화하여 보다 안정적인 가격 운영 체계를 구축합니다. 다양한 유관 부서와 협업하며 프로젝트를 주도하고 소규모 조직을 관리하는 역할을 수행합니다. 이를 통해 가격 경쟁력 확보 및 수익성 개선에 기여합니다.

업무 내용

• 리테일 영업 조직(BM) 대상 가격 관련 이슈 접수, 분석 및 해결 프로세스 운영
• 카테고리별 가격 정책 수립, 운영 및 지속적인 개선 과제 추진
• 경쟁사 가격 동향 및 시장 변화 분석을 통한 가격 경쟁력 관리
• 가격 결정 요소와 연관된 비즈니스 이슈 검토 및 대응
• 데이터 분석 기반의 근본 원인 분석(Root Cause Analysis) 및 개선안 도출
• 표준 운영 절차(SOP) 수립 및 운영 프로세스 개선 프로젝트 기획·리딩

자격 요건

• 이커머스, 리테일 또는 운영 조직에서 최소 6년 이상의 유관 경력이 있으신 분
• 운영 프로젝트 리딩 또는 조직/인력 관리 경험을 3년 이상 보유하신 분
• 데이터 기반 문제 해결 및 운영 개선 프로젝트 수행 경험이 있으신 분
• Microsoft Excel 및 Google 스프레드시트를 활용한 데이터 분석 경험이 있으신 분
• 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 업무를 주도적으로 추진한 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

• 팀장 또는 파트장으로서 조직 및 인력 관리 경험을 3년 이상 보유하신 분
• 이커머스 플랫폼 또는 온라인 커머스 환경에서 가격 정책 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• 운영 프로세스 개선 및 운영 효율화 프로젝트를 성공적으로 수행한 경험이 있으신 분
• 영업(BM), 상품기획, 기술 조직 등 Cross-functional Stakeholder Management 경험이 있으신 분
• 데이터 기반의 문제 해결 역량과 높은 오너십을 바탕으로 조직을 이끌어 본 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical is looking for exceptional security-focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state-of-the-art practices such as threat modeling, table-top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others.

These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open source ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Define, implement, and document new security features
  • Lead security-focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country-specific compliance requirements
  • Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
  • Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices

Requirements

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • A track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
  • Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Results-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

Optional Skills

  • Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with the Linux kernel
  • Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
  • Knowledge of low-level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Performance engineering experience

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.

title: Electrical Asset Manager
description:
Summary

We are partnered with a renewable energy investment fund and asset owner with an operational portfolio of Solar, BESS and Onshore Wind assets across Europe.


Due to continued growth, they are looking to hire an Electrically biased Asset Manager to support the technical and commercial management of operational assets, with a strong focus on MV/HV systems, operational performance and stakeholder management.


This is a great opportunity to join a well-established business with an expanding European portfolio, offering exposure to utility-scale renewable projects, a collaborative team environment and strong long-term progression opportunities.


Benefits

  • Competitive Salary + annual bonus.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Exposure to a growing European renewable energy portfolio.
  • Long-term progression opportunities within a growing business.


What you'll be doing:

  • Manage the technical and commercial performance of operational renewable energy assets
  • Provide oversight of MV/HV electrical systems, supporting safe operations, switching procedures and electrical system performance
  • Act as a key point of contact for HV/MV operational matters, supporting best practice across the portfolio
  • Oversee key contracts including O&M agreements, PPAs and asset management services
  • Manage relationships with service providers, grid operators, contractors and other stakeholders
  • Support budgeting, operational expenditure management and performance improvement initiatives
  • Promote high standards of Health, Safety and Environmental compliance across all assets


What you'll bring:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering desirable, or a related Engineering, Science or technical discipline
  • Technical and/or commercial experience within renewable energy, power generation, utilities or other energy infrastructure environments
  • Strong understanding of MV/HV electrical systems and associated operational procedures
  • Previous experience managing, overseeing or coordinating HV/MV operational activities is highly desirable
  • Strong commercial awareness with exposure to operational or service contracts
  • Open to candidates from a more site-based background looking to move into Asset Management

title: SATCOM / Mobile / COMSEC / VHF Systems Engineer - Active Top Secret Required
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a Systems Engineer supporting a world class maintenance program servicing a wide variety of data and voice communications equipment for our prestigious client at the highest levels of the federal government in the heart of our nation’s capital. As a Systems Engineer, you are the foundation of our overall approach to maintenance. You act as the maintenance subject matter expert for our government client and exhibit the exceptional technical and customer service skills to resolve issues as quickly and efficiently as possible. GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career.


At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Systems Engineer, you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Systems Engineer joining our team to bring professionalism and initiative to a fast-paced environment that offers extensive options for training, certification, and career advancement. When we succeed, you succeed and together our best becomes better.


HOW A SYSTEMS ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Provide technical input and guidance to the customer in the planning, configuring and implementation of mobile and fixed communications platforms, with emphasis on safety, reliability, supportability, and long-term sustainment.
  • Deliver system administration, operational support, troubleshooting, and end-user assistance for land mobile radio (LMR), satellite communications (SATCOM), cellular-based routing solutions, and Windows-based terminals in tactical and field environments.
  • Perform routine and emergency maintenance and repair on SATCOM systems, multi-band radio platforms, IP-based voice endpoints, computing devices, and core data network equipment (servers, KVMs, routers, switches, distribution panels) to maintain system availability and mission readiness.
  • Manage inventory records and life-cycle maintenance schedules for communications and IT equipment, supporting accurate asset visibility, planned refresh, and ongoing sustainment of operational systems.
  • Support logistics activities related to the acquisition, storage, relocation, and deployment of communications equipment to ensure timely access to resources required to sustain and expand mission communications capabilities.
  • Handle communications security (COMSEC) keying material in accordance with applicable DOW and unit COMSEC policies and procedures to protect the integrity and confidentiality of secure communications.
  • Provide recommendations on replacements, upgrades, and enhancements to existing communications capabilities to ensure systems remain modern, resilient, and supportable over time.
  • Create and maintain documentation for standard operating procedures, recurring tasks, and system updates, enabling consistent operations and efficient troubleshooting across the supported organization.
  • Develop and deliver training for unit personnel on the proper operation and routine maintenance of secure mobile communications platforms, supporting long-term sustainment of deployed systems.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • Highly knowledgeable on mobile communications systems to include the Iridium satellite constellation, 4G LTE/5G mobile routers, secure mobile cellular devices, and VHF/SHF/UHF radio platforms.
  • Understanding of IP networking fundamentals, VOIP systems architecture, encrypted video teleconferencing (VTC) systems, and the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN).
  • Knowledge of satellite communications technologies to include UHF/Ku/Ka bands, Milstar capabilities, WGS capabilities, TDMA and FDMA network architecture, and procedures for accessing communications assets in the space segment.
  • Knowledge of radio frequency theory, including HF radio propagation, VHF radio capabilities, and radio encryption methods
  • Understanding of site design and equipment integration based on established deployment operating procedures and requirements.
  • Familiar with systems integration procedures to include hardware framing and mounting methods, basic soldering, power tool operation, minor modification of plastic and metal bench stock parts, and cable installation and removal techniques.
  • Knowledge of general principles of electrical circuits, fabricating and splicing of electrical connectors, and testing electronic equipment using digital multimeters.
  • Experience in troubleshooting complex communications problems using specialized testing equipment such as spectrum analyzers, optical time domain reflectometers (OTDR), bit error rate testers, network traffic analyzers, and packet inspection equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Windows 10, Windows administrative tools, and Windows software interoperability.
  • Knowledge of generally accepted standards pertaining to technical writing/documentation associated with operational requirements documents, standard operating procedures, and quick reference guides.
  • Understanding of solutions procurement process to include assessment of alternatives, requirements analysis, budget restrictions, and implementation constraints.

Qualifications:

  • Available for travel within the continental United States for periods of time up to two weeks in support of mission activities.
  • Possesses an active TOP SECRET/SCI clearance and possesses eligibility requirements to access classified information.
  • Must possess excellent written and verbal communications skills with the ability to articulate complex mission information to members of U.S. Government’s leadership.
  • Be capable of establishing and cultivating friendly relationships with partner agency personnel, third party equipment providers, and sibling programs.
  • Must be self-sufficient and capable of maintaining required operational tempo when working autonomously or with minimal supervision.
  • Work location will be in Washington, D.C. and offices in the DMV area. Work hours are flexible, but contract staff must meet minimal requirements on a weekly basis. CONUS travel is at the request of the customer and may not be flexible under some circumstances.

  • Security Clearance Level: Active Top Secret with SCI Eligibility
  • Required Skills and Abilities: Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills

Where discovery never stops. Be part of something bigger.

Roles for every stage of your career.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Research Assistant to join the Clancy laboratory at the Centre for Inflammation Research. Supported by an eight-year Wellcome Trust Career Development Award, our research aims to understand how immune cell signalling is regulated at the molecular level.

As part of our research group, you will contribute to lab-based projects focusing on the structural and functional characterisation of proteins that regulate T cell and macrophage function. Our research combines of structural, molecular, and cell biology techniques, with in vivo models to address fundamental questions in immunology.

You’ll work closely with the Principal Investigator and other lab members to contribute to a long-term research programme. You will contribute to day-to-day research activities of the lab and gain experience in a broad range of experimental techniques.

title: Financial Crime Analytics Consultant – Management Information and Reporting
description:
As part of a major transformation and migration programme, we’re looking for Financial Crime Analytics Consultants to help shape and deliver new reporting capabilities while ensuring our existing Management Information (MI) continues to run smoothly. Sitting within the Financial Crime MI & Reporting function, this role offers a blend of project‑led change and day‑to‑day reporting, giving you the chance to modernise reporting assets, strengthen data quality and controls, and maintain accurate, timely outputs throughout the transition.

You’ll bring sharp attention to detail, strong analytical judgement, and a developing understanding of data governance and control frameworks. Confident working with data in a fast‑moving environment, you’ll support the analysis of complex datasets and translate business needs into clear, meaningful reporting. Collaboration will be central, as you work closely with colleagues across Operations, Governance and the Second Line of Defence, gaining exposure to a wide range of stakeholders and deepening your experience in MI and reporting.

Your analytics expertise will underpin data testing, validation, and quality assurance, helping to build confidence in reporting during the migration. You’ll also play a key role in moving existing Excel‑based MI into Power BI, ensuring continuity of insight while supporting the adoption of modern tools and new ways of working. Strong analytical capability, clear communication, and the ability to stay organised and delivery‑focused in a changing environment will set you up for success in this role.

We are happy to consider flexible working approaches to help you perform at your best.

This is a 12-month Fixed Term Contract.

At Nationwide we offer hybrid working wherever possible. More rewarding relationships are supported through our hybrid approach, bringing colleagues together across our UK wide estate, whilst also supporting generous access to home working. We value our time in the office to solve problems, to learn, and to feel connected.

For this job you'll be located at our nearest regional office or hub. There will be a need to regularly connect with colleagues for collaboration and in some locations you’ll be expected to spend at least two days a week, or if part time you'll spend 40% of your working time, in the office. If your application is successful, your hiring manager will provide further details on how this works.

If we receive a high volume of relevant applications, we may close the advert earlier than the advertised date, so please apply as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

In this role, you’ll support the team through multiple data migrations, helping to transition reports and MI into Power BI in line with agreed standards. You’ll build a strong understanding of existing data sources, legacy reporting, and current processes, translating them into refreshed or newly developed Power BI outputs. A key part of your work will involve carrying out data quality checks, testing, and validation to ensure that every migrated report is accurate, reliable, and aligned with business expectations.

You’ll help maintain timely and precise MI to meet Financial Crime reporting needs, covering both regulatory and internal requirements. As new tools, datasets, and ways of working are introduced, you’ll work closely with colleagues to resolve data or reporting issues and keep delivery on track. You’ll also contribute to change, risk, and data governance activities by following established frameworks, documentation standards, and control processes. Alongside this, you’ll support the assessment of data availability, identify potential gaps across project, ad hoc and regular reporting, and escalate concerns where needed to ensure reporting remains robust throughout the transition.

About you

As a minimum, you will have:

  • A proven ability to use SAS and SQL to interrogate large, complex datasets drawn from multiple sources, demonstrating confidence in managing and interpreting high‑volume information
  • Experience working with Power BI or a comparable visualisation tool, along with exposure to data migration activity and an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area
  • A solid understanding of data governance principles and data quality frameworks, with the awareness needed to support strong controls and reliable reporting
  • Background experience within Financial Services or another large, regulated, and operationally complex environment, enabling you to navigate risk, structure, and oversight with ease
  • Previous involvement in large‑scale data migration programmes would be a valuable advantage, bringing additional insight into the challenges and opportunities of transformation

Our customer first behaviours put customers and members at the heart of how we work together. They are the set of behaviours that every colleague needs to display, in every role:

  • Feel what customers feel - We step into our customers’ shoes, using their feedback and insights to empathise with them and to understand their needs, so that every decision we make starts and finishes with our customers in mind

  • Say it straight - We are brave in speaking out and saying what we think – we’re honest and direct with good intent, openly sharing diverse perspectives to reach the best conclusions and using language everyone can understand

  • Push for better - We don’t settle for mediocrity, we challenge the status quo, taking responsibility for continuous improvement and personal development

  • Get it done - We prioritise what will have the greatest impact, we are decisive, and we take accountability for delivering brilliant customer outcomes

You can strengthen your application by showing how our customer first behaviours resonate with you, and where you may have already demonstrated these.

The extras you’ll get

There are all sorts of employee benefits available at Nationwide, including:

  • 25 days holiday, pro rata

  • Private medical insurance

  • A highly competitive pension to help you build a strong foundation for retirement

  • Access to an annual performance-related bonus

  • Training and development to help you progress your career

  • A great selection of additional benefits through our salary sacrifice scheme

  • Life assurance to provide peace of mind for you and your loved ones in the event of your death

  • Wellhub – access to a range of free and paid options for health and wellness

  • Up to 2 days of paid volunteering a year

Banking – but fairer, more rewarding, and for the good of society

We forge our own path at Nationwide.

As a mutual, we’re owned by our members - those customers who bank, save or have a mortgage with us. We challenge the financial sector status quo. We don’t see customers as the engine of our own profit. We share our profits with them and put their needs first. Always there when they need us. Supporting them and their lives.

If you’re inspired by fairer finances, passionate about making a meaningful impact, and truly care about our customers, you’re one of us.

At Nationwide, you are challenged to grow and rewarded for doing so. Valued. Recognised. Inspired to be your best. As a community, we want our working lives to count. As a team, we celebrate what we achieve. As a standard-setter, we work for the good of customers, communities, and broader society.

We are purpose-driven. Uncompromisingly customer. Unstoppably Nationwide.

We respond to everyone, so we will be in contact shortly after the closing date to let you know the outcome of your application.

title: Planning & Performance Technology Lead
description:
Planning & Performance Technology Lead

Job Description
This role will provide end-to-end technical leadership for the platforms, data, integrations, and reporting capabilities that support enterprise financial planning, forecasting, modeling and budgeting. The role serves as the primary technology representative for the platforms, partnering with Finance stakeholders, enterprise technology teams, and external vendors to deliver and sustain enterprise financial planning capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical strategy, architecture, implementation, and ongoing evolution of enterprise planning, forecasting, and budgeting capabilities.
  • Lead the Oracle EPM/EDM Technology pod, providing day-to-day technical direction, managing team priorities and capacity, developing technical expertise, and ensuring accountability for delivery, application support, and operational performance.
  • Serve as the primary Finance Technology partner to FP&A and Corporate Finance, translating business requirements into technical designs, delivery roadmaps, and platform enhancements.
  • Provide technical leadership for the implementation and ongoing support of Oracle EPM and related Finance platforms, including application configuration, business rules, calculations, workflows, security, reporting, and environment management.
  • Define the target-state architecture supporting the movement of actuals, plan, forecast, workforce, and reference data across source systems, the Finance data platform, EPM applications, and QRM.
  • Define and lead the technical integration between Oracle EPM and QRM, enabling the reliable exchange of planning, forecasting, balance sheet, and financial data required to support integrated Finance and Treasury processes.
  • Design and govern integrations between EPM platforms and upstream and downstream systems, including general ledger, HR, procurement, data lake, reporting, and management information systems.
  • Establish clear technical standards for data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, validation, exception management, and financial reporting.
  • Lead technical design reviews and evaluate solutions for scalability, performance, security, resiliency, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Define and oversee system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, performance testing, and production-readiness validation.
  • Manage technical dependencies, risks, issues, milestones, and delivery commitments across internal technology teams, implementation partners, and software vendors.
  • Provide technical oversight and quality assurance for project deliverables, including architecture decisions, design specifications, configuration workbooks, integration designs, test plans, deployment plans, and support documentation.
  • Own the ongoing operation, maintenance, and enhancement of Oracle EPM and EDM, ensuring platform stability, incident and problem management, release management, production support, and continuous improvement. Drive automation and process improvements that reduce manual work, shorten planning cycles, strengthen controls, and improve access to timely financial information.
  • Maintain a prioritized technology roadmap aligned with Finance objectives, regulatory and control requirements.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience leading the technical implementation or support of Oracle EPM, QRM, Hyperion, SAP, or comparable enterprise planning platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, long-range planning, and management reporting processes.
  • Experience with EPM application design, metadata structures, calculation rules, workflow, security, reporting, and data integration.
  • Understanding of general ledger structures, chart of accounts, financial hierarchies, dimensional models, and master data governance.
  • Experience integrating EPM applications with ERP, HR, procurement, data lake, and business intelligence platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical delivery across Finance, Data, Architecture, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, vendors, and implementation partners.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, data quality, reconciliation, auditability, access management, change control, and production support.
  • Ability to translate complex Finance requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate architecture and delivery decisions to senior stakeholders.

Hours & Work Schedule

  • Hours per Week: 40
  • Work Schedule: Monday - Friday

The salary range for this position is $133,000 - $174,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, relevant skills, and experience.

title: Health Safety & Environmental - Manager II
description:
Site HS&E Manager will lead the development, implementation, auditing, monitoring and accountability efforts of all HS&E policies and procedures to ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Additionally, this role is responsible for site security measures to protect people and assets and the emergency management program.

Essential Functions:

Implement and oversee the site HSE program that will ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory standards as well as Company HS&E policies and standards.

Lead the site HSE DWS Center of Excellence (CoE) team to build capability in HSE systems across the organization and eliminate losses.

Provide ongoing support and capability building to plant personnel in the identification of workplace hazards, reporting and investigation of incidents, and the elements of the HSE program.

Develop and facilitate employee engagement and training programs to meet site needs, benchmarking & reapplying systems and processes from other sites, assessing current performance & recommending improvements.

Manage change and streamline compliance programs – Must ensure a robust system to manage compliance with laws, anticipate and manage change, and develop strategies to reduce risk.

Measure progress toward meeting our HSE targets and objectives and track regulatory data. Post regulatory information as required and submit HSE data per Global reporting strategy.

title: Director, Core Voice Technology & Platform
description:
As Director, Core Voice Technology & Platform Engineering, you'll own the foundation our entire contact center runs on. That includes carrier and communications services, the voice and interaction routing core, the platforms that run them, and the reliability practice that keeps them available.

In voice, there's no room for error. When a call fails to connect, drops partway through, or has poor audio, our guests notice right away, and a polished application on top can't fix it. Your job is to make the foundation stable, predictable and easy to monitor, so the experience and AI teams building on it can move quickly with confidence.

This is a platform leadership role. You'll lead numbering and carrier services, SIP and media, routing and queuing, the voice self-service runtime, call recording, telephony integration and the underlying infrastructure. You'll deliver all of it as stable, versioned, well-documented capabilities rather than one-off configurations. You'll also keep our communications layer portable, so we can change a carrier, messaging provider or platform component when the commercial terms make sense.

You'll partner closely with Contact Center Application & AI Engineering. That team owns the experience layer. You'll own everything it depends on to set up, route, carry, record and end every interaction. The two teams connect through a shared, versioned interface contract.

Your Day to Day

  • Carrier and communications layer: Own carrier strategy and engineering (SIP trunking, session capacity, geographic and provider redundancy, failover design, least-cost and quality-based routing) and the number inventory end to end (DIDs, toll-free, international numbering, porting, provisioning automation, lifecycle hygiene), since number sprawl is a cost and compliance problem. Own emergency services compliance for all voice endpoints, including dispatchable location, direct 911 dialing, and notification, plus the technical relationship with carrier, CPaaS, and communications-layer providers.

  • Voice and interaction core: Own routing and queuing architecture (skills and attribute models, queue design, overflow and failover treatment, priority and interrupt logic, business-hours and holiday handling); the voice self-service and IVR runtime, including telephony-side behavior of conversational and agentic experiences and the handoff contract into assisted service; call and screen recording, media storage, encryption, and retention execution against Legal and Records policy; and CTI and telephony control exposed to the experience layer, including presence, state, transfer, conference, and consult.

  • Voice quality and real-time performance: Own end-to-end audio quality as a measured discipline: MOS or equivalent scoring, jitter, latency, packet loss, and codec strategy, monitored continuously rather than investigated after complaints. Own real-time media path design with Networking, including QoS, SD-WAN policy, and traffic engineering across sites and cloud regions, and the connectivity standard, diagnostics, and support model for remote agents whose last mile sits outside enterprise control.

  • Platform engineering and reliability: Own infrastructure-as-code, environment strategy, configuration management, and repeatable provisioning; capacity planning against seasonal and event-driven demand, including peak booking periods and disruption surges; resilience through high-availability design, disaster recovery, and failover exercises that are actually run; change management for a real-time system, with windows, staged rollout, verification, and rollback; production reliability, 24x7 on-call, and incident command; and observability for the voice path, including telemetry, synthetic call testing, and dashboards operations leaders can read unaided.

  • Security, fraud, and regulatory controls: Own SIP and session security, toll fraud and traffic pumping prevention, and access control for platform administration; caller authentication and attestation posture, including how outbound calls are labeled or blocked by terminating carriers; the technical controls behind consent, recording notification, and payment handling on voice, in partnership with Compliance, Legal, and Security; and audit evidence, including access logs, configuration history, and change records.

  • Vendor management and portability: Maintain a current, defensible assessment of switching cost for each carrier, platform, and communications-layer dependency, and fund the abstractions worth keeping. Own technical evaluation, configuration, integration, and lifecycle management of purchased platform components, including upgrade and version currency, and support commercial negotiation with usage data, quality data, and a credible technical alternative, bringing lock-in exposure forward before contract decisions.

  • Organization and cross-functional leadership: Build and lead a team spanning voice engineering, platform and reliability engineering, and telecom operations, typically through leads or managers with a blended employee and partner model. Partner as peer counterpart to Contact Center Application & AI Engineering on joint roadmap, interface contract, and shared incident response; translate infrastructure constraints into terms operations leaders can plan around; and reduce silos with Networking, Infrastructure, Security, and Operations through shared runbooks, shared telemetry, and joint intake rather than ticket handoffs.

What We Need From You

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Relevant platform, network, or cloud certifications are beneficial but not required.

  • Experience: 10+ years in telecommunications, voice, or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years leading teams and 2+ years leading managers or team leads. Direct accountability for a 24x7 production voice or real-time communications environment at enterprise scale, including outage ownership. Hands-on background in SIP and real-time media, not vendor administration alone, as that depth is not substitutable with general infrastructure leadership. Exposure to at least one major CCaaS or cloud contact center platform at the telephony and routing layer. Managing carrier relationships across capacity, porting, escalation, and commercial review. Migrating or modernizing voice infrastructure, ideally on-premises to cloud, with production continuity maintained. Operating where long tenure and established process mean change requires bringing people along.

  • Technical skills: SIP signaling, SDP, RTP/SRTP, codecs, transcoding, DTMF handling, and session border control; voice quality engineering (MOS and related scoring, jitter buffering, QoS and DSCP marking, network path and packet capture analysis); carrier and numbering (trunk architecture, capacity modeling, numbering administration, porting, least-cost and quality-based routing); emergency services requirements, call authentication and attestation frameworks, robocall mitigation, and recording and consent obligations across jurisdictions; contact center routing architecture (skills and attribute-based routing, queue and overflow design, interaction state models); IVR and voice self-service engineering, including speech recognition and TTS integration at the telephony layer; cloud and platform engineering (IaC, containerization, CI/CD, secrets and configuration management, multi-region design); observability and SRE practice (SLOs and error budgets, synthetic monitoring, distributed tracing across telephony and application boundaries, incident management); security fundamentals for real-time communications, including toll fraud vectors, session hijacking, and encryption in transit and at rest.

  • Leadership: Runs a calm, structured incident with clear command and communication, and no heroics as a standing operating model; explains infrastructure risk and trade-offs in business terms, including what an investment buys and what declining it costs; builds credibility with operations leaders by understanding call flow reality before proposing to change it; develops engineers and managers and builds redundancy in scarce, deep telephony expertise rather than tolerating single points of human failure.

Travel: 10-15%

Other key skills required for the role include:

  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple time-sensitive activities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

For salaries in other countries please reach out to the talent acquisition partner recruiting for this role.

title: Senior Director, Commercialization Partnerships Operations
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Sr. Director, Commercialization Partnerships and Operations leads the commercialization partnerships and operations team at RevMed headquarters, with direct leadership responsibility for the Director, Commercialization Partnerships and Operations role(s). Reporting to the Vice President, Commercialization Partnerships, this position sets the strategic direction and operating standards for all commercial and distribution partners. The Senior Director owns portfolio-wide standardization, governance design, process mapping and cross-functional alignment, while directing the team’s execution and partnering with regional commercial heads on relationship management and commercial readiness.

As a leader for commercialization partnerships and distributorships, this role serves as a strategic advisor to senior executives on partnership strategy, distribution models, governance, and portfolio performance. The Senior Director aligns RevMed’s internal functional teams (Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Medical Affairs, Finance, and Legal) and external commercial distribution partners around consistent operating processes that support commercial readiness, regulatory/MAA approval, compliant named-patient access programs, and reliable product supply across the commercial partnership portfolio.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Governance Framework:

  • Consistent KPI Architecture: Set and own a unified commercial and operational KPI framework across all commercial partnerships and distribution partners; establish consistent definitions, reporting standards, and review cadences, and oversee implementation by the Director-level team and regional stakeholders.

  • Governance & Decision-Making: Design and own the governance model across all commercial partnerships and distributorships, including standardized charters, membership, meeting cadences, and decision rights for Joint Steering Committees (JSC), Joint Commercial Committees (JCC), and Joint Operations Committees (JOC), as well as joint pricing decisions. Guide the team’s implementation and ensure alignment with regional commercial heads and functional leaders.

  • Map and standardize end-to-end processes across all commercial partnerships and distributorships, defining accountable owners, cross-functional handoffs, escalation pathways, charter guidelines, voting rights, and decision-making matrices (RevMed vs. Partner/Distributor) across commercial, pricing, regulatory, and supply chain domains. Establish documented playbooks and oversee consistent adoption, with clearly defined regional or contractual exceptions.

  • Commercial & Non-Commercial KPIs: Forecast/order accuracy, market access, medical information metrics, performance to volume targets, order-to-cash cycle times, stockout frequency, inventory buffer levels, and lead-time adherence.

  • Regulatory & Quality KPIs: Variances/amendment submission timelines, adherence to quality and PV agreements.

Quarterly Financial Tracking:

  • Set consistent financial reporting standards with RevMed HQ Finance and Partner Commercial Operations across the portfolio. Oversee the team’s quarterly tracking, reporting, analysis, and reconciliation of commercial revenue, transfer pricing, and royalty/profit-share milestones, escalating material issues to the Vice President, Commercialization Partnerships.

  • KPI-Based Financial Reconciliation: Own the portfolio-wide quarterly financial reconciliation framework and oversee team execution with Finance across partners based on contracted KPIs, volume tiers, milestone achievements, and operational clawbacks or bonuses.

  • Commercial Dashboard Management: Establish standardized executive dashboards and oversee team maintenance of real-time reporting on financial performance, sales volume, inventory valuation, and partner margin compliance. Translate portfolio insights into strategic recommendations for senior executives.

Team Leadership & Executive Thought Leadership:

  • Team Leadership: Lead and develop the commercialization partnerships and operations team, including the Director, Commercialization Partnerships and Operations role(s). Set team priorities, clarify accountabilities, and guide Director-level execution of partner-specific operations within the portfolio-wide standards and governance established by this role.

  • Executive Thought Leadership: Advise the Vice President, Commercialization Partnerships and senior executives on commercial partnership and distribution strategy, operating-model choices, and governance evolution. Present portfolio-level opportunities, risks, and recommendations to inform executive decisions and drive continuous improvement across commercial partnerships and distributors.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Education: B.S./B.A. in Business, Life Sciences, Supply Chain, or Finance (MBA or advanced degree preferred).

  • Experience: 12–15+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with direct experience in Alliance Management, Commercial Operations, Strategic Account Operations, or Global Program Management. Demonstrated experience leading teams and Director-level professionals, establishing operating standards across multiple partnerships or distributorships, and designing portfolio-wide governance and processes.

  • Cross-Functional Expertise: Proven track record bridging commercial activities with technical/operations functions (Supply Chain, Quality/CMC, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Finance). Ability to influence senior executives as a thought leader, translate complex portfolio issues into strategic recommendations, and align cross-functional leaders around standardized governance and operating processes.

  • Negotiation Experience: Demonstrated experience developing, negotiating, and operationalizing licensing, distribution, commercialization, or alliance agreements.

  • Geographic & Regional Knowledge: Solid understanding of regional pharmaceutical markets, regulatory environments (regional & national competent authorities), pricing & reimbursement dynamics, and distribution models (direct vs. distributor/partner).

  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 30%. Hybrid role, at minimum 2-3 days in office at Redwood City headquarters.

Preferred Skills:

  • Oncology development, supply chain, and commercialization experience.

  • Prior experience in a smaller, rapidly growing biotech or pharmaceutical company.

title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer – Postgres Tooling based in Switzerland.

As a Software Engineer specializing in PostgreSQL tooling, you will play a key role in building and maintaining open-source tools that help developers manage database schemas and migrations safely and efficiently. You will contribute to the evolution of a powerful schema comparison and migration engine, ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and security of generated SQL. Working at the intersection of database internals, software engineering, and compiler-style problem-solving, you will tackle complex technical challenges involving dependency management, permissions, and data integrity. You will collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams and open-source contributors to improve developer workflows and establish robust tooling standards. The role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership of a widely used project and help drive it toward a stable, standalone release. You will thrive in an asynchronous, open-source-first environment that values technical excellence, independent thinking, and engineering precision.

Accountabilities

  • Co-maintain and progressively take technical ownership of an open-source PostgreSQL schema comparison and migration engine, reviewing contributions and eventually growing into its lead maintainer.
  • Review, evaluate, and merge code contributions, including AI-generated pull requests, while ensuring high standards of correctness, maintainability, and security.
  • Investigate and resolve reported issues related to schema differences, dependency ordering, migration generation, and PostgreSQL compatibility.
  • Expand automated testing and validation coverage across multiple PostgreSQL versions to ensure consistent and reliable behavior.
  • Ensure generated database migrations are safe, privilege-aware, and designed to prevent unintended data loss or security regressions.
  • Identify potentially destructive schema changes and implement mechanisms to detect them and generate safer alternatives wherever possible.
  • Contribute to the development of a stable 1.0 release, including defining public APIs, establishing semantic versioning contracts, improving documentation, and expanding PostgreSQL extension support.
  • Engage with the open-source community by managing issue reports, reviewing external contributions, providing technical guidance, and maintaining constructive discussions with contributors.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams to ensure consistent migration generation and execution across products, platform services, database branching, and AI-powered workflows.
  • Write technical design documents, define architectural direction, and establish engineering strategies for the continued evolution of the tooling.
  • Participate in the engineering team's on-call rotation, helping investigate and resolve production-related issues while supporting reliable software delivery.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including extensive hands-on experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, particularly system catalogs such as pg_catalog and pg_depend, object ownership, permissions, grants, default privileges, Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, and extension membership.
  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL DDL operations and database migration semantics, including locking behavior, transactional limitations, dependency management, and the identification of potentially destructive changes.
  • A security-conscious engineering mindset, with particular attention to preventing unauthorized privilege changes, accidental access exposure, and unintended data loss.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and the ability to develop reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software.
  • Experience designing advanced testing strategies for correctness, including differential testing, property-based testing, and test corpus validation across multiple PostgreSQL versions.
  • Familiarity with compiler-style engineering challenges, including dependency graphs, topological sorting, cycle detection, and schema comparison algorithms.
  • Ability to review and understand complex code changes within sophisticated codebases, including contributions generated with AI-assisted development tools.
  • Proven experience owning and maintaining production software, including staged releases, error monitoring, incident investigation, and responding to real-world user feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, from initial problem definition and architectural planning through production implementation.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to document technical decisions clearly.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and collaborate successfully within asynchronous, globally distributed engineering teams.

Nice To Have

  • Previous experience developing or maintaining database schema comparison and migration tools such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, Flyway, or Liquibase.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL backup and schema extraction internals, particularly pg_dump.
  • Open-source project maintenance experience, including managing public APIs, semantic versioning, technical documentation, and community contributions.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL extensions such as pg_cron, pgmq, pg_partman, vault, pg_net, pgvector, or PostGIS.
  • Experience with Go programming language.
  • Contributions to PostgreSQL itself or experience developing and maintaining PostgreSQL extensions.
  • Previous experience working with PostgreSQL-based products or managed database platforms.

Benefits

  • Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in India within a globally distributed team, with no mandatory office attendance.
  • Co-working Support: Access to a WeWork membership or co-working allowance to support a productive remote working environment.
  • Equity Ownership (ESOP): Employee stock ownership opportunities, allowing team members to share in the company's long-term growth and success.
  • Technology Allowance: Dedicated budget to purchase equipment and improve your workspace, including laptops, monitors, headphones, and other essential tools.
  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance covering 100% of employee premiums and 80% of dependent premiums, subject to applicable plan terms and local eligibility.
  • Annual Team Off-Sites: Opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues during company-wide gatherings in different cities around the world.
  • Flexible Working Arrangements: Asynchronous work culture that encourages autonomy, flexibility, and ownership of your schedule.
  • Professional Development: Annual learning and education allowance for courses, books, conferences, and other professional growth opportunities.
  • International Collaboration: Opportunity to work alongside a globally distributed engineering team representing more than 60 countries and 20 languages.

title: Electronics Safety Systems Engineer – Missile Ranges / Flight Safety Systems
description:
Description

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Your greatest work is ahead!

The Leidos Defense Electrical Systems Department is seeking a talented Electronics Safety Systems Engineer to design, develop, and qualify high-reliability safety electronics systems for missile range operations, autonomous flight safety systems (AFSS), and firing safety applications. This role focuses on the system development including definition of requirements and requirement flow down to AFSS electronic components — including low-voltage firing sets, initiator safety circuits, interlocks, stimulus sensing, and related protection systems — ensuring compliance with stringent missile range safety standards such as RCC 319 and related requirements. You will work in a fast-paced environment alongside systems, software, hardware development, test engineers, and range operations teams to deliver dependable, fail-safe electronics systems for missile and flight safety applications.

The selected candidate will be expected to execute in a fast-paced, small team environment through all phases of the hardware life cycle from conceptual development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support. With a product focus, the individual is also expected to actively partner with other engineers, project managers, technicians, and customers to develop solutions that adhere to a diverse set of requirements. The ideal candidate will thrive in a learning environment that encourages leadership and technical growth.

If you are up for the challenge of joining this team, then apply today to be considered.

Leidos Defense Systems Sector provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!


Primary Responsibilities.

  • Ownership of system level design/qualification for an autonomous flight safety system, including providing design requirement guidance to component design engineers, and conducting design reviews with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop Flight Safety System design and validation requirements in compliance with various missile range safety standards (RCC 319, etc.).
  • Review the design and development of safety-critical electronics including low-voltage firing sets, initiator safety circuits, power filtering, interlocks, reliable stimulus sensing systems, CDUs, and safety circuits for LEEFI and NSI initiators.
  • Review Flight Safety System component designs and test procedures against requirements. Items may include high reliability analog circuits, filters, protection circuits, sensing circuits, A/D conversion interfaces, and fail-safe architectures, grounding and isolation schemes, EMI/EMC impact analysis and testing.
  • Apply RCC 319 and related range safety standards throughout the design, analysis, and verification process. Support environmental and qualification test requirements of safety electronics, including thermal cycling, shock and vibration, vacuum / pressure testing, salt fog, humidity, pyro-shock, resonant plate / beam testing, acceleration, and EMI/EMC testing.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary development environment with evolving priorities and tight schedules.

Basic Qualification

  • Candidate must possess a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited institution. Candidate must have 4+ years of experience and with a Master’s degree at least 2+ years of experience.
  • Strong experience in safety-critical or high-reliability electronics design and/or testing and validation. Ability to interpret/review electrical schematics and mechanical drawings. Demonstrated experience integrating/certifying firing safety electronics, initiator circuits, interlocks, or similar safety systems for flight testing.
  • Solid understanding of grounding, isolation, shielding, bonding, ESD, and EMI protection techniques.
  • Experience with range safety standards, particularly RCC 319 and related requirements.
  • Familiarity with analog circuit function, filtering, sensing, and A/D interfaces in reliability-critical applications. Familiarity with standard electrical test equipment (oscilloscopes, meters, function generators, etc.).
  • Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.U.S. Citizenship required (due to the nature of the work); ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance is expected.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preference shown to candidates who possess a Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited university.
  • Active DOD S, TS or DOE Q Clearance.
  • Direct experience with missile range safety systems, autonomous flight safety systems, or similar systems and their certification.
  • Experience certifying/qualifying low-voltage firing sets, initiator safety electronics, and reliable stimulus sensing circuits.
  • Experience designing automated or semi-automated test systems for safety electronics boards.
  • Prior work supporting environmental qualification of high-reliability electronics for range or flight safety use.

Security Requirements:
Candidate must be a US Citizen and possess (and be able to maintain) a Final Secret Clearance or meet the eligibility to obtain (and maintain) a Secret Clearance.
