title: E-UAS Pilot/Technician
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Description

​The CUSTOMER requires enhanced situational awareness and rapid response capabilities during protection events nationwide and withing the National Capital Region. The program provides Enhanced Unmanned Aerial Systems (E-UAS) for persistent aerial ISR overwatch and rapid-response drone capability, and Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) for detection, tracking, and mitigation of unauthorized drone activity. Contractor personnel operate and sustain government-furnished E-UAS/C-UAS systems from CUSTOMER facilities and at protective sites, integrating operations with CUSTOMER command-and-control systems (including VIDTERRA and TAK).

​

​Primary Responsibilities

  • ​Deploy, operate, and recover government-furnished UAS ISR platforms for continuous aerial surveillance of designated protection zones.
  • ​Operate mobile rapid-response UAS platforms equipped with high-resolution EO/IR cameras, thermal imaging, and communications-relay payloads; maintain readiness for immediate launch (within 3 minutes of CUSTOMER request).
  • ​Provide real-time video, imagery, sensor data, and operational updates to CUSTOMER operations centers and designated stakeholders.
  • ​Conduct pre-flight, in-flight, and post-flight procedures to ensure safe, compliant, and effective operations in accordance with FAA Part 107 and CUSTOMER directives.
  • ​Must be able to stand for long periods of time, work in adverse weather, climb ladders, work on rooftops, and lift 50 lbs. unassisted.
  • ​Support integration of UAS data feeds with CUSTOMER command-and-control infrastructure, including live video distribution via VIDTERRA and TAK.
  • ​Conduct interoperability testing with CUSTOMER IT staff prior to each event to validate connectivity, video distribution, and system integration.
  • ​Participate in protective advance planning meetings, pre-event briefings, and post-event debriefings with CUSTOMER stakeholders.
  • ​Maintain accurate documentation of flight operations, incident logs, daily operational reports, and after-action inputs; keep FAA Part 107 and platform-specific certification/training records available for CUSTOMER inspection.
  • ​Complete government-provided CUSTOMER Basic Operator Course, EUAS Policy course, and platform-specific certifications as required.
  • ​Adhere to all CUSTOMER security protocols, information-handling requirements, and federal cybersecurity standards.
  • ​When not deployed on active missions, work from the National Capital Region (NCR) facility to service, maintain, and store equipment and complete required CUSTOMER training.
  • ​Support variable schedules and nationwide travel, including nights, weekends, holidays, extended shifts, and 24/7 event coverage as required.

​

​Basic Qualifications

  • ​Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • ​High School Graduate
  • ​Top Secret (TS) security clearance.
  • ​Current FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate.
  • ​Ability to complete government-provided CUSTOMER Basic Operator Course and EUAS Policy course (offered on a rolling basis; training period not to exceed one month).
  • ​Experience operating UAS ISR and/or rapid-response platforms in ISR, surveillance, public safety, emergency response, law enforcement, military, federal, or private-sector/commercial mission environments. Candidates with current, substantial private-industry UAS operating experience are encouraged to apply; prior federal or law-enforcement experience is not required.
  • ​Experience conducting mission planning, pre-flight inspections, launch/recovery operations, flight monitoring, and post-flight documentation.
  • ​Experience operating UAS sensors/payloads such as EO/IR cameras, thermal imaging, live video streaming, mapping, or communications-relay systems.
  • ​Familiarity with airspace coordination, aviation safety practices, emergency procedures, weather considerations, and UAS operating limitations.
  • ​Ability to travel nationwide and internationally (approximately 80% travel) and support variable schedules, including 24/7 event coverage.
  • ​Strong communication skills; ability to work independently and as part of a coordinated operational team in high-pressure environments.

​

​Preferred Qualifications

  • ​Prior experience supporting CUSTOMER, federal protective services, law enforcement, military, or National Special Security Event (NSSE) operations.
  • ​Experience with VIDTERRA, TAK, secure video distribution, encrypted data transmission, or command-and-control integration.
  • ​Experience with larger ISR UAS platforms, mobile rapid-response platforms, or multi-platform operational deployments.
  • ​Platform-specific or manufacturer certifications, or military UAS operator training.

title: Smart Mobility Specialist
description:
Great communities are built on connection. From vibrant economic centers, resilient communities, and public spaces where we gather to the roads, bridges, transit systems, airports, and ports that connect us, our work touches everyday life. We bring together diverse perspectives and expertise to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Join us to help plan, design, and engineer community and mobility solutions that improve everyday life. Whatever the distance, wherever the destination, our designs lead you there.

Our SmartER Mobility and Zero Emissions Advisory Group focuses on providing consulting services such as planning services of transit, multimodal, complete streets, and emerging technologies like zero-emission and autonomous vehicles. Our recent efforts have focused on making our transit clients ready for the future; a future that will be heavily influenced by the personalization of mobility through technology, changing lifestyles, and an expanding portfolio of mobility choices.

Stantec has served as a trusted advisor to more than 150 zero-emissions related projects and our team has developed more than 40 zero-emission rollout and fleet transition plans for transit agencies, municipalities, and other public fleet owners across North America. Our team pairs transit service planning with Stantec’s proprietary power and energy modeling tool, cost modeling, facility and charging infrastructure design, and funding expertise to deliver practical, phased transition roadmaps. This depth of experience is reflected in our industry standing, including a #7 ranking among the Top 50 Design Firms in Transportation (ENR) and a #3 ranking in Transit Architecture (BD+C).

Your Opportunity

The Smart Mobility Specialist will bring a diverse and background in the transit planning and operations industry along with an open mind to new technologies and mobility planning. The goal is to provide project management and business development support and insights as well as mentoring of junior employees in a range of projects throughout North America.

This position offers great opportunities for professional growth through the exposure to diverse projects covering the span of transit planning from first Mile/last Mile services to rapid transit, as well as zero-emission transition studies that are guiding our clients to the future of transportation. In addition, you will also have the opportunity to work with other departments internally including other consultants in the Infrastructure and Buildings groups, leading to further career growth.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Project and Program Management

  • Prepare client reports, presentations, and manage direct client communications

  • Serve as technical support or lead of zero-emission fleet transition and transit planning projects

  • Conduct and oversee operational, financial, and cost-benefit analysis of different transit and transportation technologies systems

  • Coordinate and conduct data collection and data analysis of transit systems

  • Development of plans, reports and other deliverables

  • Coordination and participation of stakeholder outreach and engagement

  • Cross-functional / multidisciplinary coordination

  • Mentor and support junior staff in the development of transit plans (COA, demand response, long- and short-range) and zero-emission fleet transition plans

  • Support business development by collaborating in the response to Request for Proposals (RFPs) and Request for Qualifications (RFQ)

  • Attend conferences and business development trips to represent Stantec and meet with clients in the promotion of our team’s qualifications.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills are a must.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience in managing multiple transportation projects (transit network, regional transportation, comprehensive operational analysis, demand response services, long- and short-range transit planning), particularly transit operations or service planning, with other multimodal components and complete streets, experience as a plus.

  • Ability to think creatively, work independently and deliver high-quality work with general supervision.

  • Ability to work in a team environment, synthesize problems, and communicate analytical results to a variety of audiences.

  • Time management - working on multiple projects at once/juggling multiple competing priorities.

  • Knowledge of transportation planning theories, major trends in transportation planning, specifically public transit, microtransit, shared mobility services, micromobility.

  • Knowledge of zero-emission technologies (like battery electric and hydrogen) and their applications in public transportation systems and for municipal fleets.

  • Public speaking, preparing and presenting materials for public outreach and engagement.

  • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills.

  • Intermediate to advanced GIS skills.

  • Must have a good driving record and valid driver’s license.

  • Travel availability of up to 20%.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree from accredited university in planning, transportation planning, public administration, engineering, or another related field. Master’s degree desired, not required.
  • 5 years’ experience in zero-emissions planning, transportation planning, and related work.
  • Work experience in transit environment or agency is considered a strong asset.
  • Experience working with complete streets and multimodal planning outside of transit networks (pedestrian and bicycle connectivity, safe routes to school, vision zero, etc.) is preferrable, not required.
  • Experience compiling data, executing complex data analysis through Excel or other similar tools.
  • Experience working with transit agencies, municipalities, and planning departments at the city and state level.
  • Experience with compiling, writing, and revising reports for public audiences. Must be able to demonstrate ability to communicate complex/technical ideas in a clear, easily understandable manner.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee and other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible.

  • Design and develop new core features, making sound architectural decisions and balancing performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Optimize the performance of storage systems, indexing mechanisms, and search operations, working at a low level to improve engine efficiency.
  • Address complex engineering challenges involving memory management, data structures, input/output operations, and concurrency.
  • Ensure the correctness and reliability of implemented features through comprehensive testing, recovery mechanisms, debugging, and production issue resolution.

title: Digital Project Manager in B5, Birmingham, West Midlands (County)
description:
Join Ofwat’s IT Service Delivery & Partnering Team as a Digital Project Manager

*Office Location: Birmingham (B5 4UA) with hybrid working*

About Us

We are Ofwat, the Water Services Regulation Authority, a non-ministerial government department responsible for regulating the water sector in England and Wales. The water sector is entering a new chapter. The government has set out a bold new direction, bringing together expertise from across the sector to deliver better outcomes for customers and the environment. We are collaborating with fellow regulators to respond to recommendations in The Independent Water Commission Report, the Welsh Government’s response to the Green Paper, Shaping the Future of Water Governance in Wales, and the Government’s White Paper, A new vision for water.

Ofwat is working with the government and other regulators to help create a new body for England, bringing together our strengths with those of the Drinking Water Inspectorate, the Environment Agency and Natural England. We are also continuing to work with the Welsh Government to support decisions on the future arrangements for Wales.

While these changes take shape, our mission remains the same: to hold water companies to account, drive performance, and ensure the sector delivers real value for customers, communities, and the environment. If you’re passionate about making a difference, this is a unique moment to join us and help shape the future of water, and together we can continue to make a positive impact.

The Role

The Digital Project Manager role has an important and valuable contribution to enable us to deliver on our goals and regulatory commitments. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape several key technology initiatives that will have a lasting impact across Ofwat. We are looking for a project professional who combines strong delivery discipline with excellent stakeholder management skills and who can confidently lead complex technology projects from concept through to successful implementation.

You will be responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering a portfolio of technology projects that support Ofwat's digital transformation and operational objectives. Working closely with technical teams, suppliers, business stakeholders and senior leaders, you will ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the required quality standards.

This role is ideally suited to an experienced IT Project Manager who can demonstrate successful delivery of infrastructure, application, data migration and business transformation projects in complex organisations. Just as importantly, you will be personable, approachable and skilled at building trusted, productive relationships across technical teams, business areas, senior stakeholders and external suppliers.

About You

Below are some of the key essential experience, skills & knowledge required for this post:

1. Lead criterion 1: Demonstrable experience of successfully delivering multiple concurrent IT and digital projects from initiation through to implementation, using recognised project management methodologies and best practice.

2. Lead Criterion 2: Proven experience of delivering complex IT and digital transformation projects, including Microsoft technologies such as Purview, infrastructure, enterprise systems or data migrations.

3. Strong experience of project planning and governance, using recognised project delivery frameworks such as PRINCE2 or Agile, including managing budgets, risks, dependencies and project reporting.

4. Demonstrable experience managing third-party suppliers and implementation partners, coordinating internal and external resources to support successful project delivery.

5. Experience leading project governance, facilitating project boards or steering groups, and providing clear, high-quality reporting and project information to senior stakeholders.

6. Good knowledge and practical understanding of Microsoft technologies and technology service environments, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Online, with an understanding of information governance, security and compliance considerations in technology projects.

Ofwat is recognised as an Official Sensitive department, and a Security Check (SC) is a requirement for this role. Applicants are normally expected to have been in the UK for the last five years to meet the standard requirements for SC clearance. Successful candidates must obtain SC clearance to a standard satisfactory to Ofwat within the first six months of employment.

Why You Should Join Us

* People Centric: Our people are at the heart of Ofwat and everything we do - we ensure all voices are heard and treat each other with respect; you'll be given the autonomy and the support to do your role in the best way.

title: Visa Coordinator
description:
Opportunity

Hult International Business School is seeking a U.S. Visa Coordinator to support international students throughout their immigration journey while helping ensure institutional compliance with U.S. immigration regulations.

Based at Hult's Boston campus, this role serves as a key resource for F-1 students from admission through graduation, providing individualized immigration advising, visa application guidance, arrival support, and ongoing compliance assistance. The Visa Coordinator helps students navigate complex immigration requirements while delivering a high-touch, student-centered experience aligned with Hult's global and multicultural environment.


The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing a large volume of student cases in a fast-paced environment. They will possess strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to explain complex regulatory requirements clearly and accurately to diverse student audiences.


Working closely with enrollment, academic, student affairs, and operations teams, the Visa Coordinator plays an important role in supporting student success, protecting institutional compliance, and helping students achieve their educational and professional goals in the United States.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Student Immigration Advising and Case Management

  • Advise admitted and continuing students regarding F-1 visa requirements, immigration regulations, and institutional processes.

  • Manage a high-volume caseload of students throughout the pre-arrival, enrollment, and post-arrival lifecycle.

  • Review financial, academic, and immigration documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.

  • Coordinate document collection and issuance processes required for visa sponsorship and immigration compliance.

  • Conduct individual advising appointments, virtual consultations, group information sessions, and immigration workshops.

  • Guide students through visa application procedures and interview preparation.

  • Assist students experiencing visa delays, refusals, administrative processing, status concerns, or other complex immigration situations.

  • Provide immigration advising related to academic rotations, transfer procedures, reduced course loads, program changes, leaves of absence, and other student situations affecting immigration status.

  • Maintain accurate student records and case notes within institutional systems and immigration databases.

  • Support timely communication with students through outreach campaigns, individualized follow-up, and ongoing case management.

SEVIS Administration and Regulatory Compliance

  • Support institutional compliance with U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP), and related immigration requirements.

  • Assist with preparation, review, issuance, and maintenance of Forms I-20 and other related immigration documentation.

  • Maintain accurate student records and reporting obligations within SEVIS and institutional systems.

  • Monitor student enrollment, registration, academic progress, and other immigration-related compliance requirements.

  • Support processing related to transfers, program extensions, reduced course loads, reinstatements, travel signatures, employment authorizations, and program completion activities as assigned.

  • Identify potential compliance concerns and escalate issues appropriately.

  • Assist with audits, internal reviews, regulatory reporting, and institutional compliance initiatives.

  • Monitor changes to immigration regulations, policies, government guidance and communicate impacts to relevant stakeholders.

Student Education and Campus Engagement

  • Develop and deliver immigration information sessions for prospective, incoming, and continuing students.

  • Present during orientation, intake activities, and student lifecycle programming.

  • Create and maintain student-facing immigration resources, guides, communications, and training materials.

  • Serve as a visible and accessible campus resource regarding immigration-related questions.

  • Promote student understanding of immigration responsibilities and available support services.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Enrollment Advisors to support student onboarding, visa readiness, and arrival planning.

  • Collaborate with academic, finance, coaching, career development, housing, registration, and student affairs teams regarding immigration-related student matters.

  • Work closely with institutional immigration compliance leadership to ensure consistent application of policies and procedures.

  • Support coordinated responses to complex student cases affecting enrollment, retention, academic progression, or immigration compliance.

  • Maintain productive working relationships with external stakeholders, including government agencies, immigration counsel, and service providers as appropriate.

Data Management, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain accurate records, reporting metrics, and case management documentation.

  • Monitor visa conversion rates, issuance trends, processing timelines, and other key operational indicators.

  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and process improvement opportunities.

  • Support implementation of new technologies, systems enhancements, and operational best practices.

  • Assist with preparation of reports, compliance reviews, and strategic planning initiatives.

Additional Portfolio Responsibilities

In addition to core immigration advising responsibilities, the Visa Coordinator may be assigned ownership of an additional operational or student-support portfolio aligned with campus or global priorities.

Examples may include:

  • Faculty and staff immigration coordination

  • Dual Degree student advising

  • Exchange and partnership programs

  • Undergraduate student immigration support

  • Global mobility initiatives

  • International experiential learning programs

  • Immigration-related data analytics and reporting

  • Student programming and engagement initiatives


Portfolio assignments may change periodically based on institutional needs and discretion of management.


Qualifications and Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • Two or more years of experience in international student services, immigration advising, visa processing, higher education administration, student affairs, or a related field.

  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and high-volume caseloads.

  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment.

  • Strong technology skills, including CRM and database systems and Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural and educational backgrounds.

  • Legal authorization to work in the country of employment.

Preferred

  • Experience working with F-1 student immigration regulations and SEVIS.

  • Experience as a Designated School Official (DSO) or supporting DSO functions.

  • Knowledge of international student advising best practices within U.S. higher education.

  • Experience working in a global or international educational environment.

  • Experience utilizing Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

    Range: $52,000-$58,000.

Seasonal Nature of the Role

This position operates within an annual cycle driven by major academic intakes and immigration deadlines.


Peak periods involve intensive student outreach, documentation review, visa preparation support, compliance activities, and case management. During non-peak periods, the role contributes to strategic initiatives, operational improvement projects, training development, and institutional planning efforts.


Success in this role requires flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to shift priorities in response to changing institutional and regulatory needs.


Other Duties as Assigned


On-Campus Presence

This position requires substantial on-campus engagement at Hult's Boston campus. The role currently requires a minimum of four days per week of in-person presence, with additional in-person support required during peak operational periods.

Responsibilities include student advising, orientation programs, workshops, presentations, and collaboration with campus partners. Occasional evening and weekend availability may be required to support student programming and institutional initiatives.


Remote work flexibility is subject to institutional policy and business needs. Currently limited to 1 remote day per week but may change based on business needs during periods of academic year or future requirements.


About Us
Hult International Business School is a non-profit educational pioneer and the first triple-accredited U.S. business school. Ranked by the Financial Times, Economist, Forbes, and Bloomberg Businessweek, Hult offers undergraduate, graduate, and executive education programs across its global campuses in Boston, London, and Dubai. The School’s philosophy is that business skills can only truly be learned by doing. By immersing students from around the world in practical, hands-on experiences from day one, this approach creates a global community of confident, entrepreneurially minded graduates ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow.

Equal Opportunities at Hult
Hult is dedicated to actively creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing opportunities regardless of gender, religion, race, color, sexual identity, disability, ethnicity, age, and all the individual identities that make us unique. At Hult, we believe that through diversity we find our strength. If you require any accommodation to assist you in the interview process, please include this with your inquiry.

Hult offers competitive salaries and benefits in a global, empathetic, and highly multicultural working environment. If you are motivated by the prospect of an international career with a dynamic and forward-thinking school, we would love to hear from you.

title: Technology Transfer and Export Control Specialist, Senior
description:

The Opportunity:

This position offers the opportunity to directly support the joint or service headquarters in advancing its mission by managing and implementing international security cooperation programs, technology transfer processes, and export control policies that strengthen global defense partnerships and enable interoperability with key allies. As a Senior Technology Transfer and Export Control Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in shaping, overseeing, and advancing programs that impact foreign military sales (FMS), foreign disclosure, export licensing, and technology security.


This headquarters-based role entails strategic advising, policy execution, and interagency collaboration to ensure the success and continuity of defense technology transfer and Security Assistance Enterprise activities. Your work will advance U.S. efforts in supporting allies, partners, and the broader national security mission while upholding export control standards and safeguarding the integrity of sensitive U.S. defense technology.


In this critical role, you will oversee the execution of multi-faceted security cooperation policies while providing management and oversight of export control compliance and technology security programs. You will serve as a senior advisor and key staff officer with expertise in the Arms Export Control Act (AECA), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Technology Release and Foreign Disclosure (TRFD) procedures, and related policies. You will ensure the successful implementation of technology transfer and foreign disclosure processes in alignment with national security priorities, interagency goals, and international policy frameworks.


You will guide stakeholders by analyzing legislation, facilitating policy harmonization, and leading interagency collaboration efforts with government agencies such as the Department of State and Department of Commerce. You will also oversee FMS and international agreements to ensure compliance with release requirements and export standards. Additionally, this role provides the opportunity to enhance operational strategies, assist with developing actionable policies, and deliver impactful recommendations based on comprehensive data analysis, all while ensuring alignment with relevant regulations and priorities.

title: Cyber Network Defense Analyst III
description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

The DHS’s Hunt and Incident Response Team (HIRT) secures the Nation’s cyber and communications infrastructure. HIRT provides DHS’s front-line response for cyber incidents and proactively hunting for malicious cyber activity. Nightwing, as a prime contractor to DHS, performs HIRT investigations to develop a preliminary diagnosis of the severity of breaches. Nightwing provides HIRT remote and onsite advanced technical assistance, proactive hunting, Teir 2 and Teir 3 incident response, and immediate investigation and resolution using host-based, cloud-based and network-based cybersecurity analysis capabilities. Team personnel provide front line response for digital forensics/incident response (DFIR) at Teir 2 and Teir 3 levels along with proactively hunting for malicious cyber activity. We are seeking Cyber Threat Hunters to support this critical customer mission. Responsibilities:
- Correlate forensic findings to network events in support of developing an intrusion narrative
- Collect and document system state information (e.g. running processes, network connections) prior to imaging, as required
- Perform forensic triage of an incident to include determining scope, urgency and potential impact
- Track and document forensic analysis from initial participation through resolution
- Coordinate with Government staff and customer personnel to validate/investigate alerts or additional preliminary findings
- Conduct analysis of forensic images, and available evidence in support of forensic write-ups for inclusion in reports and written products
- Assist to document and publishing Computer Network Defense (CND) guidance and reports pertaining to incident findings
Characterize and analyze network traffic to identify anomalous activity and potential threats to network resources
- Coordinate with enterprise-wide cyber defense staff to validate network alerts
- Document and escalate incidents (including event's history, status, and potential impact for further action) that may cause ongoing and immediate impact to the environment
- Perform event correlation using information gathered from a variety of sources within the enterprise to gain situational awareness and determine the effectiveness of an observed attack
- Provide daily summary reports of network/host events and activity relevant to cyber defense practices
- Receive and analyze network & host alerts from various sources within the enterprise and determine possible causes of alerts
- Provide timely detection, identification, and alerting of possible attacks/intrusions, anomalous activities, and misuse activities and distinguish these incidents and events from benign activities
- Use cyber defense tools for continual monitoring and analysis of system activity to identify malicious activity
- Analyze identified malicious activity to determine weaknesses exploited, exploitation methods, effects on system and information
- Identify and analyze anomalies in network traffic using metadata
- Identify applications and operating systems of a network device based on network traffic
- Identify network mapping and operating system (OS) fingerprinting/other baselining activities
- Assist in the construction of signatures which can be implemented on cyber defense network tools in response to new or observed threats within the network environment or enclave

Required Skills/Clearances:
- U.S. Citizenship
- Active TS/SCI clearance
- Ability to obtain Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Entry on Duty (EOD) Suitability
- 5+ years of direct relevant experience in cyber defense analysis using leading edge technologies and industry standard cyber defense tools-
- Ability to create forensically sound duplicates of evidence (forensic images)- Ability to author cyber investigative reports documenting digital forensics findings- Proficiency with analysis and characterization of cyber attacks- Skilled in identifying different classes of attacks and attack stages- Understanding of system and application security threats and vulnerabilities- Understanding of proactive analysis of systems and networks
- Able to work collaboratively across physical locations
- Action-oriented and have a proactive approach to problem solving
- Proficiency with common operating systems (e,g, Linux/Unix, Windows) - Experience implementing incident handling methodologies
Desired Skills:
-Understanding of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS in the Cloud Environment
Proficiency with One ormore of these EDR Tools; CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Cortex, MS MDE, or Trellix
Proficiency with two or more of the following tools:--- Host forensics software (EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Sleuth Kit/Autopsy)--- SIFT--- Volatility
--- KAPE--- WireShark--- Splunk
--- Elastic- Proficiency conducting all-source research.
Required Education:
BS Computer Science, Cyber Security, Computer Engineering, or related degree; or HS Diploma & 7-9 years of network/host investigations experience. Desired Certifications: (One or More)
GCFE, GCFA, GCLD, GCPS, GCPN, GWEB, GIRD, GREM, GNFA, GCIH, GCIA, GSEC,
Kubernetes Security Specialist, Microsoft 365 Certifications, Microsoft Azure Certifications, AWS Certifications, SANS Cloud Courses (SEC541, SEC584, SEC588) and Certifications GSEC (SANS401), Network+, Security+, CEH

Arlington, VA

Previously part of a leading Fortune 100 company and headquartered in Dulles, VA; Nightwing became independent in 2024 but continues to support the nation’s most mission impactful initiatives.

When we formed Nightwing, we brought a deep set of credentials and an unfaltering commitment to the mission. For over four decades, our team has been providing some of the world’s most technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence support services to the U.S. government on its most important missions.

At Nightwing, we value collaboration and teamwork. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside talented individuals who are passionate about what they do. title: Certifying Aircraft Engineer
description:
Location: Manchester, Engineering

Hours: 7 am - 7 pm, 4 on 4 off

Contract Type: Permanent

Salary: Competitive

Closing Date: 30th November 2026

In a nutshell
At Virgin Atlantic, our Engineering teams keep our aircraft safe, reliable and ready to fly. As a Certifying Engineer, you’ll carry out and supervise line maintenance, helping deliver safe, efficient and punctual departures for our customers.
Reporting to the Station Maintenance Manager, you’ll work closely with Duty Maintenance Managers, Maintenance Control and local partners to make the most of every aircraft turnaround. Combining hands-on technical expertise with confident team leadership, you’ll support our fleet and contracted third-party aircraft, working within your company approvals.


Day to day
• Carry out and certify maintenance within your approvals, completing transit checks and resolving inbound defects safely and efficiently.
• Supervise engineering colleagues and approved contractors, ensuring work meets company standards and documented maintenance procedures.
• Coordinate with Maintenance Control to prioritise tasks, maximise available ground time and keep colleagues informed of technical issues.
• Support staffing and resource planning when acting as the senior engineering representative, responding to schedule changes and aircraft-on-ground situations.
• Help maintain station readiness, including aircraft spares, technical information, equipment and facilities.
• Keep airport teams informed during technical delays and arrange specialist support for extended maintenance or significant events.
• Champion safe working practices, clear communication and a motivated team throughout each shift.


About you
You’re an experienced aircraft maintenance professional who takes pride in doing things safely and thoroughly. You can make sound technical decisions within your approvals, work independently and bring people together when operational demands change.

You’ll bring:
• A sound aircraft engineering background, including considerable experience in line maintenance.
• Completion of a recognised aeronautical college course or formal training programme.
• A UK CAA aircraft maintenance licence, or an appropriate licence issued by the state where maintenance takes place.
• Virgin Atlantic approval on one or more aircraft types currently in our fleet.
• Strong team leadership and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate colleagues, contractors and operational teams.
• Knowledge of applicable health and safety requirements, alongside confidence using computer systems.

If you’re ready to bring your engineering expertise to our international operation, we’d love to hear from you.


Accessibility and inclusion

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible. If you need reasonable adjustments or additional support, you can let us know in your application.

If you’d prefer to speak to someone directly before or during your application, interview or assessment, please contact our recruitment team at recruitment@fly.virgin.com.

We know every role and candidate is different, so we’ll discuss the adjustments available for the role and at each stage of recruitment, and how best to support you.

At Virgin Atlantic, we’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from everyone. Whatever your background, identity, experience or perspective, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Cryptographic Systems Engineer
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
We are seeking a technically focused Cryptographic Systems Engineer to support Department of War CIO efforts related to cryptographic modernization, post-quantum cryptography, and secure systems integration.

This position is intended for an experienced engineer with approximately 10 years of relevant technical experience who can work across cryptographic systems, network engineering, systems engineering, and security architecture. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience integrating or supporting cryptographic capabilities within enterprise or mission environments and be comfortable working with networking, encryption technologies, key management, and emerging post-quantum cryptography requirements.

The role will support engineering analysis, technical integration, migration planning, solution assessment, and implementation activities associated with enterprise cryptographic modernization.


Responsibilities:

  • Support engineering and integration of cryptographic technologies across enterprise and mission systems.
  • Analyze existing cryptographic implementations, dependencies, protocols, and infrastructure to support modernization and migration activities.
  • Support implementation and integration of encryption technologies across network, system, cloud, and application environments.
  • Assist with cryptographic inventory and discovery efforts, including identification of algorithms, protocols, certificates, key dependencies, and affected systems.
  • Support post-quantum cryptography migration activities and implementation of emerging NIST and Department guidance.
  • Evaluate cryptographic products, architectures, and technical solutions for interoperability, security, scalability, and operational suitability.
  • Support testing, validation, troubleshooting, and technical assessment of cryptographic implementations.
  • Work with network and systems engineering teams to integrate cryptographic capabilities into existing architectures.
  • Develop technical documentation, engineering recommendations, implementation guidance, and briefing materials for technical and senior stakeholders.

This position is designed to be flexible, with responsibilities evolving to meet business needs and enable individual growth.


Requirements:

  • Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant engineering experience supporting systems, networks, cybersecurity, cryptography, or related technical environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with cryptographic technologies, encryption systems, or secure communications.
  • Experience integrating security or cryptographic capabilities into operational systems or network environments.
  • Strong understanding of network and security architecture concepts, including protocols, routing, segmentation, secure communications, and system dependencies.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as PKI, TLS, IPsec, MACsec, VPN technologies, certificates, key management, or hardware/software encryption solutions.
  • Working knowledge of classical cryptography and emerging post-quantum cryptography
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with engineering, cybersecurity, program, and Government stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting DoD, Federal Government, intelligence, or other high-assurance environments.
  • Hands-on network engineering experience.
  • Experience with cryptographic modernization, crypto-agility, or migration of legacy cryptographic technologies.
  • Experience with cryptographic inventory, discovery, or dependency mapping.
  • Experience with cloud, enterprise networking, embedded systems, or high-assurance communications environments.
  • Familiarity with FIPS-validated cryptographic products or modules.
  • Relevant technical certifications such as CISSP, CCNP/CCIE, Security+, or equivalent engineering/security credentials.


Why Work for Us?

Core4ce is a team of innovators, self-starters, and critical thinkers—driven by a shared mission to strengthen national security and advance warfighting outcomes.

  • 401(k) with 100% company match on the first 6% deferred, with immediate vesting

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Are you interested in using artificial intelligence to change how an industry operates after decades of working the same way? Do you want to define a product's architecture from the first line, rather than inherit it? Are you looking for a place where the impact of your work is measured in a company's operations, not in a dashboard metric?

We are an early-stage, high-potential start-up. We are building an artificial intelligence product for a traditional industry, with real operations in Mexico and the United States as users from day one. For now we are working discreetly: we share the details of the product, the market, and the customers during the interview.

What we can share up front is the ambition. Today, in this industry, decisions made in the field are made late and with incomplete information, and those decisions directly affect a company's operations and results. Our goal is to change that: for whoever makes decisions in the field to have today the information that currently doesn't arrive until weeks later.

We are looking for people with a high level of commitment and a genuine orientation toward innovation. This is not a project for someone who wants to execute tasks defined by someone else. It is for someone who enjoys ambiguity, proposes ideas, fails fast, and corrects even faster.

As a Senior Engineer, you will be the company's first technical hire. You own the full lifecycle of what you build: data model, design, implementation, deployment, and operation. You will make the architecture decisions that define the product for years to come, and you will develop the team that builds on top of them.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement the core data model on which the entire product depends.
  • Take the product to production with real users in the field, against written acceptance criteria.
  • Build the retrieval and evaluation loop for the artificial intelligence layer: how its acceptance rate is measured and how it is improved without degrading what already worked.
  • Define the team's engineering standards: code review, testing, continuous deployment, and technical documentation.
  • Hire, onboard, and develop the initial technical team.
  • Adopt and evaluate artificial intelligence tools in the development workflow, with judgment about where they add value and where they don't.
  • Operate what you build: monitoring, diagnosis, and resolution of production incidents.

What a workday looks like

This is a high-performance environment. Cycles are measured in weeks, not quarters, and the priority is using technology to change the way an industry operates that until now has changed very little.

A significant part of your day is learning. You will come to understand a business you probably don't know, by talking with the people who run it and seeing how they work in the field. The other part of the day is turning that learning into decisions: about architecture, about product, about what to build first and what to discard. That cycle of learning from the field and applying it immediately is the job, not a prelude to the job.

You will have real autonomy and also real responsibility. No one is going to assign you tasks: you will decide what they are.

About the team

A founding team of seven people, with no administrative layers. Technical decisions are debated on the merits, not by hierarchy. The project has committed capital to operate without depending on a funding round in the short term.

  • 5+ years of professional, non-internship experience in software development.
  • 5+ years programming in at least one general-purpose language such as Java, Python, C#, Go, TypeScript, or similar.
  • 3+ years leading the design or architecture of new or existing systems.
  • Experience as a mentor, technical lead, or leading an engineering team.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish and English.

Preferred qualifications

  • Data modeling in complex transactional domains: ERP, financial systems, logistics, manufacturing, or similar.
  • Language-model-based functionality shipped to production, with systematic evaluations and acceptance metrics.
  • Experience with one or more of: AI tools for developer productivity, AWS, SQL and NoSQL databases, distributed systems, diagnosing complex production issues.
  • Having been a team's first technical hire.
  • Experience digitizing processes in traditional industries.
  • Mobile or field applications with intermittent connectivity.
  • Willingness to go out into the field on a recurring basis. The product is not validated from a desk.

description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a Senior Mechanical/Thermal Engineer to join our Directed Energy team in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The ideal candidate will have a background in thermal analysis, engineering design, and thermal controls.

The successful candidate will work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and fabricators in a research and development environment supporting advanced directed energy technologies, including high-power microwave, RF, electromagnetic, and pulsed-power systems.


Please note: This position is located on-site in Albuquerque, NM. There may be opportunity to telework occasionally.

Are you ready to make an impact? Apply and share your resume with us today!

Primary Responsibilities:

The engineer will be responsible for taking mechanical designs from concept through detailed design, fabrication, assembly, integration, and test. The position requires an individual who can work independently, communicate effectively across technical disciplines, and collaborate closely with machinists, fabricators, vendors, and other engineers to develop robust, manufacturable hardware.

Secondary responsibility for capturing cooling requirements for directed energy systems, developing thermal control systems that satisfy those requirements, supervising their construction, and conducting testing and troubleshooting on cooling equipment to verify performance. Duties may include documenting designs and presenting them to the customers, generating bills of materials and coordinating their purchase, auditing as-build systems for compliance to design, and documenting test results.

  • Create 3D solid models and detailed mechanical designs for innovative hardware, equipment, and systems, carrying designs from initial requirements and concepts through fabrication, assembly, integration, and testing.
  • Perform appropriate engineering analysis to support design decisions and verify mechanical performance.
  • Create and maintain engineering drawings, including appropriate dimensions, tolerances, and other manufacturing requirements, in accordance with company standards and customer specifications.

  • Work directly with Leidos machinists, fabricators, technicians, and external vendors to develop, procure, and support fabrication of mechanical components and assemblies.

  • Conduct FEA thermal analysis to quantify heat loads and cooling needs.
  • Design cold plates and heat exchangers to manage heat flow.
  • Conduct CFD analysis to calculate flow rates, pressure drop and heat removal.
  • Size commercial heat exchangers, fluid pumps and fans in accordance with thermal requirements and analysis.
  • Develop 3D models, drawings and flow diagrams to document the design of thermal control systems.

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or closely related field with 8+ years of experience or a master’s degree with 6+ years of experience with mechanical or thermal systems.
  • Must be a US Citizen.
  • Must meet the eligibility to obtain and maintain a Secret Clearance.
  • Demonstrated experience developing mechanical hardware from concept through detailed design, fabrication, assembly, integration, and testing
  • Proficiency with SolidWorks, including 3D part and assembly modeling and creation of detailed engineering drawings; experience with PDMWorks.
  • Working familiarity with cooling components such as heat exchangers, chillers, pumps, and cooling fans.
  • Experience applying mechanical design principles, material selection, tolerancing, and design for manufacturability in the development of fabricated hardware.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with machinists, fabricators, technicians, engineers, and scientists.
  • Experience with thermal measurement diagnostics such as thermocouples, flow gauges, and pressure sensors.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and be able to lead meetings with large groups of people.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop practical solutions to complex mechanical design, fabrication, assembly, and testing problems
  • Ability and willingness to adhere to government and company safety requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or engineering tasks while maintaining project schedules and priorities
  • Work location is predominantly Albuquerque, NM. Candidate must be a resident of, or be willing to relocate to, Albuquerque, NM.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with directed energy systems, vacuum components, and pulsed power systems.
  • Skilled in the use of Simulink to model thermal control systems.
  • Adaptable in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with SolidWorks Simulation
  • Application of GD&T to mechanical engineering drawings

title: Senior Director, Data Management
description:
Primary Role

We are seeking a Senior Director, Data Management, reporting to the Senior Vice President, Clinical Operations. This role will be responsible for the people, processes, and systems that deliver complete, accurate, and inspection-ready clinical trial data across the portfolio. This leader builds and leads a high-performing Data Management organization, shapes the delivery approach across in-house and outsourced teams, and serves as Alto’s accountable lead for Data Management during regulatory inspections and audits. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on judgment and collaborates within Clinical Operations and across key cross-functional partners, including Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Data Science, and Engineering, to drive the efficient and successful execution of clinical trials.


What you'll do

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead the Data Management function, including oversight of in-house and outsourced Data Management activities.
  • Provide coaching, performance management, goal setting, and professional development for direct reports.
  • Define and implement Data Management strategies that align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and manage Data Management budgets, including forecasting costs related to personnel, technology, and vendor services.
  • Ensure efficient allocation and utilization of internal and external Data Management resources across clinical programs.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and innovation.

Process & Quality

  • Oversee the performance of external Data Management partners and vendors, including quality, timelines, deliverables, and compliance.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain Data Management processes and workflows, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Oversee the design and management of case report forms (CRFs), data collection tools, and data validation checks to support complete, accurate, and consistent clinical trial data.
  • Oversee data cleaning activities and processes to support timely and accurate database lock.
  • Coordinate and participate in the review of clinical data and patient profiles for data consistency and accuracy.
  • Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and best practices for the Data Management function to ensure consistency and quality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Serve as the Data Management lead across key cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Biostatistics and Programming, Clinical Project Managers, Data Science, Engineering) and external partners (e.g., CROs, vendors) to ensure seamless execution of Data Management activities.
  • Provide Data Management input into clinical trial protocols, CRF design, and data collection methodologies to ensure they meet regulatory and quality standards.

Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP) and company SOPs throughout the Data Management lifecycle.
  • Ensure Data Management systems are appropriately validated and compliant with applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee Data Management activities supporting regulatory submissions and maintain inspection readiness related to clinical data and Data Management processes.
  • Serve as Alto’s accountable Data Management lead during regulatory inspections and audits, including preparation, response coordination, resolution of findings, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions, as applicable.

Risk Management & Problem Solving:

  • Identify and mitigate Data Management risks, including those related to data quality, timelines, vendors, systems, and resource constraints.
  • Develop and implement mitigation and contingency plans to address data-related challenges and minimize impact on clinical trial timelines and deliverables.
  • Proactively resolve complex data-related issues and challenges across internal teams and third-party partners.

Data Governance & Best Practices:

  • Develop and implement data governance frameworks and best practices to ensure data consistency, security, and long-term usability.
  • Promote standardization of Data Management processes across clinical trials to improve efficiency and reduce variability.
  • Stay current with industry trends, regulatory developments, innovations, and emerging technologies, and implement relevant best practices within the organization.

Location

On-site in Los Altos, CA office or REMOTE

Salary Range

$190,000 - $250,000

*depending on qualifications and experience level

Travel Required

Light Travel Required

Qualifications

Required Skills:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical data management, including at least 5 years in a leadership or management role within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to set Data Management strategy while maintaining the operational depth and hands-on judgment necessary to drive execution.
  • Experience building or scaling a Data Management function, including transitioning activities between outsourced and in-house operating models.
  • Proven experience managing clinical data across Phase I–IV clinical trials, including global studies, with significant experience supporting Phase 3 trials and NDA submissions.
  • Experience evaluating, selecting, implementing, and validating clinical data management systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory requirements, including ICH-GCP and 21 CFR Part 11, and their application to clinical Data Management.
  • Experience in CNS therapeutic areas; psychiatry experience preferred.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Demonstrated people management experience, including direct supervision, coaching, performance management, and professional development of Data Management professionals.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams and effectively manage resources across multiple clinical programs.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Advanced degree (e.g., MS, PhD, or MBA) preferred
  • Clinical Data Management certifications preferred

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

  • Required to sit for prolonged periods of time.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the noise level in the work environment is usually quiet

title: Enterprise Security Architect
description:
Enterprise Security Architect

The Opportunity:

Security must be architected, not bolted on. You understand how to embed security into every layer of an enterprise system, from data pathways to identity flows, to network segmentation and cloud control planes. We are seeking an Enterprise Security Architect to design security solutions for clients with complex network, platform, and data-protection needs by implementing solutions that withstand advanced cyber threats. In this role, you will help define, enhance, implement, and maintain security solutions for one or more networks and technology platforms while guiding adherence to information security policies and procedures.


In this role, you will apply risk modeling and secure design methodologies to develop tailored controls for client and industry exposures, then translate those designs into practical architectures for network and application deployments. You will advise on security technologies and communicate security complexities clearly to technical teams, stakeholders, and senior management. You will partner with engineering teams, cybersecurity SMEs, cloud or platform owners, and business stakeholders. You’ll assess current-state environments, identify architectural gaps, evaluate emerging technologies, and build roadmaps that advance enterprise security maturity. This is an opportunity to shape hardened systems that support the mission, and to learn from a team of experts while doing it.

Join us. The world can’t wait.


You Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity
  • 3+ years of experience in security architecture or security design
  • Experience designing enterprise-scale secure cloud or hybrid architectures and developing architecture documents such as diagrams, models, SSPs, and data flows
  • Experience with network security appliances using technologies such as F5 or Palo Alto
  • Experience with data security engineering, including DLP, encryption at rest and in transit, and tokenization
  • Experience with security technologies such as HSMs, SASE, and cloud security platforms
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust architectures, NIST SP 800‑53 or 800‑207, and secure engineering principles
  • Knowledge of enterprise information security architecture, information assurance, and network security
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with cloud security platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience with enterprise logging, SIEM or SOAR integrations, and detection engineering alignment
  • Experience supporting compliance or accreditation processes, including RMF, ATO, FedRAMP, and ICD 503
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies and DevSecOps practices
  • Experience with container or Kubernetes security and micro-segmentation
  • Experience creating reusable secure architecture patterns or reference designs
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and priorities
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, and COBIT
  • TS/SCI clearance

title: Business Analyst, Infrastructure & Pricing Strategy
description:
About Cantina:

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential that AI brings in shaping human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About the Role:
Cantina is hiring a Business Analyst to help shape our infrastructure strategy and the pricing & monetization framework behind our product offerings. As a member of our finance team, you will work closely with both our external infrastructure and compute providers and our internal engineering teams to help us evaluate, forecast, and optimize our evolving compute needs across inference and training as we scale the business.

As we expand our product offerings across dynamic video, images, and new modalities, each brings distinct compute requirements, cost structures, and monetization considerations. Understanding these dynamics and translating them into a scalable, economically sustainable business model is critical to our growth.

This role is a great fit for someone with a deep understanding of compute economics and infrastructure pricing dynamics from both a technical and commercial perspective. The ideal candidate will have first-hand experience navigating these complexities at an AI or cloud infrastructure company and is eager to take on greater ownership at a fast-growing startup, working at the intersection of finance, engineering, and product strategy.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build unit-level economic models across each compute modality (video, image, voice, text) to inform usage-based pricing and monetization strategies for new products and customers

  • Evaluate and help negotiate infrastructure agreements with compute and cloud providers, including spend commitments, capacity requirements, rate cards, and commercial terms

  • Partner with engineering, business, and finance teams to forecast infrastructure needs, optimize compute spend, monitor margins, and proactively identify deviations from our operating plan

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2-4 years in strategy, business operations, or finance within a fast-growing tech company, ideally in AI or cloud infrastructure

  • Hands-on experience with usage-based pricing or infrastructure contracts, with an understanding of how compute is purchased, metered, and billed

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets (SQL is a plus)

  • Degree in finance, economics, or a related quantitative field

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and an enthusiasm for building from the ground up in a fast-paced startup environment

  • A collaborative, team-first mindset and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams

Compensation:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is between $110,000-$130,000. When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and generous company equity

  • 42 days of paid time off, including:

    • 10 sick days

  • Generous parental leave & fertility support

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan

  • Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like

  • Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees

  • One Medical membership, and more!

title: Systems Administrator
description:
About Mach Industries

Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

We are seeking a Systems Administrator to support the implementation, administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise IT infrastructure. This role is responsible for day-to-day operations across servers, cloud and on-prem systems, identity and access management, endpoint administration, monitoring, patching, backup, and user support. This person will help ensure systems remain secure, available, and well-managed by following established standards, documenting procedures, troubleshooting issues, and executing repeatable operational tasks. You will be responsible for maintaining the technical environment, supporting reliable service delivery, and assisting with the operational processes required to keep IT running effectively across a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, including servers, core services, and business-critical systems.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the helpdesk team by troubleshooting and resolving advanced infrastructure, system, and endpoint issues in a timely manner.
  • Manage user accounts, group policies, permissions, and identity services to ensure secure and reliable access to company resources.
  • Perform routine system maintenance activities such as patching, backups, upgrades, monitoring, and performance tuning.
  • Support endpoint and device management processes, including provisioning, configuration, software deployment, and standards enforcement.
  • Create and maintain accurate system documentation, operational procedures, inventory records, knowledge base content, and configuration standards to support consistent administration and support.
  • Assist with security and compliance efforts by applying hardening standards, responding to operational findings, and supporting audit readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of systems administration, infrastructure administration.
  • Experience supporting core infrastructure services such as Active Directory, Microsoft 365, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file services, and endpoint management platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across servers, operating systems, identity, networking, and endpoint devices, with the ability to serve as an escalation point for helpdesk issues.
  • Working knowledge of security best practices, patch management, backup and recovery, access control, and system hardening.
  • Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and support knowledge base materials.
  • Strong communication and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in regulated or compliance-driven environments such as defense, manufacturing, aerospace, or similar industries.
  • Exposure to security and compliance frameworks including NIST 800-171, CMMC, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or related standards.
  • Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure environments that include both on-premises systems and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP.
  • Familiarity with enterprise endpoint management, mobile device management, and software deployment tools such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms, backup systems, and infrastructure monitoring tools in a production environment.
  • Working knowledge of scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or similar tools to streamline administrative tasks.
  • Experience developing or improving technical documentation, operational runbooks, and internal knowledge base content.
  • Industry certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA, VMware, or cloud platform certifications are a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
