title: Product Manager, Payments
description:
About the Role

As a Product Manager, you will own a defined product area and be responsible for delivering meaningful outcomes for customers and the business. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and other stakeholders to understand customer needs, shape product direction, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex customer and business problems, making thoughtful product decisions, and collaborating across teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. While you will receive guidance on broader product strategy, you will be expected to independently lead product discovery, prioritization, execution, and continuous improvement within your product area.

Success in this role is measured by the outcomes you create for customers and the business through strong product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and reliable execution.

What You’ll Do

Own Customer Problems

  • Develop a deep understanding of customers through research, observation, data, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Clearly define customer problems and identify opportunities to improve the product.
  • Validate assumptions and solutions through customer insights, experimentation, and data.

Product Strategy & Prioritization

  • Translate customer and business needs into prioritized product initiatives.
  • Evaluate solution options and make informed tradeoff decisions based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
  • Define clear product requirements, success metrics, and launch criteria.

Deliver Results

  • Own initiatives from discovery through launch, measuring outcomes and continuously improving the product based on customer feedback and data.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality software.

Collaborate & Communicate

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships across Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, Support, and Operations.
  • Communicate priorities, decisions, risks, and progress clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify dependencies, manage tradeoffs, and help teams stay aligned.

Take Ownership

  • Independently own a defined product area with increasing autonomy, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term product health.
  • Continuously improve your product management practices through feedback, learning, and data-driven decision making.

In Payments, Specifically

  • Own a defined area of the payments platform end to end, which may include settlement, reconciliation against dealer accounting systems, disputes, processor integrations, or payments reporting.
  • Own the economics of that area alongside the experience. Understand what we earn and what we pay, make your case in commercial terms, and quantify risk and exposure so the business can decide on it.

You do not need payments experience. You will need to learn a complicated domain fast, be precise about money, and think commercially by instinct.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Management or a related role within SaaS or enterprise software. We will consider strong candidates from payment operations, implementation, solutions engineering, or business analysis where the work was substantively product work.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver customer and business outcomes through cross-functional product development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-informed product decisions.
  • Experience defining product requirements, prioritizing work, and measuring success through product metrics.
  • Experience conducting customer interviews, usability testing, or other product discovery activities.
  • Proficiency with modern product, design, and AI-assisted tools to accelerate product discovery, communication, and execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with evolving priorities.

At myKaarma, Product Managers are expected to be curious, customer-centric, collaborative, and outcome driven. We value product managers who seek to deeply understand customer problems, make thoughtful decisions grounded in evidence, and continuously improve both their products and themselves.

Nice to Have Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in automotive technology or enterprise SaaS ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with API platforms, developer experience, or integration frameworks.
  • Background in CX optimization, automation, or partner ecosystems.


We know great candidates don't always match every requirement. If this role excites you and your experience aligns with many of the qualifications, we'd encourage you to apply. Skills can be learned—we also value curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to grow.





Total Rewards at myKaarma


At myKaarma, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that extends beyond the base salary. Our commitment to competitive compensation includes bonuses and benefits that support both personal and professional well-being:


  • Flexible Work Environment: We embrace a high-performance, flexible structure that values freedom and responsibility. Our “Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled” model empowers teams to innovate and continuously improve using data-driven insights.
  • Health and Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits, along with wellness and telework stipends.
  • Time Off: Generous vacation time to recharge and balance life outside work.
  • In-Office Perks: Enjoy unlimited snacks and refreshments when in our office.


Our Commitment to Inclusion


At myKaarma, diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and inclusive workplace where every employee feels valued and empowered and can do meaningful work. Our mission to deliver exceptional solutions to our clients is strengthened by the unique contributions and perspectives of our team members from all backgrounds.


As an equal opportunity employer, myKaarma prohibits any form of unlawful discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable laws in the regions where we operate. We adhere to all EEOC regulations and actively promote an environment that celebrates and supports diversity, equity, and inclusion for all.


Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. Reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done, which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on myKaarma. title: Systems Engineer

description:
Company Description

Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SOSi is a private defense and government solutions business specializing in advanced technology systems and mission support. Its capabilities include data science, software development, network engineering, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and logistics.

Job Description

SOSi is on the hunt for a forward-thinking Systems Engineer to help shape the future of Command and Control (C2) IT solutions at Joint Base Pearl Harbor Hickam. You’ll be part of a high-impact team supporting over 5,000 users across the Pacific theater, solving complex technical challenges that drive mission-critical operations.

In this role, you’ll lead the charge in developing and maintaining a robust enterprise infrastructure and private cloud platform. You’ll collaborate with senior DoD personnel, deliver executive-level briefings, and ensure compliance with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and Data Centric Security Principles.

If you're ready to innovate at the edge of defense technology and make a real-world impact, this is your moment!

  • Customer-service oriented with a willingness to participate and assist.
  • Able to follow instructions and work both independently and in a (distributed) team environment.
  • Team-player and able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing.
  • Attention to detail. Excellent planning and time-management skills.
  • Able to support 24/7 operations (including support to exercises), when necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional IT certifications in relevant technology platform (e.g., Network+, Citrix, Dell, HPE/Aruba, ITIL, Juniper, Microsoft, Nutanix, Palo Alto, VMware).
  • Experience with Forcepoint/Everfox Trusted Thin Clinent.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA).
  • Familiarity with VDI/Virtual Environments and solutions (VMware Horizon, Citrix VDI).
  • Familiarity with Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI), Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) and C2 applications.
  • Experience in ITIL framework and best practices (e.g., Change Management, Configuration Management, Capacity Planning).
  • Experience using Help Desk software (e.g., Jira, Remedy, ServiceNow).
Additional Information

Work Environment

  • Working conditions are normal for an office environment.
  • Fast paced, deadline-oriented environment.
  • May require foreign travel and site visits.
  • May require periods of non-traditional working hours including consecutive nights or weekends.

Working at SOSi

All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.

title: Director, Research Strategic Collaborations
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is seeking a motivated Director, Research Strategic Collaborations to advance Research priorities through external scientific collaborations, coordinated scientific engagement, and effective cross-functional partnerships.

Reporting to Senior Director, Research Scientific Liaison and working closely with Research leadership, this individual will evaluate and manage academic collaborations, coordinate collaborative external disclosures, and implement processes that strengthen collaboration execution and portfolio visibility.

The ideal candidate combines oncology drug discovery expertise with sound scientific judgment, strong operational capabilities, and excellent relationship-building skills. This role requires the ability to translate complex science into actionable recommendations, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and independently manage multiple scientific workstreams.

  • Support implementation of an external collaboration strategy aligned with corporate, portfolio, and Research priorities.

  • Facilitate the identification of potential academic partners offering differentiated expertise, technologies, models, or biological insights.

  • Assess the scientific merit, quality, and relevance of collaboration proposals. Triage proposals for unique partner capabilities, resource requirements, and potential impact; Develop recommendations for leadership review.

  • Thought partner with internal scientists and external investigators to define research objectives, deliverables, milestones, and decision points.

  • Manage designated collaborations, facilitating scientific discussions, tracking experimental progress, and coordinating issue resolution.

  • Coordinate contract execution with Research, Legal, and other stakeholders to support sponsored research agreements, material transfer agreements, NDAs, consulting agreements.

  • Conduct periodic collaboration assessments and lead portfolio reviews, informing recommendations to continue, expand, redirect, or conclude partnerships.

  • Maintain productive relationships with external investigators and institutional stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment with internal priorities.

  • Implement consistent collaboration management practices, including clear responsibilities, review timelines, documentation, and escalation pathways.

  • Establish and maintain portfolio dashboards and prepare updates on collaboration progress, to track scientific engagement updates to support prioritization and resource decisions.

  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, accountability, and visibility across scientific engagement activities.

  • Plan and lead scientific engagements, such as invited speaker seminar series, roundtables, and advisory boards, from planning through execution, aligning internal stakeholders and coordinating external contributors to achieve defined scientific objectives aligned with Research priorities.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of the Research portfolio to anticipate stakeholder needs and support effective coordination.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • PhD in cancer biology, molecular biology, pharmacology, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 12 years of relevant experience, including at least 8 years in biotechnology or pharmaceuticals.

  • Strong foundation in oncology drug discovery and an understanding of how preclinical and translational research informs clinical development.

  • Demonstrated experience managing scientific collaborations, research programs, or complex cross-functional initiatives.

  • Ability to critically evaluate scientific proposals, identify key data gaps, and develop clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Proven ability to build productive relationships and influence scientific experts, cross-functional stakeholders, and external partners without direct authority.

  • Excellent scientific writing, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to tailor complex information to diverse audiences.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and recognize when leadership input is needed.

  • Ability to translate strategic direction into practical plans and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience managing academic collaborations, sponsored research agreements, material transfer agreements, or portfolio planning.

  • Familiarity with RAS biology, targeted oncology therapeutics, and translational research.

  • Experience developing collaboration assessments, portfolio metrics, dashboards, and operating processes.

  • Experience engaging academic investigators and institutional stakeholders within the oncology research community.

title: IT Operations and Project Coordinator, IT Infrastructure
description:
What The Role Is

The IT Operations and Project Coordinator is a key member of the IT Infrastructure team at Clearway Energy Group (CEG). This position is primarily responsible for the successful delivery of strategic and operational IT infrastructure initiatives across CEG. This position reflects accountability in organizing, tracking, and facilitating infrastructure operations & projects that span the company’s corporate offices, data centers, and renewable energy sites across the U.S.

The IT Operations and Project Coordinator works closely with managers, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to help coordinate planning efforts, track deliverables, manage project logistics, and ensure timely communication. The role plays a critical part in ensuring infrastructure operations and projects stay on schedule, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

Functions include oversight and working with infrastructure teams to develop functional and technical requirements; allocating systems resources; managing accounts and documentation; and ensuring the rigorous application of information security policies and practices.

In addition to project delivery, this role owns IT procurement, telecommunications management, and related administrative functions for the IT Infrastructure team, including vendor and contract administration, purchasing support, and purchasing reclassifications.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and work breakdown structures across multiple IT infrastructure initiatives.
  • Coordinate and schedule project meetings, stakeholder check-ins, and resource planning sessions.
  • Serve as a central communication point between technical teams, stakeholders, and vendors, ensuring alignment on priorities and deliverables.
  • Track and follow up on project tasks, deadlines, and assigned actions to keep projects on schedule.
  • Maintain project documentation, including meeting minutes, action items, risk logs, and status updates.
  • Prepare project reports and dashboards for IT leadership with insights on progress, risks, and dependencies.
  • Administer the use of project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, ServiceNow).
  • Coordinate with Procurement on PO creation, invoice tracking, and vendor communications.
  • Support vendor scheduling and project-related logistics (e.g., onsite activities, shipping, resource onboarding).
  • Draft internal project communications and rollout plans for infrastructure changes that impact users.
  • Coordinate end-user communication, ensuring updates are timely, clear, and aligned with standards.
  • Maintain the IT Infrastructure vendor and contract portfolio: track renewals, support pricing and terms reviews, coordinate with Corporate Procurement and Legal agreements, and monitor vendor performance.
  • Own day-to-day telecom management for corporate offices, data centers, and renewable energy sites, including carrier and vendor relationships, voice and data circuits, SD-WAN/MPLS, and cellular services.
  • Coordinate telecom service orders, installations, moves/adds/changes, outage tickets, and disconnects with carriers and internal teams, and maintain accurate circuit, service, and equipment inventories.
  • Review telecom and IT vendor invoices against contracts and service orders and resolve billing discrepancies with carriers and vendors.
  • Review IT purchasing and invoice coding to identify miscoded or misclassified charges (e.g., GL accounts, cost centers, project codes, capex vs. opex).
  • Support month-end and year-end close for IT Infrastructure spend, including accruals, invoice reconciliation, budget tracking and forecasting, and variance reporting to IT leadership.

What You'll Bring

This role requires a strong working knowledge of the following:

  • Proven ability to coordinate multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Skilled in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, ServiceNow).
  • Generating project dashboards and executive summaries.
  • ITIL framework
  • Excellent organizational skills to manage multiple tasks, timelines, and resources simultaneously.
  • Manage project budgets and make informed decisions to ensure the project stays on budget.
  • Working knowledge of telecommunications services and carrier contracts (voice, data circuits, SD-WAN, wireless).
  • Understanding of accounts payable, purchasing, and general ledger coding, including cost center reconciliation.
  • Strong incident management skills and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Exceptional work ethic and time management skills.
  • Ability to work well independently and/or as part of a team.
  • Strong commitment to customer service.
  • Ability to travel 10% of the time, and on short notice.

What Would Be Nice

  • An associate or bachelor’s degree in information systems or a similar field is preferred. Significant experience in key Information Technology competencies will be considered in place of a formal degree.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting IT Infrastructure and Software in an enterprise environment.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent.

No visa sponsorship or any kind of sponsorship for employment authorization is available for this role, now or in the future.

title: OpenShift Platform Engineer (Systems)
description:
Job#: 3055256

Job Description:


Candidates must be U.S. citizens able to obtain and/or maintain a Department of Defense security clearance as a condition and continuation of employment.

OpenShift Platform Engineer (Systems)

Location: Radford, Virginia (Remote)

Role Overview

This position is for a Platform Engineer supporting a program operating a containerized, Kubernetes-based, multitenant hosting environment. This environment is used for enterprise and distributed applications across multiple global locations. The Platform Engineer will be instrumental in designing, building, operating, and securing the Kubernetes platform that supports mission-critical workloads.

Key Responsibilities
  • Work with engineering teams to design, develop, and maintain a Kubernetes-based enterprise hosting architecture.
  • Develop, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to support provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes clusters and platform services.
  • Provide daily administration of Kubernetes clusters, including patching, upgrades, and maintenance of all core components.
  • Configure and manage Container Network Interface (CNI) plugins such as Calico, Cilium, or OpenShift SDN.
  • Deploy and maintain Container Storage Interface (CSI) drivers to support dynamic provisioning of persistent storage.
  • Monitor consumption of compute, storage, and networking resources and notify leadership when additional capacity is required.
  • Harden Kubernetes clusters and associated components in accordance with best practices and required cybersecurity controls.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues related to Kubernetes networking, container workloads, persistent storage, and runtime environments.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, including architectures, diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide on-call production support for after-hours incidents and escalation.
Required Qualifications


Clearance: Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance as a condition or continuation of employment.


Education: A Bachelor’s degree or higher in an IT-related field is required.

Experience: Senior-level hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, Rancher, or upstream Kubernetes is required. Experience deploying and managing CSI drivers for dynamic persistent storage provisioning is also necessary.

Technical Skills: The role requires strong IaC experience using Helm, Kustomize, Terraform, and GitOps tools like Argo CD or Flux. Candidates must have strong troubleshooting skills across Kubernetes networking, container runtimes, persistent storage, and platform services. Familiarity with Kubernetes persistent storage ecosystems and observability tools is required.

Certifications: A Security+ or equivalent Level II certification is required. A relevant Computing Environment certification such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration must be obtained within 6 months of hire.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts including CNIs, service discovery, ingress controllers, and network policies.
  • Proven experience building and administering enterprise-grade Kubernetes clusters.
  • Experience with container orchestration technologies such as Docker, Podman, or Kubernetes.
  • Experience managing container registries like Harbor or Quay.
  • Automation proficiency using Ansible, Terraform, Python, or similar tools.
  • Working knowledge of industry-standard hardening practices.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps processes and integrating Kubernetes workloads into CI/CD pipelines.

title: Principal UI/UX Designer
description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Zuora is rethinking how enterprise software is designed and experienced as we move toward becoming an AI-native company. We are looking for an exceptional Sr./Principal Product Designer who can help define the next generation of product experiences.

This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional screens, navigation and workflows and rethink how customers interact with software when AI can understand intent, make recommendations and take action.

We want a designer who combines outstanding design craft, strong product thinking and curiosity about AI—someone who can challenge conventional approaches and turn new possibilities into intuitive, valuable customer experiences.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Design AI-Native Experiences: Rethink traditional enterprise workflows and interaction models, creating intelligent, intent-driven and agentic experiences that help customers accomplish complex business tasks.
  • Translate AI into Trusted Experiences: Design how AI assists, recommends and takes action, with appropriate transparency, human oversight and customer control—particularly in mission-critical financial workflows.
  • Influence Product Direction: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data and AI teams from early concept through delivery. Challenge assumptions, shape product decisions and translate customer problems into innovative solutions.
  • Elevate Design Excellence: Bring exceptional interaction design, visual design, information architecture and prototyping skills. Evolve Zuora's design system to support new AI-native patterns and consistent experiences.
  • Stay Close to Customers: Engage directly with enterprise customers, understand complex workflows and validate that new experiences solve meaningful business problems.


About You

  • Significant experience designing sophisticated digital products, ideally enterprise SaaS or complex workflow platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-powered products or the ability to envision how AI and agentic technologies fundamentally change product experiences.
  • Excellent prototyping and visual storytelling skills to test product and user experience ideas and drive internal alignment around product craft and user outcome
  • Exceptional design craft and a portfolio demonstrating original thinking, strong interaction design and customer-centered problem solving.
  • Strong product instincts and the ability to influence what gets built, not just how it looks and works.
  • Technically curious, with an understanding of modern AI capabilities and their implications for product design.
  • Proven ability to work closely with Product and Engineering and take concepts from exploration through execution.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, experimentation and challenging established conventions.

What Success Looks Like

Establishing new design approaches for AI-native enterprise experiences, influencing product direction and helping Zuora deliver simpler, more intelligent and more valuable customer experiences.

Benefits

Job Summary:

LifeSafety Management is seeking a detail-oriented Service Billing & Cash Applications Coordinator to support our Boynton Beach, FL office. This in-office role reports to the Accounting Supervisor and works closely with service operations, dispatch, service technicians, customers, and branch leadership.

This position is responsible for the timely and accurate billing of completed service calls, including repair, troubleshooting, and emergency service work, and for maintaining accurate customer billing records. The ideal candidate is highly organized, task-driven, and able to manage multiple priorities while ensuring billing accuracy, timely invoice turnaround, and outstanding customer service.

This position is primarily office-based and involves prolonged periods of computer work, frequent communication with internal personnel by phone and email, and regular use of online portals, tracking systems, and office software. The role requires strong attention to detail, effective multitasking, the ability to manage competing deadlines, and occasional lifting of office materials up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare, review, and process invoices for completed service calls, including repair, troubleshooting, and emergency/after-hours service work.
  • Verify service tickets, technician labor hours, parts and materials used, trip charges, customer purchase orders, and billing rates prior to invoicing.
  • Submit invoices through customer billing portals and maintain compliance with customer invoicing requirements.
  • Review closed service calls daily to ensure all completed work is billed promptly and no tickets are left unbilled.
  • Research and resolve service call billing discrepancies, disputed charges, and credit/rebill requests.
  • Confirm service call rates and terms against customer agreements and approved quotes before billing.
  • Work closely with service managers, coordinators, and technicians to resolve billing questions and documentation issues.
  • Support collections efforts by providing service call invoice copies, technician documentation, and billing backup to customers and the accounts receivable team.
  • Maintain accurate customer billing records, tax-exempt certificates, and account information.
  • Track and report on unbilled service calls and billing backlog.
  • Support month-end closing activities related to service call billing, including unbilled work and billing cutoff.
  • Generate and distribute customer account statements as needed.
  • Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with special projects and other accounting or administrative duties as assigned.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • 2-5 years of experience in service billing, preferably billing service calls or field service work orders.
  • Experience processing high-volume service call invoicing.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and financial recordkeeping.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve billing discrepancies independently.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interaction with customers and internal teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work consistently in an in-office environment.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a sense of urgency and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the fire and life safety, construction, service, or field service industries.
  • Experience with Solutions Q360 or similar ERP/accounting systems.
  • Familiarity with time-and-materials billing, parts pricing, and service ticket documentation.
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

This role may require extended periods of sitting or standing, movement around the office or job site, and operation of standard equipment. Physical activities can include reaching, bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting up to 75 lbs. Field positions may involve heavy lifting, working in varying climates (including outdoor conditions), construction or low-voltage environments, and exposure to dust, noise, or confined spaces. Personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required. Some roles may require travel.

title: Western Canada Irrigation Lead
description:
Your Opportunity

As a part of our Western Canada Irrigation team, this person will have the opportunity to work on the recently awarded Westside Irrigation Rehabilitation Project (WIRP) in Saskatchewan. Stantec (as a part of Prairie Engineering Partners) will be responsible for completing the fieldwork, planning and engineering to the next stage of project design. The right candidate will have technical skills and experience that can be applied to the delivery of water conveyance projects related to irrigation and irrigation planning for government, municipal, and private sector clients. Projects may include greenfield infrastructure, expansion/upgrades to existing systems, and rehabilitation. The successful candidate is expected to have knowledge and experience working on similar projects. As the Western Canada Irrigation Leader, your tasks will include but are not limited to, leading and undertaking engineering studies, engineering design and document preparation, and related fieldwork or investigations as required.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the preparation of engineering reports, drawings, and specifications related to irrigation planning, design, and other related water resources and conveyance projects.
  • Working collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams, clients or other consultants.
  • Coordinating and attending field work or field investigations where required.
  • Lead client management, business development and proposal preparation.
  • Assisting in recruiting and developing the irrigation specialization across the water team.
  • Mentoring, training and/or supervision of intermediate or junior engineers.
  • Attending in-house and formal training sessions to ensure continuing professional development.
  • Adhering to Stantec’s Environmental Health and Safety protocols and processes.
  • Travelling occasionally within Alberta and western Canada.

Capabilities and Credentials

  • Proven irrigation system planning and design experience.
  • Experience in other related water conveyance or agriculture/agri-food projects is considered an asset.
  • Understanding of all phases of project implementation, and strong understanding of engineering design processes.
  • Understanding of soil water relationships
  • Experienced with hydraulic analysis/modeling.
  • Excellent communication, written, and presentation skills.
  • Collaborative in nature, with the ability to work effectively with multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with the ability to motivate and lead others.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office software suite. Experience with Microsoft Project is an asset.
  • Experience with design software and tools such as AutoCAD Civil3D is an asset.
  • Experience with hydraulic/hydrologic modeling software (MikeUrban, PCSWMM, StormCAD, WaterCAD, XPSWMM, etc.) is an asset.
  • Valid Class 5 Drivers License.

Education and Experience

  • The successful candidate will have a minimum of 8 years of experience working on water resources or conveyance projects, with a strong emphasis on irrigation planning and design.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Civil or Agricultural Engineering or equivalent is required.

  • Registered as a P.Eng with APEGA in the Province of Alberta and/or with APEGS in the Province of Saskatchewan.

title: Data Engineer, ADF and Integrations
description:
Duracell is an iconic brand and the world’s leading manufacturer of high-performance alkaline batteries, power cells, and rechargeables. We are the most trusted source of personal power because of our sustained commitment to innovation, producing more compact, more powerful, and longer lasting batteries.

Join our Global Commercial Applications team in India as a Data Engineer, ADF and Integrations, and be the person who makes sure the numbers behind Duracell’s trade promotions are right.

You will own the Azure Data Factory pipelines and the integrations that feed our Salesforce Trade Promotion Management platform, as the India-hours counterpart to our Senior Data Engineer in Mexico. You will also own the KPI logic, reporting and sales performance data that our commercial organisation uses to plan and measure trade promotions. You are accountable for the numbers being right, not only for the pipelines running.

As AI takes on more routine work, this role matters even more: you will own both the data that reaches the platform and the metric definitions that give it meaning (the semantic layer), the context without which automated analysis cannot be trusted.

Why you’ll like this role:

  • Real ownership: your pipelines, metrics and reconciliations are what the commercial and finance teams rely on.
  • Work at the intersection of data engineering, CRM and commercial finance (Salesforce, SAP and planning systems).
  • A role with a future: define the metrics and quality checks that make AI-generated analysis reliable.
  • Work with colleagues from different cultures and time zones around the globe, with a daily overlap with the European team (working hours are approximately 11:00–20:00 IST).
  • Own and maintain KPI logic, reports and dashboards for Trade Promotion Management and sales performance.
  • Build and maintain the Azure Data Factory pipelines serving Trade Promotion Management and Consumer Goods Cloud, including validation, error handling and monitoring.
  • Operate the integrations that move data between Salesforce, SAP and the planning systems, including the master data and actuals feeds.
  • Run and validate KPI and cost uploads, and reconcile actuals against source systems.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies raised by the commercial teams, including during budget and claims season.
  • Own metric definitions and documentation, so that the same measure means the same thing across markets.
  • Review every AI-generated figure that reaches a financial report; this work does not move to sampling.
  • Build and maintain the validation rules and reconciliation checks that catch errors before users do.
  • Act as the India-hours escalation point for pipeline and integration incidents, working with the Senior Data Engineer in Mexico.
  • Support test scenarios for connected platform changes such as S/4 master data and the PBCS feed.
  • Set your own objectives and timings to meet the reporting outcomes agreed with the IT Lead, working independently and escalating complex cases.
  • Proactively propose and implement improvements to reporting, reconciliation and data quality, rather than reporting the same issues repeatedly.
  • Interpret procedures where a situation requires it, and adjust systems and processes to improve the reliability of the numbers.
  • Communicate with commercial and finance colleagues outside Commercial Applications, and with vendors in coordination with the IT Lead.
  • Provide guidance and training to more junior colleagues, and lead the team on metric definitions and reconciliation practice.

Expected contributions

  • Pipelines and feeds reaching the platform are complete, on time and reconciled, with the monitoring to prove it.
  • The numbers are right, not only the reports running: actuals reconciled against source systems.
  • Metric definitions owned and consistent across markets (the semantic layer automated analysis depends on).
  • Every AI-generated figure that reaches a financial report is reviewed; this work does not move to sampling.
  • Validation rules and reconciliation checks catch errors before users do.
  • University degree or equivalent training in the discipline of work, with a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Broad theoretical and practical knowledge of data engineering and of the related reporting, integration and commercial finance disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines in Azure Data Factory, including parameterised pipelines, error handling and monitoring.
  • Practical experience of integration patterns between a CRM platform and an ERP.
  • Strong SQL, and hands-on experience building reports and dashboards over commercial data.
  • Experience with Salesforce reporting or CRM Analytics; Salesforce Administrator certification preferred.
  • Experience reconciling financial or sales actuals between systems.
  • Understanding of trade promotion metrics (spend, volume, lift, tactics, claims) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting a global user base across multiple time zones. Working hours are approximately 11:00–20:00 IST, giving a daily overlap with the European team.
  • Exposure to SAP order to cash or finance data is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking skills, and strong attention to detail.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and additional benefits.
  • The chance to work in a startup environment with the world’s #1 battery company, under the Berkshire Hathaway portfolio.
  • Medical insurance covering you, your dependents and your parents or in-laws, subject to company policy.
  • Term and life insurance (subject to provider terms and conditions).
  • Accident insurance.
  • Mobile SIM/data card, subject to company policy.
  • Hybrid working model.

title: Undersea Systems Modeling and Simulation Engineer
company: Applied Research Laboratory at the Penn State University
description:
We are searching for motivated and talented team members with science, technology, engineering, acoustics, or mathematics (STEM) based education and background to join the Undersea Systems Simulation (USS) Department of the Model-Based Engineering (MBE) Division in the Undersea Systems Office (USO) at Penn State’s Applied Research Laboratory (ARL). We support our national security and undersea warfare sponsors through the development and demonstration of science and technology with the expertise, tools, and processes to take concepts from the early developmental phase through transition to industry and the fleet.

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

You will:

  • Design, setup, and execute transient, physics-based computer simulation studies to investigate a wide range of metrics associated with undersea engagements

  • Perform modeling, simulation, and analyses of undersea systems for a variety of Department of Defense (DoD) applications

  • Analyze simulation study results and condense results into cohesive conclusions and actionable recommendations

  • Perform system-level operability and Concept of Operations (CONOPS) based studies and analysis of results

  • Analyze, design, and implement computational models (vehicle dynamics, sound propagation, signal processing, etc.) associated with undersea systems modeling and simulation

  • Integrate and analyze vehicle software (operational code) including guidance and control, signal processing, and vehicle controller into larger digital simulations

  • Utilize modeling and simulation (M&S) using physics-based software models and software in the loop (SWIL) simulations. No hardware and/or hardware-in-the-loop is involved with the position

Additional responsibilities for the higher-level position include:

  • Working with more complex scenarios

  • Performing more in-depth analyses

  • Managing more concurrent tasking

Required skills/experience areas include:

  • A degree in an area of study related to Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Engineering Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Acoustics, or Computer Science

  • Ability to understand complex and/or ill-defined systems, develop action plans to resolve questions about those systems, and deliver concrete findings and guidance from studies to stakeholders and customers

  • Creativity in problem solving, including the ability to absorb a broad range of information

  • Inquisitive, proactive, and interested in learning new tools, techniques, and problem domains

  • Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication and presentation skills.

  • Well-organized, independent, and ready to work

  • Comfortable working in an environment where problems are often not initially well-defined

Preferred skills/experience areas include:

  • Modelling vehicle dynamics, signal processing, sound propagation, undersea acoustics, reverberation, sonar arrays, numerical analysis & methods, statistics, autonomy algorithms, and/or computational physics

  • Programming for engineering applications and scientific applications (FORTRAN, C, C++, Ada, Matlab, Python, and/or Simulink, etc.)

  • Willingness to concurrently work multiple projects (usually 2-3)

  • Ability to work closely with small cadre of highly trained professionals to meet challenging design and program objectives

  • Current eligibility for access to classified information at the Secret level or higher and may be subject to a government background investigation to upgrade clearance eligibility, if required

Your working location will be fully onsite, located in State College, PA. Questions related to flexible work should be directed to the hiring manager during the interview process. This role may require periodic travel.

MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS

If filled as Research and Development Engineer - Simulation and Modeling (ARL) - Intermediate Professional, this position requires: Bachelor's Degree - Engineering or Science 2+ years of relevant experience Required Certifications: None If filled as Research and Development Engineer - Simulation and Modeling (ARL) - Professional, this position requires: Bachelor's Degree - Engineering or Science No prior relevant work experience required Required Certifications: None

All-Source Intelligence Analyst

Threats to our military are regularly evolving and becoming more complex. What if you could apply your proficiency to weaken these developing threats and contribute to the security of our country’s dynamic military resources? With all the information accessible today, it takes a capable specialist to know how to collect, organize, and present data concisely to clients. If you have professional or military experience in analysis, along with a can-do mindset, we have an opportunity for you to use those skills to help enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of senior government and military decisionmakers and planners, and support real-world missions in a dynamic, client environment.


As an all-source intelligence analyst on our team, you will conduct all-source analysis of doctrine, strategy, plans, policies, objectives, goals, intentions, command authorities, force structures, and resources relating to current, emerging, and future chemical programs and capabilities.


You will be part of a unique multi-discipline team, assisting partners to fuse operations and intelligence information to enhance government efforts against emerging threats and counterproliferation efforts. title: Construction Project Manager

The Group also delivers significant precast packages for data centres, battery energy storage system (BESS) developments and other major civil, energy and infrastructure projects throughout Ireland and the UK.


Shay Murtagh Precast continues to secure major, high-profile projects, resulting in a strong pipeline of work and an exciting opportunity for a Construction Project Manager to join our team and contribute to their successful delivery. The successful candidate should have an engineering or construction background, with a minimum of five years’ relevant experience, including setting-out and site experience, together with proven project-management capability.


Role Purpose:

The Construction Project Manager is accountable for the safe, commercially controlled and timely delivery of allocated projects from pre-construction and internal handover through design coordination, manufacture, logistics, site installation, commissioning and final close-out. The postholder will manage complex projects including large concrete storage tanks, lift cores, data-centre infrastructure and other bespoke precast and civil-engineering works.


Working closely with Commercial, QS, Design, Production, Logistics, Health and Safety, Quality and site-delivery teams, the Construction Project Manager will establish a clear delivery strategy and ensure that project scope, programme, design information, manufacturing requirements, resources, temporary works, lifting arrangements, RAMS, logistics and site-readiness activities are fully coordinated.


The Construction Project Manager will be the principal operational point of contact for clients, main contractors, consultants and other project stakeholders. They will maintain a clear view of programme, cost, risk, change and delivery performance across multiple projects, address issues before they affect key milestones and provide accurate, concise updates to the Construction Manager and senior management.


This is a hands-on role requiring strong leadership, sound judgement and a consistently high level of ownership, initiative and follow-through. The successful candidate must identify what needs to happen next, drive outstanding actions through to completion and make timely decisions without waiting for continuous direction. Where a matter requires additional technical, commercial or management authority, it must be escalated promptly with a clear assessment of the potential impact and a recommended course of action.


The role is based in Raharney and involves travel to project sites throughout Ireland and periodically to the UK. It is not intended to be permanently based in the UK. Routine UK site coverage will be supported by locally based engineering resources, while the Construction Project Manager will travel at key project stages and as delivery requirements dictate. UK travel is expected approximately every few weeks, although the frequency will vary depending on the project programme and any issues requiring direct project-management oversight.


Core accountabilities


Project leadership & delivery


  • Take overall ownership of allocated projects from internal handover through mobilisation, installation, commissioning, handover and commercial close-out.
  • Develop and maintain an integrated project-delivery plan covering design, approvals, procurement, manufacture, transport, site readiness, installation, testing and handover.
  • Set clear priorities, responsibilities and deadlines for each project team and drive actions through to completion.
  • Maintain oversight of multiple concurrent projects while giving appropriate attention to technical detail, emerging risks and critical milestones.
  • Identify delays, constraints and competing priorities early and agree practical recovery or mitigation measures with the relevant stakeholders.


Pre-Construction & Technical Coordination

  • Lead the project start-up and internal handover process, confirming scope, contract requirements, programme, interfaces, assumptions, exclusions, risks and responsibilities.
  • Attend pre-contract, pre-start, design and coordination meetings with clients, designers, consultants, main contractors and internal departments.
  • Review the overall project requirements with Commercial, QS, Design, Production and Operations, ensuring that design, manufacture, installation and site interfaces are understood and coordinated.
  • Ensure that technical queries, design information, approvals, temporary works and construction details are progressed in line with the project programme.
  • Apply sound civil-engineering and construction judgement when reviewing drawings, specifications, construction methods, site constraints and buildability.


Site Readiness Installation and Logistics

  • Confirm that each site is ready before mobilisation, including access, ground conditions, crane positions, working areas, welfare, permits, interfaces, storage and delivery arrangements.
  • Plan and coordinate the installation of precast structures and associated civil works, ensuring that labour, subcontractors, plant, cranes, access equipment, materials and deliveries are available when required.
  • Prepare or coordinate project-specific construction plans, risk assessments and method statements, lift plans and site-specific safety documentation in conjunction with the Health and Safety team and competent appointed persons.
  • Coordinate with Production and Transport to align manufacturing, loading sequence, delivery dates and site installation priorities. Oversee mobilisation, critical lifts, first installations, major changes and other key project stages, providing senior direction to site teams and local engineering support.


Programme Resource and Performance Management

  • Prepare, maintain and communicate detailed project programmes, short-term look-ahead and milestone plans.
  • Schedule the labour, supervision, engineering support, plant, equipment, materials and subcontract resources required for successful delivery.
  • Monitor actual progress against programme, investigate variances and implement recovery actions before agreed completion dates are affected.
  • Coordinate site workloads and resource priorities across Ireland and the UK, escalating capacity constraints and resource conflicts promptly.
  • Maintain accurate project records, progress information and weekly metrics and provide concise reports for the Commercial / Construction Director and company management.


Commercial Contract and Change Control

  • Manage projects in accordance with the agreed budget, contract scope and commercial strategy, working closely with the Quantity Surveyor and Commercial team.
  • Support the preparation of subcontract work packages, clearly defining scope, responsibilities, programme, commercial terms and health and safety requirements.
  • Participate in the selection and management of approved subcontractors and monitor their performance throughout project delivery.
  • Identify scope changes, delays, disruption, additional works and potential commercial impacts as they arise, ensuring that records and notices are maintained and communicated promptly.
  • Monitor project costs, labour, plant, subcontract and material performance and contribute to forecasting, valuations, final accounts and project close-out.


Health Safety and Environmental Management

  • Lead project delivery in accordance with company health, safety and environmental requirements and promote a visible, proactive safety culture across all sites.
  • Ensure that construction plans, RAMS, lift plans, permits and site-specific controls are prepared, reviewed, briefed and implemented before relevant work begins.
  • Verify that site teams and subcontractors have the required competencies, training, inductions, equipment and supervision for the activities being undertaken.
  • Monitor site compliance through regular visits, inspections and engagement with the Health and Safety team; address unsafe acts or conditions immediately.
  • Ensure that incidents, near misses and hazards are reported, investigated and closed out with effective corrective actions.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core AI Squad, you'll design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform capabilities that power intelligent product experiences across Cloudbeds. This is a product engineering role focused on production AI systems, agentic workflows, evaluation, and observability - not an internal tooling role. You'll work primarily in Python while collaborating across our broader PHP and Java ecosystem, building systems where correctness, reliability, latency, cost, and model quality are core to the job. Your goal is to help Cloudbeds ship AI-powered customer experiences that are useful, trusted, scalable, and measurable.

Our Core AI Squad:

The Core AI Squad owns the customer-facing AI platform infrastructure, agentic workflows, and evaluation and observability foundations that enable AI-powered experiences across Cloudbeds products. The team builds the production capabilities that let us evaluate models and providers for specific use cases, orchestrate tools and workflows, measure quality over time, and integrate AI safely into real customer journeys. You'll join a senior, product-minded group that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, fast learning, and strong collaboration across product, design, data, and engineering.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform services and product features primarily in Python, while integrating with PHP and Java systems as needed
  • Build and evolve agentic harnesses, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, tool execution, state management, recovery paths, and evaluation hooks
  • Integrate agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems with strong attention to reliability, correctness, latency, scalability, and cost
  • Evaluate models and providers for specific product use cases, using clear success criteria and abstractions that keep the platform flexible as the AI ecosystem evolves
  • Own evaluation, tracing, observability, and quality feedback loops for AI features so the team can detect regressions, understand behavior, and improve over time
  • Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and advocate for engineering best practices, test automation, maintainability, and operational excellence
  • Collaborate with product, design, data, security, and engineering partners to turn ambiguous AI product opportunities into reliable customer-facing features
  • Comfort building, debugging, and operating services that interact with PostgreSQL, SQS, gRPC, and REST APIs, including data models, event streams, service contracts, and versioning
  • Contribute as a senior individual contributor through technical leadership, architecture input, pair programming, code reviews, and mentorship

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production systems
  • Strong proficiency with Python in production environments, including APIs, services, tests, debugging, and operational ownership
  • Hands-on experience building, integrating, or evaluating agentic systems, agent harnesses, tool orchestration, or LLM-powered workflows
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, or similar platforms (PydanticAI, CrewAI, etc)
  • Experience with MCP, vector databases, retrieval patterns, RAG architectures, or AI evaluation platforms
  • Comfortable working across a polyglot stack, especially contributing to or integrating with PHP and Java services when the product requires it
  • Familiarity with prompt and version management, guardrails, tracing, LLM observability, cost and latency optimization, or human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerization such as Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, plus experience working with remote-first, globally distributed teams
  • Experience with API-driven design, distributed systems, data modeling, and reliable service boundaries
  • Strong knowledge of software best practices, design patterns, performance, security-minded development, and testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, especially in complex systems with uncertain or probabilistic challenges

title: Reporting Change Analyst
description:
We're looking for a data analyst to join our Reporting Change Team and help shape the future of reporting and data across Nationwide's Finance function. You'll work with analysts, developers, business designers and Finance specialists on everything from data analysis and requirements gathering to solution design and testing.

You don't need to be a Finance or regulatory reporting expert. We're looking for strong analytical skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Success in this role comes from taking ownership of your work and delivering a high standard of output for stakeholders. You'll enjoy getting into the detail, understanding how things work and identifying practical solutions to problems. A natural curiosity about how data, systems and reporting processes connect will help you make sense of the bigger picture, while the confidence to ask questions and provide constructive challenge when something doesn't seem right is equally important. You'll also bring a willingness to learn about finance, risk and the way a building society operates, building your knowledge and expertise as you grow in the role.

At Nationwide we offer hybrid working wherever possible. More rewarding relationships are supported through our hybrid approach, bringing colleagues together across our UK wide estate, whilst also supporting generous access to home working. We value our time in the office to solve problems, to learn, and to feel connected.

For this job you'll spend at least two days per week, or if part time you'll spend 40% of your working time, based at either our Swindon, London, Northampton or Glasgow office. If you’re based at our Glasgow office, this will apply from 1 April 2027 and ahead of that there will be a need to regularly connect with colleagues for collaboration events. If your application is successful, your hiring manager will provide further details on how this works. You can also find out more about our approach to hybrid working here.

If we receive a high volume of relevant applications, we may close the advert earlier than the advertised date, so please apply as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll work in the Reporting Change Team on projects supporting the strategic direction for reporting and data within Finance. Depending on the project, you’ll work with Finance SMEs and stakeholders to understand problems, gather requirements and analyse existing processes, data and reporting logic. You’ll help document business rules and translate them into clear requirements for developers, while supporting the design of data tables and reporting solutions.

You’ll also analyse datasets to identify trends, issues and data quality concerns, support the testing of new data and reporting solutions, and work closely with developers, business designers and other analysts throughout delivery. As part of this, you’ll help identify opportunities to simplify existing processes and make better use of automation.

You’ll work across different projects and stages of delivery, giving you exposure to a broad range of Finance systems, reporting processes and data. This is a great opportunity if you’re looking to take the next step in your data or analysis career, gaining experience of complex Finance data, strategic reporting change and modern data solutions while working alongside experienced analysts, developers and Finance specialists.


About you

You'll be curious, approachable and technically minded, with an interest in developing your career in data, systems and reporting change. You'll value different perspectives, work collaboratively with others and be comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback.

You'll be comfortable analysing data, identifying patterns or issues and working with others to understand the business rules (logic) behind it. You'll use this understanding to help shape requirements, data structures and reporting solutions, looking beyond the numbers to understand what the data represents and provide valuable business insight.

As a minimum you’ll have:

  • Experience working with stakeholders to understand a problem or need, ask the right questions and turn this into clear requirements or documented outcomes - constructively challenging assumptions where appropriate.
  • Excellent Excel skills, with experience using formulas and functions to analyse, reconcile and interrogate data.
  • Experience working with large or complex datasets, including data testing, reconciliation or data quality analysis using SQL, Power BI or similar.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data, identify patterns or issues and draw logical conclusions.
  • A willingness to learn new skills, systems, technologies and areas of Finance, and apply that learning to your work.
  • Experience understanding how data moves through a process, including following existing logic, code or workflows to understand how data is transformed and used.
  • Experience delivering change, process improvement or automation.

Our customer first behaviours put customers and members at the heart of how we work together. They are the set of behaviours that every colleague needs to display, in every role:

  • Feel what customers feel - We step into our customers’ shoes, using their feedback and insights to empathise with them and to understand their needs, so that every decision we make starts and finishes with our customers in mind

  • Say it straight - We are brave in speaking out and saying what we think – we’re honest and direct with good intent, openly sharing diverse perspectives to reach the best conclusions and using language everyone can understand

  • Push for better - We don’t settle for mediocrity, we challenge the status quo, taking responsibility for continuous improvement and personal development

  • Get it done - We prioritise what will have the greatest impact, we are decisive, and we take accountability for delivering brilliant customer outcomes

You can strengthen your application by showing how our customer first behaviours resonate with you, and where you may have already demonstrated these.

The extras you’ll get

There are all sorts of employee benefits available at Nationwide, including:

  • 25 days holiday, pro rata

  • Private medical insurance

  • A highly competitive pension to help you build a strong foundation for retirement

  • Access to an annual performance-related bonus

  • Training and development to help you progress your career

  • A great selection of additional benefits through our salary sacrifice scheme

  • Life assurance to provide peace of mind for you and your loved ones in the event of your death

  • Wellhub – access to a range of free and paid options for health and wellness

  • Up to 2 days of paid volunteering a year

Banking – but fairer, more rewarding, and for the good of society

We forge our own path at Nationwide.

As a mutual, we’re owned by our members - those customers who bank, save or have a mortgage with us. We challenge the financial sector status quo. We don’t see customers as the engine of our own profit. We share our profits with them and put their needs first. Always there when they need us. Supporting them and their lives.

If you’re inspired by fairer finances, passionate about making a meaningful impact, and truly care about our customers, you’re one of us.

At Nationwide, you are challenged to grow and rewarded for doing so. Valued. Recognised. Inspired to be your best. As a community, we want our working lives to count. As a team, we celebrate what we achieve. As a standard-setter, we work for the good of customers, communities, and broader society.

We are purpose-driven. Uncompromisingly customer. Unstoppably Nationwide.

What to do next

If this role is for you, please click the ‘Apply Now’ button. You’ll need to attach your up-to-date CV and answer a few quick questions for us.

We respond to everyone, so we will be in contact shortly after the closing date to let you know the outcome of your application.

Keeping your data and personal information confidential is important to us. To find out more about how we use and process your data, please read our Privacy policy.

If you want to find out more about using AI in our recruitment process, please read more here.

Disability Confident

We’re not just guided by data, we’re driven by the real experiences of our people. We’re a Disability Confident Level 3 Leader, the highest level.

That’s why we’re constantly evolving our policies and practices to make sure everyone feels genuinely supported, valued, and empowered to champion inclusion. Whatever your needs, we’re here to support you. If you need any additional support throughout your application journey, email our team at Recruitment Support.

Apply safely with Nationwide

Recruitment scams can look convincing, so take a moment to check the role is listed on our official careers site and read our guidance on Don’t be conned by a job scam.

Please note that should you be successful in securing this role, the job title on our internal systems will be System Data & Change Consultant.

title: RSSC-West Satellite Analyst
description:

QinetiQ US will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. Position Overview

Join our team supporting the U.S. Space Force (USSF) Commercial Satellite Communications Office (CSCO) Regional SATCOM Support Centers (RSSCs) West (RSSC-West) at Peterson Space Force Base. We are seeking an RSSC Satellite Analyst for the RSSC-West Commercial Cell. In this role you will focus on COMSATCOM lease management and commercial Electromagnetic Interference / Radio Frequency Interference (EMI/RFI) work. You will help DoD customers get the commercial satellite capacity they need, keep track of the leases already in use, and make sure interference affecting commercial satellites is identified and reported.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service and COMSATCOM subject matter expertise within the RSSC-West Area of Responsibility (AOR), maintaining situational awareness of the COMSATCOM contracts and leases in use and a knowledge base on commercial satellite constellation coverage and status.
  • Support DoD and mission partner customers in acquiring COMSATCOM capabilities, including help defining and shaping their requirements.
  • Provide local AOR teleport availability planning and frequency clearance support, as applicable, coordinating with the cognizant frequency manager.
  • Develop and submit Satellite Access Requests (SARs) and Satellite Access Authorizations (SAAs), including access times, points of contact, terminal look angles, satellite orbital location, and transmit/receive carrier parameters and frequencies.
  • Develop reports detailing the status of Gateways and Teleports and applicable terrestrial infrastructure.
  • Support and report on EMI and RFI through proper channels, covering DoD reference emitters, current DoD transmissions to commercial satellites, and network owner/operator geolocation results.
  • Engage with the COMSATCOM community of interest to support EMI monitoring, detection, characterization, and geolocation, and document trends in EMI events affecting Commercial SATCOM.
  • Monitor COMSATCOM system health, status, and potential threats, such as Commercial SATCOM EMI reports, Notices to Space Operators (NOTSOs), and status messages on NIPRNet and SIPRNet.
  • Monitor COMSATCOM usage to identify satellite or system anomalies and other noteworthy operational events, and provide telephony and troubleshooting assistance in support of the RSSC-West 24/7 mission.
  • Help develop and update Commercial SATCOM standard operating procedures, and collaborate with all designated entities to support Space operations.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma and 6 years of relevant SATCOM experience as a SATCOM technician, controller, communications planner, or network operator in a military or commercial environment.
  • Working knowledge of communication principles and SATCOM theory, including RF link parameters, carrier frequencies, and terminal look angles.
  • Knowledge of COMSATCOM systems, capabilities, and delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and exceptional customer service skills, with the ability to work directly with military and government customers.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Ability to work full-time on site at Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado Springs, CO.
  • Active TS/SCI clearance; #qinetiqclearedjob

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related discipline.
  • Security+ or another DoD 8140-compliant cybersecurity certification.
  • Prior experience with an RSSC, the SIOD, a SATCOM System Expert (C-SSE), or Commercial SATCOM operations.
  • Knowledge of current COMSATCOM vendors, technology, and business models.
  • Hands-on experience with the SAR/SAA process.
  • Experience with EMI/RFI monitoring, characterization, or geolocation.
  • Experience supporting COMSATCOM lease management or acquisition.
  • Familiarity with Joint and DoD SATCOM processes and operations.

This position conducts Technical Surveillance Countermeasures surveys and inspections across continental United States and outside the continental United States locations, providing time-sensitive response capabilities to protect sensitive facilities and information from technical surveillance threats. The specialist maintains technical proficiency through mandatory annual training requirements and contributes to the overall counterintelligence posture of supported organizations.

  • Provide time-sensitive response support for emerging technical surveillance threats and urgent mission requirements.
  • Prepare comprehensive documentation and reporting for all Technical Surveillance Countermeasures activities in accordance with established protocols.
  • Perform accurate and timely data entry into designated government databases and tracking systems.
  • Complete a minimum of 40 hours of Technical Surveillance Countermeasures-related professional development training annually to maintain technical currency.
  • Travel up to 50% within the continental United States and outside the continental United States to support mission requirements at various government installations.
  • Coordinate with counterintelligence personnel to integrate Technical Surveillance Countermeasures findings into broader threat assessments.
  • Maintain and operate specialized Technical Surveillance Countermeasures equipment in accordance with technical standards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Interagency Training Center Practitioner certification required.
  • Completion of 40 hours of Technical Surveillance Countermeasures-related training annually.
  • Current First Aid, Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation, and Automated External Defibrillator certification.
  • Meet all requirements outlined in Department of Defense Manual 8140.03 for cyberspace workforce qualification.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible Technical Surveillance Countermeasures (TSCM) experience supporting Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or other U.S. Government security and counterintelligence operations.
  • Valid U.S. passport with no restrictions.
  • Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Defense Threat Reduction Agency mission sets and organizational structure.
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.

Primary duty location is Fort Belvoir, Virginia, within the National Capital Region.
