title: Senior Manager, ERP Applications
description:
Join one of the fastest growing, most dynamic companies in the furniture industry. For over 25 years, Four Hands has been a leading designer and wholesaler of furniture and décor, helping people create spaces that feel like home.

Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies and named one of Austin’s Top Workplaces year after year. We invest in exceptional people — with a team of over 800 and growing — fostering our employees’ careers and celebrating them at every step of the way. Four Hands is where passion meets purpose and where your next chapter begins.

Four Hands is seeking a Sr. Manager, ERP Applications to lead end-to-end execution for our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform — spanning functional business-process ownership, technical development delivery, and production operations. This role is accountable for the full D365 F&O team: it leads Product Owners across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Planning domains, and has direct management responsibility for the Technical Lead who drives hands-on development and leads the developer pod.

The Sr. Manager leads execution across the full ERP lifecycle — from requirements definition and development delivery through go-live, steady-state operations, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate has deep D365 F&O functional knowledge across Finance and SCM and strong people leadership skills. This role coordinates with the QA and Devops team to ensure changes move through the release process safely and predictably.

In This Role

ERP Delivery & Platform Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end execution of D365 F&O delivery, including functional configuration, technical development, integrations, and production operations across Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Supply Chain, and Planning domains
  • Oversee functional configuration, process documentation, and business sign-off for D365 F&O enhancements and changes
  • Support the full ERP lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, development oversight, testing, cutover, go-live support, and post-go-live stabilization
  • Oversee UAT planning and execution across functional domains, ensuring business readiness and sign-off
  • Coordinate with QA and DevOps teams to ensure development, testing, and releases follow established processes and standards
  • Drive change management, end-user training, and adoption for D365 F&O enhancements and process changes across the business
  • Promote a culture of accountability, trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement

Integrations, Data & Technical Governance

  • Oversee system integrations between D365 F&O and external platforms, including WMS, Salesforce, EDI, eCommerce, logistics, tax, banking, and financial close systems, ensuring reliability, documentation, and compliance with established standards
  • Manage relationships with technical vendors and integration partners, including managed service providers, ISVs, and middleware vendors, ensuring delivery accountability and alignment with Four Hands technical standards
  • Enforce fit-to-standard principles and customization governance as defined by the Director, Enterprise Solutions, ensuring disciplined decision-making around D365 F&O customizations
  • Support master data governance across D365 F&O and connected systems, including customer, vendor, item, and pricing data, ensuring accuracy and consistency across platforms
  • Ensure the team follows established IT controls, change management standards, security requirements, and audit documentation practices

Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Run joint backlog reviews across Product Owners and development teams, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and ready for development
  • Use KPIs, dashboards, and operational data to monitor system health, service quality, and team performance; identify trends and drive corrective actions
  • Lead root cause analysis for recurring incidents and production issues across functional and technical domains, reducing ticket volume and improving system reliability
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for business stakeholders on system issues, configuration questions, and process improvement requests
  • Execute continuous improvement initiatives within approved priorities by identifying process gaps, proposing solutions, and driving delivery through functional and technical teams
  • Encourage team members to evaluate performance outcomes, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend solutions that enhance operational efficiency

Leadership and Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team to deliver results aligned with Four Hands' strategic objectives
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among team members, encouraging idea sharing and best practices
  • Foster individual growth and skill enhancement through regular feedback, training sessions, and professional development opportunities
  • Monitor progress towards goals through regular check-ins and performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and guidance
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging team members to analyze performance outcomes, identify areas for enhancement, and propose innovative solutions.
  • Foster a culture of trust, teamwork, and collaboration, promoting continuous improvement and employee engagement

Other Duties

  • Other duties as assigned, in accordance with training and qualifications
  • Uphold the Core Values and be a valuable member of the Four Hands Team
    • Be open and honest
    • Reach for excellence
    • Act with responsibility
    • Value the whole person
    • Enjoy the journey

The Ideal Person

  • 10+ years of ERP experience, preferably with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, covering Finance and Supply Chain Management modules, with exposure to both functional and technical delivery
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading functional and/or technical teams in an ERP environment
  • Deep functional knowledge across Finance (GL/AP/AR), Supply Chain, Procurement, and Planning domains
  • Demonstrated experience across the full ERP lifecycle: requirements, design, development oversight, testing, cutover, go-live, steady-state operations, and continuous improvement
  • Sufficient technical fluency to direct a hands-on development team and engage meaningfully in technical trade-offs, integration design, and customization decisions
  • Proven ability to manage a structured backlog and run disciplined requirements and prioritization processes across functional and development workstreams
  • Experience with fit-to-standard analysis and enforcing customization governance in a D365 F&O environment
  • Experience owning master data governance across ERP and integrated systems
  • Demonstrated use of KPIs, dashboards, and data-driven methods to improve system reliability and operational efficiency
  • Experience with root cause analysis, incident/problem management, and driving corrective actions to reduce recurring issues
  • Experience owning functional UAT, business sign-off, and production cutover activities
  • Experience driving change management, end-user training, and adoption programs for ERP enhancements
  • Familiarity with IT controls, change management governance, security standards, and audit requirements
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to translate business needs into clear requirements and communicate system constraints back to the business
  • Experience working within a structured application lifecycle management (ALM) and release management process, such as Azure DevOps, LCS, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with the D365 F&O integration landscape including EDI, eCommerce, WMS, CRM, tax, and financial close systems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to run effective backlog, delivery, and governance meetings
  • Familiarity with Korber WMS, Salesforce, Cleo, Avalara, Blackline, Kentico, or similar platforms preferred
  • Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 Finance and/or Supply Chain Management (MB-310, MB-330) also preferred

About Four Hands

Headquartered in Austin, Texas, since 1996, Four Hands crafts furniture, art and décor — pieces that are all about creating space. Timeless, thoughtful designs with endless possibilities. Pieces meant to be experienced and form a whole that feels like home.

Our trade customers range from interior designers to large retailers who rely on our expertise to grow and guide their business to success. We treat our partners as part of the Four Hands family, championing them and rooting for their every win.

And, we are constantly pursuing better — from sourcing the finest materials and finishes to seeking fresh inspiration to elevate our designs — we are never settled, never done.

Four Hands recruits qualified applicants and advances in employment its employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, genetic information, ethnic or national origin, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

description:
About the role

At Barry’s, we believe in inspiring our employees and our clients to work hard, have fun, find their strength, and be their best. The Barry’s MBA Summer Associate Program is designed to immerse graduate students in the world of global boutique fitness. As an MBA Summer Associate you will lead meaningful initiatives and work on projects that enable Barry’s to achieve its vision of transforming lives worldwide. While participating in the MBA Summer Associate Program, you will have the opportunity to work alongside other HQ employees to gain a deep understanding of our business and will also have exposure to senior executives in the Company.

All of our employees are expected to uphold Barry’s community and culture standards, and live the Company’s mission, vision, and values daily. As a Barry’s MBA Summer Associate, you represent the Barry’s brand within the studio and throughout the fitness community. We are looking for hard-working, determined, and self-motivated candidates with solid communication, time management, and interpersonal skills. We seek candidates who act professionally and have strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task in fast-paced environments.

What you'll do

  • Lead 1-3 key strategic projects, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to drive impactful business outcomes.
  • Analyze and synthesize data to inform strategic decision-making and communicate business trends.
  • Assess current operations and new or ongoing initiatives to identify areas for growth, resolve issues, and/or increase cross-functional buy-in.
  • Develop and manage recurring and ad hoc analyses, translating insights into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Design financial and operational models to support strategic initiatives.
  • Analyze customer, competitor and market insights and recommend ways to improve customer journey and experience.

Our Student Associates are paid at an hourly rate. Barry’s does not provide housing.


Qualifications

  • Must be currently enrolled in a MBA program
  • Provide a letter from your school verifying enrollment (upon offer)
  • Summer Associates are a full-time role and expected to work 35+ hours per week during the duration of the program
  • Available to work from approximately June through September
  • Preferred location is New York City, with remote option available

title: Principle Facilities Specialist
description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. title: Space Security Manager
description:
Space Security Manager

The Opportunity:

Space has evolved from a peaceful environment into a contested and congested domain. The U.S. Space Force is rapidly expanding to address global threats. Booz Allen enables mission success through advanced technology and enabling services to deliver speed to outcomes.

Our team is sought out to solve the service’s most difficult and amorphous problems. We are seeking prior service members with understanding of how the defense enterprise works and a willingness to problem-solve issues big and small. Our teams are tasked with designing, standing up, operating, and optimizing organizations. We’re tasked with identifying advanced tools and technology that can expedite military outcomes or reduce staff burden. We’re tasked with managing the byproducts of change through project implementation. Each project we take on presents new opportunity.

We’re seeking someone like you to help us make our contribution to the fight.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in senior security support roles, including managing collateral classified activities, SAP operations, and anti-tamper requirements
  • Experience with secure facilities and proper handling of classified information across multiple programs
  • Knowledge of DoD Manual 5205.07, Volumes 1-4, and DoD policies and procedures
  • Ability to document and implement security methods and decisions for operations, including risk mitigation strategies
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree

  • Experience with space programs
  • Experience supporting the U.S. Space Force or other military space programs
  • Experience with security-related systems such as JPAS, JADE, and AFRIMS, and visitor control functions, including in space program environments
  • Experience in program protection planning, including vulnerability analysis and countermeasure integration, for safeguarding space-related technologies, satellites, ground stations, and orbital infrastructure
  • Experience with analytical writing, including drafting plans, security assessments, reports, and briefings, around space assets and operations
  • Knowledge of COMSEC material handling and space communications protocols
  • Ability to assist with providing ongoing assessments and updates to security policies, ensuring continuous improvement tailored to space risks and mission profiles
  • Completion of DSS or CDSE Security Professional Education Development (SPeD) Program, or DSS Information, Industrial, and Physical Security Training

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

title: Environmental Technician - Healthcare
description:
Job Summary
Supports Sustainability Services onsite program, including manual labor associated with chemical handling, lab pack duties, drum movements within the facility, drum bulking, drum crushing, assisting when extra personnel are needed and other duties as assigned. This is a support position focused on hazardous and non-hazardous waste related projects.

This position will travel between customer sites, within the San Antonio area.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other minor duties may be assigned.

  • Ensure waste types are properly segregated, regulatory shipment windows are met, proper container labeling is adhered to, good housekeeping is maintained and accurate tracking logs are kept.
  • Identify best practices that assist customers in reducing waste volumes, increasing operational efficiencies, identifying optimal equipment usage and generating cost savings.
  • Segregate, label, mark and package waste materials in a safe and compliant manner.
  • Collect, pour, transfer, consolidate, repackage and package solid, liquid and hazardous material.
  • Perform labor intensive activities such as container or drum collection, drum bulking, sorting trash for recyclables and loading of trucks.
  • Transfer waste into containers of different size.
  • Provide labor support at 90-Day Hazardous Waste Pad, when applicable.
  • May provide support or direction to less experienced Technicians.
  • Wears required personal protective equipment.
  • Participates and cooperates in safety process, including following written procedures, attending required training and scheduled meetings.
  • Immediately reports any unsafe conditions, incidents, injuries or property damage to supervisor.
  • Follows Environmental and Quality Management System (ISO 14001/9001) policy, procedures and operational controls related to job responsibilities.
  • Maintains compliance with applicable environmental, safety and transportation regulations (EPA, OSHA and DOT).


Qualifications

A. Required Qualifications

  • Associate's Degree (accredited), or in lieu of degree
  • High School Diploma or GED (accredited and 2 years of relevant work experience.
  • Must have a valid Driver's License
  • 24-hour HAZWOPER certification (or equivalent) or the ability to obtain such within 30 days of employment. and
  • Manifesting hazardous and non-hazardous waste experience preferred and
  • Pre-assignment and/or pre-hire customer-specific drug and/or alcohol testing may be required by certain customer-contract requirements. Such testing may include urinalysis, oral swab, drug hair follicle testing and/or alcohol testing.
  • Some WM customers require vaccinations. For these positions, proof of vaccination will be required subject only to any obligation to accommodate for religious or disability reasons


B. Preferred Qualifications

  • RCRA and DOT regulatory compliance experience preferred
  • Manifesting hazardous and non-hazardous waste experience preferred


Physical Requirements

Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Lifting
  • Carrying
  • Pushing
  • Pulling

  • Stooping
  • Kneeling
  • Crouching
  • Reaching
  • Feeling
  • Standing
  • Walking

As part of the ongoing employment requirements, the successful candidate may be subject to drug and alcohol testing—including pre‑employment screening, post‑incident evaluations, reasonable suspicion checks, and random testing—in accordance with government regulations and company policies.

title: Regional Ecosystem & Partnership Lead
description:
Following Nationwide’s acquisition of Virgin Money, we’re building an ambitious, relationship-led Business Bank with the scale and purpose to make a meaningful difference to businesses and communities across the UK.

As Regional Ecosystem & Partnerships Lead, you’ll play a key role within Nationwide’s Entrepreneurial Support Team, helping us build a strong national network of partnerships, communities and local connections that brings our support for entrepreneurs to life across the UK.

This is a highly collaborative and externally facing role. You’ll develop relationships across the UK entrepreneurial ecosystem, bringing together founders, business communities, universities, local authorities, accelerators and other organisations to create meaningful opportunities for entrepreneurs to connect, learn and grow.

You’ll shape how Nationwide shows up regionally, establishing a consistent national approach while making sure our activity remains relevant to the needs and opportunities of different local business communities.

This is an opportunity to help shape something different.

As we grow our Business Bank, we have the chance to combine Nationwide’s scale, mutual purpose and trusted brand with an ambition to support more businesses and entrepreneurs across the UK.

You’ll be joining at an important point in that journey, with the opportunity to shape how Nationwide Foundry builds its presence across the country, develops meaningful partnerships and becomes part of the communities and ecosystems where entrepreneurs are building and growing their businesses.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to connect entrepreneurs, communities and partners, and want to build a regional ecosystem with genuine national reach, we’d love to hear from you.

Flexible base location, with regular travel UK wide.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll lead the development and delivery of our regional ecosystem and partnership approach, creating the connections and infrastructure that allow Nationwide to reach entrepreneurs across the UK.

You’ll be responsible for:

• Developing our regional ecosystem and partnership roadmap, identifying the communities, organisations and relationships that can extend our reach and increase the value we provide to founders.
• Building strategic relationships with business communities, universities, local authorities, accelerators, support organisations and regional networks.
• Shaping and delivering regional events and partnership programmes that connect entrepreneurs with useful expertise, opportunities and support.
• Leading our regional activation model, ensuring a consistent national approach while adapting activity to the needs of local entrepreneurial ecosystems.
• Leading and developing Regional Managers as the model grows, setting clear priorities, standards and measures across a distributed regional network.
• Building a strong pipeline of potential partners and assessing opportunities based on strategic fit, founder value, credibility, reach and risk.
• Using founder feedback, regional insight and performance measures to understand what’s working and continually improve our approach.
• Managing the customer, commercial, operational and reputational considerations associated with partnerships, events and regional delivery.
• Working closely across Business Banking and the wider Society to connect national propositions with effective regional delivery.

About you

You’ll bring significant experience in partnerships, relationship management, regional programmes, events or the wider entrepreneurship ecosystem, alongside the credibility and energy to build relationships across a diverse external network.

You’re likely to have:

• Extensive experience developing partnerships, regional programmes or networks involving multiple organisations and stakeholders.
• A strong understanding of the UK entrepreneurship and business-support ecosystem and how different organisations can work together to support founders.
• Experience building trusted external relationships and turning those relationships into tangible opportunities and outcomes.
• Strong delivery skills, with experience taking programmes from strategy and planning through to implementation and evaluation.
• Experience leading distributed teams, networks or communities where influence and clear direction are just as important as formal reporting lines.
• Strong commercial and stakeholder judgement, including the ability to assess the potential value, credibility and risk of prospective partnerships.
• The ability to balance national consistency with the different needs, opportunities and characteristics of regional business communities.
• Confidence operating across a large, regulated organisation while also building credibility with entrepreneurial communities and external partners.
• A genuine interest in entrepreneurship and creating stronger connections between founders, businesses and the organisations that can help them succeed.

About your rewards

We continually review and evaluate our offering to ensure we have a broad range of market competitive benefits available for our colleagues. When you put a lot in, it’s only fair to expect a lot out. So, when you help us do the right thing for our customers, we want to reward you.

There are all sorts of employee benefits available at Nationwide, including:

• 30 days holiday
• Access to private medical insurance
• A highly competitive pension to help you build a strong foundation for retirement
• Access to an annual performance-related bonus
• Training and development to help you progress your career
• A great selection of additional benefits through our salary sacrifice scheme
• Life assurance to provide peace of mind for you and your loved ones in the event of your death
• Wellhub – access to a range of free and paid options for health and wellness
• Up to 2 days of paid volunteering a year

Banking – but fairer, more rewarding, and for the good of society
We forge our own path at Nationwide.

As a mutual, we’re owned by our members — those customers who bank, save or have a mortgage with us. We challenge the financial sector status quo. We don’t see customers as the engine of profit. We put their needs first. Always.

If you’re inspired by fairer finances, passionate about making a meaningful impact, and truly care about customers, you’re one of us.

At Nationwide, you are challenged to grow and rewarded for doing so. Valued. Recognised. Inspired to be your best.

We are purpose driven. Uncompromisingly customer. Unstoppably Nationwide.

What to do next

To apply, simply click the ‘Apply Now’ button. Please ensure you attach your CV and complete a few short application questions.

title: Digital Verification Engineer
description:
Job#: 3052820

Job Description:


Candidates must be U.S. citizens able to obtain and/or maintain a Department of Defense security clearance as a condition and continuation of employment.

Digital Verification Engineer

Location: El Segundo, California (On-site)

Role Overview

This position requires an experienced professional to analyze customer and system requirements, developing architectural approaches and detailed specifications for electronic products. The selected candidate will design, validate, and support digital hardware designs throughout the entire product lifecycle. This role demands strong technical ownership, proactive communication, and the ability to work independently under general direction to deliver high-quality engineering solutions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze customer and system requirements to develop basic architectural approaches and detailed specifications.
  • Develop high-level and detailed digital designs consistent with product requirements.
  • Validate designs utilizing various methods of review, testing, and analysis.
  • Identify, track, and status technical performance measures to ensure compliance with requirements.
  • Provide engineering support throughout the entire lifecycle of the product.
  • Investigate emerging technologies to develop concepts for future product designs.
  • Support supplier management with technical recommendations and services of limited scope.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation and deliver maintainable engineering solutions.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience with SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM).
  • Strong digital hardware fundamentals, proficiency with electronic design tools, and a proven track record of documenting design decisions, debugging approaches, and technical contributions.

PLEASE NOTE:

Candidates must be able to obtain and/or maintain a Department of Defense Secret clearance as a condition and continuation of employment.

title: Data Scientist, Senior
description:
Data Scientist, Senior

The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.


On our team, you’ll use your leadership skills and data science expertise to create real-world impact. You’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll guide teammates and lead the development of algorithms and systems. You’ll use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to advise your clients as they make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.


Work with us as we use data science for good.


Join us. The world can’t wait.


You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, including performing quantitative analysis, developing visualizations, and processing complex data to create data-driven insights
  • Experience using Python to manipulate and analyze data
  • Experience using SQL to conduct complex database queries
  • Experience using data manipulation and extract, transform, and load (ETL) procedures
  • Experience with leveraging APIs to query systems
  • Experience with developing dashboards or lightweight Web applications to communicate key insights
  • Experience with communicating information in oral or written formats to an audience with varying technical knowledge and expertise
  • TS/SCI clearance

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience developing dashboards using Grafana
  • Experience developing Web services or Web applications using Python and Flask or JavaScript
  • Experience using Apache Spark to aggregate and analyze large data sets from various sources
  • Experience working with AI and ML technologies and data systems
  • Experience applying supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms for clustering, classification, and dimensionality reduction
  • Knowledge of commercial Cloud services used by the IC
  • Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related technical field

title: Information, Review and Release Analyst- SME
description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

Information Review and Release Analyst - SME

Nightwing seeks a part-time (24 hours per week) Information Review and Release Analyst (Subject Matter Expert) in the Herndon, VA area in support of a dynamic Intelligence Community office offering a flexible work schedule.

The position requires an individual to review and thoroughly research the substance and overall context of select documents and make the appropriate redactions-electronically and/or manually- based on the criteria of Executive Order (EO) 13526, the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and the Privacy Act (PA). The candidate must be able to successfully apply critical-thinking skills when evaluating each case, and when utilizing the broad array of customer systems and tools in order to accurately inform the review and release process.

The individual will provide the rationale for redactions using legally defined exemption codes; provide recommendations for release of the documents; and record decisions in the appropriate system. Research of previous release decisions is required to ensure accuracy and consistency in our recommendations. Analysts in this role identify Other Government Agency (OGA) equities involved in the case and ensure that they are prepared for referral or coordination.

Required Education:
• A bachelor degree and/or high school diploma and relevant years of experience specific to the skills listed
• Candidate resumes must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the specific position mentioned above and with the Sponsor.

The candidate must be able to successfully apply critical-thinking skills when evaluating each unique case, and when utilize a broad array of customer systems and tools in order to accurately inform the review and release process. Due to the complexity of most requests, time management and the ability to collaborate with other team members is a must. The selected candidate must be able to consistently deliver high-quality, accurate work, and be willing to perform ad hoc duties as needed. Candidates are able to explore their creative side for identifying process improvement ideas.

Typical Duties include, but are not limited to:
• Reviews & redacts certain equities within classified documents, records and files in accordance with established standard operating procedures, work flows and policies
• Submits requests to the scanning team to scan any documents needed for research
• Submits requests to the search team to conduct the initial of search for data relevant to the case
• Assists with the training of newly hired search team members, as requested
• Collaborates with supervisory client POCs to recommend and implement changes that improves processes, workflows and standard operating procedures
• Works an eight-hour shift between 6:00AM -6:00PM, Monday-Friday.
-- Infrequently provides surge support outside of normal office hours for short-fused emergent requests

Together, we’ll leverage our collective expertise to drive innovation, solve complex problems, and deliver exceptional results for our clients.

title: Salesforce Development Lead
description:
Duracell is an iconic brand and the world’s leading manufacturer of high-performance alkaline batteries, power cells, and rechargeables. We are the most trusted source of personal power because of our sustained commitment to innovation, producing more compact, more powerful, and longer lasting batteries.

Join our Global Commercial Applications team in India as Salesforce Development Lead and become the senior technical authority for the Salesforce platform behind Duracell’s trade promotions.

You will lead the Salesforce developers based in India and own Apex development, technical design and release quality for our Salesforce Trade Promotion Management and Consumer Goods Cloud platform. You will be the escalation point for the most complex incidents and enhancements, and you will be accountable for the delivery and the development of your team.

Duracell is bringing Salesforce support in-house, so this is a chance to build something. You will set the technical standard the rest of the team works to, including how AI-assisted development is reviewed before it reaches production.

Why you’ll like this role:

  • Real leadership: lead the India Salesforce team, agree their objectives and help them grow.
  • Real influence: you decide the technical standards, code review practice and release quality.
  • Work on a consumer goods platform used across regions, closely with the Solution Architects and global process owners.
  • Work with colleagues from different cultures and time zones around the globe, with a daily overlap with the European team (working hours are approximately 11:00–20:00 IST).
  • Design, build and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch and asynchronous processes for the TPM and Consumer Goods Cloud platform.
  • Own technical design decisions for enhancements, working with the Solution Architects to keep them aligned to the platform roadmap.
  • Act as the escalation point for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents, including root cause analysis and remediation.
  • Own code review and release quality for the team; no change reaches production without review.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code and configuration before deployment, and maintain the test coverage that makes sampling possible.
  • Deliver minor enhancements within the agreed monthly capacity, and estimate larger items for prioritisation.
  • Maintain technical documentation and runbooks so that knowledge sits in the platform rather than in individuals.
  • Act as certified back-up for automation and Agentforce delivery, and for SAP and ERP integrations.
  • Coach the wider Salesforce team on Apex standards, SOQL performance and deployment practice.
  • Set your own objectives and timings to meet the outcomes agreed with the IT Lead, working independently on routine delivery and escalating genuinely complex cases.
  • Proactively propose and implement improvements to development standards, tooling and process, rather than waiting for them to be specified.
  • Interpret procedures where a situation requires it, and make adjustments to systems and processes that improve the effectiveness of the team.
  • Communicate with colleagues within and outside Commercial Applications, and with vendors and third parties in coordination with the IT Lead.
  • Provide guidance and training to more junior colleagues, and lead the team on code review and release quality.
  • Lead the Salesforce developers based in India: agree their objectives, delegate build work, review it before release, and be accountable for the team’s delivery and development.

Expected contributions

  • Production-quality releases: no change reaches production without review; owns code review and release quality for the team.
  • Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents resolved with root cause fixed, not just service restored.
  • AI-generated code and configuration validated before deployment, with the test coverage that makes sampling possible.
  • Wider Salesforce team coached to a common Apex, SOQL and deployment standard.
  • University degree or equivalent training in the discipline of work, with a minimum of 7 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Broad theoretical and practical knowledge of Salesforce development and of the related platform, integration and release disciplines.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I required; Platform Developer II strongly preferred.
  • Deep hands-on Apex, SOQL optimisation, Lightning Web Components, Flows and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud or Trade Promotion Management is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with deployment tooling, source control and CI/CD for Salesforce.
  • Experience supporting a global user base across multiple time zones. Working hours are approximately 11:00–20:00 IST, giving a daily overlap with the European team.
  • Experience of incident and problem management under service level targets.
  • Demonstrated experience of delegating work and reviewing the work of others to a defined standard.
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to share knowledge and to accept and provide feedback.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Exposure to Agentforce or AI-assisted development is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and additional benefits.
  • The chance to work in a startup environment with the world’s #1 battery company, under the Berkshire Hathaway portfolio.
  • Medical insurance covering you, your dependents and your parents or in-laws, subject to company policy.

title: Project Director
description:
Project Director – Ireland | Hyperscale Data Centres & Mission-Critical Construction


If you're an experienced construction leader with a background in hyperscale data centres, mission-critical infrastructure or large-scale construction projects, this is an opportunity to join one of Europe's leading data centre construction specialists, delivering major projects for some of the world's largest technology companies.


We're looking for an experienced Project Director to take full ownership of a flagship hyperscale data centre development in Ireland, overseeing the entire project lifecycle from pre-construction and planning through to commissioning and final handover.


This is a senior leadership appointment requiring someone who can operate across construction delivery, commercial management, multidisciplinary coordination and senior client relationships.


The role goes beyond traditional project management. You'll have overall accountability for project performance, programme delivery, commercial outcomes and the leadership of large construction teams, ensuring a complex, high-value development is delivered safely, efficiently and profitably.


What you'll be doing

  • Take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of a large-scale hyperscale data centre construction project in Ireland.
  • Oversee the full project lifecycle, from pre-construction, design coordination and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across civil, structural, architectural (CSA), mechanical, electrical and associated technical infrastructure.
  • Take ownership of project budgets, financial performance, forecasting, profitability and commercial risk.
  • Manage contractual obligations, subcontractor performance, variations, change orders and commercial negotiations throughout delivery.
  • Establish and oversee project delivery structures, ensuring effective resource allocation, programme management and coordination across all construction disciplines.
  • Act as the senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key project stakeholders, maintaining strong relationships throughout the project.
  • Oversee procurement strategies, supply chain performance and the timely delivery of critical equipment and construction packages.
  • Identify and mitigate technical, operational, contractual and commercial risks to maintain programme certainty and successful project outcomes.
  • Ensure the highest standards of health and safety, quality assurance and regulatory compliance across all project activities.
  • Provide leadership and direction to Project Managers, Construction Managers, Commercial Managers and multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Work closely with senior leadership to provide accurate reporting on project progress, financial performance, programme milestones and key risks.


What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience delivering large-scale construction projects in a senior leadership capacity, ideally as a Project Director, Construction Director or Senior Project Manager.
  • A strong track record within hyperscale data centres, mission-critical facilities or similarly complex construction environments.
  • Experience working for a main contractor or specialist construction contractor, with responsibility for major construction programmes.
  • Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary CSA and MEP delivery, coordinating complex construction interfaces and technical packages.
  • Demonstrated experience taking projects through the full construction lifecycle, including pre-construction, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.
  • Strong commercial and financial understanding, including project P&L, budgets, forecasting, contractual management, variations and risk management.
  • Experience leading large construction teams and managing multiple subcontractors across technically demanding projects.
  • Strong understanding of construction programming, procurement, contractual frameworks and project controls.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with senior clients, consultants and project stakeholders.
  • A strong commitment to health and safety, quality and operational excellence.
  • Excellent leadership, communication and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced construction environments.
  • Candidates from Project Director, Construction Director, Contracts Director or Senior Project Manager backgrounds will be considered.


Location: Ireland (Dublin preferred)



This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced construction leader to take ownership of a flagship hyperscale data centre development, with significant autonomy, commercial responsibility and the opportunity to play a key role in delivering some of Europe's most technically challenging mission-critical infrastructure projects.

AWS & Cloud Technologies

Why Join Capco

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition

This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination.

title: Pre-Sales Engineer (Pipeline)
description:
The Opportunity

As a Pre-Sales Engineer at TSPi, you will have the opportunity to turn complex mission challenges into innovative technology solutions that can make a meaningful difference in people's lives. You will work at the intersection of emerging technology, federal missions, and innovation, helping customers envision and implement new approaches to some of their most pressing challenges.

In this role, you won't simply respond to technical requirements. You'll help shape what's possible. You'll engage with federal customers early in their decision-making process, uncover complex challenges, and design compelling technical solutions. From architecting innovative approaches to building demonstrations, proofs of concept, prototypes, and pilots, you'll help bring ideas to life and show customers how emerging technologies can transform the way they deliver on their missions.

We're looking for a technically accomplished problem solver with deep expertise in AI engineering, data engineering, and/or modern data platforms who enjoys working directly with customers. You'll have the opportunity to apply your technical knowledge, creativity, and communication skills to influence technology strategies, shape new opportunities, and help expand TSPi's impact across the federal landscape. This posting is for a future opportunity and contingent on future funding.

Core Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with federal customers to explore complex mission challenges and identify opportunities to improve programs, services, and operations through innovative technology solutions.
  • Lead technical discovery conversations to understand customer needs, uncover underlying challenges, and translate mission objectives into actionable technology strategies.
  • Architect and design solutions leveraging AI, data engineering, modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and other emerging capabilities.
  • Develop compelling demonstrations, prototypes, proofs of concept, and pilots that bring technical solutions to life and demonstrate their potential impact.
  • Engage with customers early in the opportunity lifecycle, including before formal procurements or RFPs, to help shape technical approaches and inform future investments.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling solutions that demonstrate measurable mission and business value to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, data scientists, subject matter experts, growth leaders, and capture teams to develop innovative, technically sound solutions.
  • Provide technical expertise throughout customer engagement, solution development, capture activities, proposals, and oral presentations.
  • Develop reusable technical solutions, accelerators, demonstrations, and proof points that can support multiple customers and mission areas.
  • Incorporate data security, privacy, governance, interoperability, accessibility, and responsible AI considerations into technical solution design.
  • Stay current on emerging technologies, federal technology priorities, and industry innovations to identify opportunities for new solutions and capabilities.

What We Value

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience in technology engineering, solution engineering, technical consulting, architecture, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in one or more of the following: AI engineering, data engineering, data platforms, cloud or platform engineering, software development, or technical architecture.
  • Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable technologies, and leading cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience designing, architecting, or developing technology solutions that address complex customer and mission requirements.
  • Experience engaging directly with customers to conduct technical discovery, identify opportunities, and recommend innovative solutions.
  • Experience developing and presenting demonstrations, proofs of concept, prototypes, or pilots.
  • Experience contributing technical expertise to capture, proposals, customer solutioning, or oral presentations.
  • Experience working within complex, highly regulated, or mission-driven environments.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI engineering, data engineering, data platforms, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Strong independent problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative solutions to complex, ambiguous challenges.
  • Ability to translate customer mission objectives and operational challenges into practical, scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong technical discovery skills, including the ability to ask insightful questions, uncover customer needs, and identify opportunities for technology-enabled transformation.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and articulate mission and business value to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to independently develop or lead the development of demonstrations, proofs of concept, prototypes, and other technical proof points.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical, growth, capture, consulting, and subject matter expert teams.
  • Understanding of data security, privacy, governance, and related considerations for deploying technology in regulated environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with evolving customer needs and priorities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field preferred.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Mobile Development Productivity
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Mobile Development Productivity team makes building, testing, and releasing Stripe’s mobile applications and device-integrated software fast, reliable, and secure. The team owns the mobile development platform end to end, including development environments, simulators and emulators, continuous integration, automated testing, builds, and releases. We support engineers working across iOS, Android, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform, mobile SDKs, and device-integrated software.

Our customers include engineers working on Stripe Dashboard Mobile, Link, Stripe’s mobile SDKs, and Terminal. We enable mobile engineers to use AI agents throughout the development process, including writing code, running tests, and validating changes across mobile platforms. Our work reduces manual release effort, improves test coverage, and makes mobile development faster and more reliable.

What you’ll do

You will improve the platform that Stripe engineers use to build mobile applications and device-integrated software. You will draw on your experience building mobile applications to understand where development is slow or unreliable, then build tools and systems that improve the experience across teams and platforms.

You will also help make AI agents effective participants in mobile development. This includes giving agents access to realistic development environments, simulators and emulators, test frameworks, and the feedback they need to validate changes. You will work closely with mobile product teams and infrastructure teams, and you will operate the systems you build.

Responsibilities

  • Build mobile development environments and workflows that enable engineers and AI agents to develop, test, and validate changes remotely
  • Improve the speed, reliability, and usability of development workflows and continuous integration across iOS, Android, React Native, and other device-integrated platforms
  • Develop automated testing infrastructure for unit, integration, end-to-end, network snapshot, and visual regression testing
  • Automate secure build and release processes for mobile applications, SDKs, and device software, reducing reliance on developer laptops and manual operations
  • Integrate code-authoring, review, and validation tools into mobile development workflows and repositories
  • Partner with mobile product and infrastructure teams to identify recurring development bottlenecks and build reusable solutions
  • Operate the systems the team owns, participate in on-call support, and improve their reliability using measures of developer productivity, build and test performance, and release health

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, not including internships or co-ops
  • Experience building and maintaining mobile applications for iOS, Android, or a cross-platform mobile framework
  • Experience writing reliable, maintainable code and tests in a collaborative software engineering environment
  • Ability to diagnose problems across application code, development tools, and build or test systems
  • Ability to work with engineers across teams to understand their needs and deliver practical improvements
  • Interest in learning unfamiliar parts of the mobile development lifecycle, including development environments, continuous integration, testing, builds, releases, and production operations
  • Experience leading large, complex projects with multiple engineers across teams and organizations, explaining technical tradeoffs, building alignment with partners and leaders, and mentoring engineers in an environment where technologies and priorities change quickly
  • Experience mentoring engineers, and helping the team use AI to build and understand systems faster while keeping quality and reliability hig

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building developer infrastructure, developer tools, continuous integration systems, or automated testing frameworks
  • Experience with Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform, or mobile SDK development

description:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

As a senior platform DevOps engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. Using your DevOps platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process.

You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your DevOps skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

title: Program Manager 2
description:
Job Overview

The Program Manager 2 supports the planning, execution, and delivery of aerospace, defense, and advanced technology programs across the company's product portfolio. Working in support of Senior Program Managers and the Portfolio Director, this role manages defined programs, projects, workstreams, or portions of larger programs to achieve Cost, Schedule, and Performance (CSP) objectives. The Program Manager 2 serves as a key execution leader within the portfolio, coordinating activities across engineering, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, finance, contracts, quality, and test organizations to maintain executable program plans, track performance, identify and mitigate risks, resolve execution issues, and meet customer and contractual commitments. This role provides Senior Program Managers and the Portfolio Director with accurate and timely program information, analysis, and recommendations necessary to make informed business and execution decisions. The Program Manager 2 is expected to operate with increasing independence while appropriately escalating issues, risks, and decisions that require Senior Program Manager or Portfolio Director involvement.

Essential Functions

  • Manage Cost, Schedule, and Performance (CSP) for assigned programs, projects, workstreams, or portions of larger programs in support of Senior Program Managers and the Portfolio Director.
  • Support Senior Program Managers and the Portfolio Director in developing and executing program and portfolio strategies, priorities, milestones, customer commitments, and business objectives.
  • Provide timely, accurate, and objective program information to Senior Program Managers and the Portfolio Director, including program health, financial performance, schedule status, risks, opportunities, resource constraints, and recommended actions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, finance, contracts, and test organizations to ensure program activities remain aligned with established objectives.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), program action plans, milestone plans, and other execution tools for assigned scope.
  • Monitor program performance against established cost, schedule, technical, and contractual baselines and identify emerging variances, issues, and trends requiring corrective action or escalation.
  • Partner with Finance and Senior Program Managers to develop and maintain program budgets, Estimates to Complete (ETC), Estimates at Completion (EAC), spend plans, staffing forecasts, and financial performance reporting.
  • Analyze program financial performance, including actual costs, forecasts, variances, and potential impacts to program profitability, and develop recommended corrective actions.
  • Identify, document, assess, and manage program risks and opportunities for assigned scope, including development and tracking of mitigation and realization plans.
  • Coordinate engineering development, integration, manufacturing, test, qualification, delivery, and fielding activities to ensure program milestones and customer requirements are achieved.
  • Support development and maintenance of program execution plans, Integrated Master Plans (IMP), resource forecasts, risk registers, action-item trackers, and other program management artifacts.
  • Support and participate in program reviews, technical interchange meetings, milestone reviews, design reviews, customer meetings, Program Management Reviews (PMRs), and portfolio-level reviews.
  • Prepare and present program status, schedule performance, financial performance, risks, opportunities, actions, and recovery plans to Senior Program Managers, the Portfolio Director, customers, and other stakeholders.
  • Serve as a day-to-day customer interface for assigned areas of responsibility while maintaining alignment with the Senior Program Manager and Portfolio Director on overall program strategy, commitments, and communications.
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Support the interpretation and execution of Statements of Work (SOW), Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs), contractual requirements, deliverables, and other program documentation.
  • Monitor program scope and requirements and identify potential changes that may affect cost, schedule, technical performance, contractual commitments, or program profitability.
  • Coordinate with Contracts and Senior Program Managers to ensure potential scope changes are appropriately documented and addressed before execution.
  • Support subcontractor and supplier management activities, including development of requirements and Statements of Work, schedule coordination, performance monitoring, and resolution of programmatic issues.
  • Lead or coordinate assigned Integrated Product Team (IPT) activities, ensuring actions, dependencies, risks, and commitments are clearly identified and tracked to closure.
  • Drive disciplined action-item management and follow-through across assigned program activities.
  • Proactively identify issues requiring Senior Program Manager or Portfolio Director involvement and escalate them with a clear assessment of cost, schedule, technical, customer, or business impacts and recommended courses of action.
  • Support portfolio-level activities as requested by the Portfolio Director, including program performance reviews, resource planning, financial forecasting, strategic initiatives, and cross program execution priorities.
  • Support proposal development, Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimates, Basis of Estimates (BOEs), capture activities, customer requests, and new business opportunities associated with assigned programs and the broader portfolio.
  • Support transition of development efforts into production, fielding, sustainment, or follow-on customer-funded activities as applicable.
  • Ensure assigned programs and activities are executed in accordance with applicable safety, quality, contractual, regulatory, and company requirements.
  • Perform other duties as required.
  • Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].
  • Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices.
  • Embodies AEVEX’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

Qualifications and Competencies

  • Working knowledge of Cost, Schedule, and Performance (CSP) management principles within aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology environments.
  • Understanding of program financial management concepts including budgets, actual costs, forecasts, ETC, EAC, variance analysis, and program profitability.
  • Working knowledge of program risk and opportunity management, including identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and tracking.
  • Understanding of Statements of Work (SOW), contractual requirements, deliverables, scope management, and change control.
  • Ability to integrate activities across engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, contracts, quality, and test organizations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate cost, schedule, technical, customer, and operational impacts.
  • Ability to translate program data into clear assessments and actionable recommendations for Senior Program Managers and portfolio leadership.
  • Ability to identify emerging issues, develop recommended solutions, and appropriately escalate matters requiring Senior Program Manager or Portfolio Director decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with customers, suppliers, technical professionals, and leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and execute effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Detail-oriented and organized with a strong bias toward execution, accountability, and closure.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and program management/scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project.
  • Demonstrates a strong desire to grow as a program leader and take on increasing levels of Cost, Schedule, and Performance responsibility.

Leadership Competencies

  • Directs and provides expert knowledge in the day-to-day function of the department.
  • Identifies, recruits, and retains top-notch talent.
  • Champions AEVEX’s culture and empowers employees to take responsibility for their jobs and goals.
  • Coaches, mentors, engage and develop the team, including overseeing new employee onboarding and providing career development planning and learning opportunities.
  • Sets performance standards and encourages employee engagement and results through delegation, continuous feedback, goal setting, and performance management.
  • Maintains transparent communication. Appropriately communicates organization information through department meetings, one-on-one meetings, and appropriate email, and regular interpersonal communication.
  • Provides oversight and direction to the employees in accordance with AEVEX’s policies and procedures.
  • Leads through influence and collaboration across cross-functional program teams.
  • Establishes clear expectations, priorities, actions, and accountability for assigned program activities.
  • Demonstrates ownership and accountability for commitments within assigned scope.
  • Builds effective working relationships across functions and promotes teamwork in support of program and portfolio objectives.
  • Communicates program status, risks, issues, and decisions clearly and transparently.
  • Uses data and objective information to support decision-making and recommendations.
  • Proactively identifies barriers to execution and works across the organization to resolve or escalate them.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment regarding when to act independently and when to seek guidance or elevate decisions to Senior Program Managers or the Portfolio Director.
  • Seeks opportunities for continued development and increasing program leadership responsibility.

Education / Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Program Management, or related field; equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Program Management Professional (PMP), DAWIA certification, or equivalent program management training preferred.

Experience

  • 5+ years of relevant program management, project management, engineering, operations, manufacturing, or related aerospace/defense experience.
  • Experience supporting or managing aerospace, defense, autonomous systems, aviation, robotics, or advanced technology programs preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve cost, schedule, technical, and delivery objectives.
  • Experience developing and maintaining program schedules, forecasts, risks, action plans, and performance reporting.
  • Experience supporting program financial management, including budgets, ETC/EAC forecasting, spend plans, and variance analysis.
  • Experience working directly with customers, suppliers, subcontractors, engineering teams, and operations organizations.
  • Experience supporting development, production, integration, test, fielding, or sustainment programs preferred.
  • Experience supporting proposals, ROMs, BOEs, or new business activities preferred.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and managing Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) and using schedules to drive program execution.
  • Experience with ERP/MRP, collaboration, or program management systems such as Jira, Confluence, or similar tools preferred.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties the employee is:

Physical Requirements

Note: For the purpose of this summary, occasionally is used to represent up to 1/3 of the time given to the work day, frequently represents 1/3 to 2/3 of the time and constantly represents 2/3 or more of the time.

description:

With a career in application development, you’ll make the end user’s experience your priority and we’ll make your career growth ours.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Principal Systems Engineer you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter.

HOW A PRINCIPAL SYSTEMS ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Phone support with the customer

    • to resolve issues pertaining to future releases of IMIS

    • support issues that arise in the field for current releases of IMIS.

  • Run vulnerability assessments STIGS/SCAP

    • add additional security controls to reduce the attack surface of the Operating Systems and network equipment

  • Make adjustments to Operating Systems and other COTS software to help with configuration management and installation. Create tools to secure operating systems and applications used.

  • Make requested changes to COTS software to meet customer intended use.

  • Create packages and tools to install, remove, setup, check, etc. the packages provided to the customer.

  • Research latest CVEs for software and hardware we use for the customer.

  • Create network environments for testing.

  • Troubleshoot network issues with the systems and assist with field network issues.

  • Make configuration changes to templates provided to the customer based on business changes.

  • Provide procedures and support to the customer as needed when troubleshooting potential network issues.

  • Make recommendations to the customer to provide better security, performance, and redundancy.

  • Setup various routing protocols in our lab environment on physical and virtual switches, firewalls, and routers to test various scenarios.

  • Contributes to completion of major engineering programs and projects

  • Develops solutions to a variety of highly complex engineering problems

  • Perform highly complex systems design, development, and integration from the start of a systems life cycle to the end

  • Oversees highly complex infrastructure including installing, configuring, testing, and maintaining operating systems, application software, and system management tools

  • Performs highly complex systems modeling, simulation, and analysis

title: Engineering Director
description:
About Us


Motion Applied are the global leaders in electronics for top-tier Motorsport with more than 35 years of Formula 1 heritage and pedigree. We supply the world’s leading racing series with control and interface units, sensors, software and electrification technology designed and built in-house. We deliver high performance and reliability, backed by continuous product development and a relentless focus on innovation.


Building on our Motorsport core we operate across multiple industries. We take technology born from the demands of top-tier Motorsport, where performance, reliability and innovation are pushed to the limit, into new markets to deliver breakthrough outcomes for our customers. From developing next-generation products to supporting critical customer programmes, our teams play an important role pioneering a better future for mobility, electrification, analytics, intelligent systems and beyond.


We recognise sustainability challenges ahead and continuously strive to build a better future through the development and application of our products.


Driven by legacy and powered by innovation, we are committed to creating an environment where talented people can grow, collaborate and make a meaningful impact while helping our customers achieve success.


Role Purpose


The Engineering Director is responsible for leading the successful delivery of Motion Applied's engineering activities so that new products are developed on time and on budget, meeting customer specifications and expectations.


The Engineering team is also responsible for maintenance and support of existing products. The role provides strategic leadership across all aspects of engineering including product development, resource planning, customer engagement, and operational governance, ensuring that engineering capability is aligned to business objectives.


The position serves as the primary leadership interface between Engineering and other key functions including Product Management, Production and Commercial teams. The Engineering Director operates as a key member of the Senior Leadership Team, attending the weekly leadership meeting with the CEO and other Directors and will therefore have sight of the overall company management agenda. It is also an external-facing role, communicating with technical customers and strategic partners.


A successful Director must balance delivery of complex and sometimes urgent customer programmes with the long-term development of engineering capability and organisational effectiveness.


Key Accountabilities


This is a senior engineering leadership role responsible for leading the entire Engineering function, defining its organisational strategy, capability and resource plans, and ensuring the business has the people, processes and technology required for future growth.


The individual will oversee complex product development and customer programmes from concept through validation, production and lifecycle support, while owning engineering governance, portfolio prioritisation, budgets, quality and delivery performance.


They will act as a senior technical interface with OEMs, motorsport teams, governing bodies, suppliers and strategic customers, while working closely with Product, Production and Customer Support.


A key part of the role is also to build and develop high-performing engineering teams, strengthen succession and talent pipelines, improve engineering infrastructure and ways of working, and ultimately drive technical excellence, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction and sustainable business growth.



Leadership Scope


The role provides strategic leadership across:

  • Engineering Operations
  • Hardware Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Software and Systems Engineering
  • Product Development Governance
  • Resource and Capacity Planning
  • Customer Engineering Engagement
  • Engineering Quality and Operational Excellence


What we can offer you


In return for everything you bring to the table, we can ensure an exciting, challenging role in a dynamic business surrounded by some of the best people in their respective fields.


At Applied we firmly believe it’s the relationships and friendships we create while working that make us special. We’re also aware that the world is changing and we are part of that change. We all want and need different things from our work and home lives, so, if you have commitments outside of work, we’re open to talking through flexible working options that work for you and us.


  • Annual leave (25 days + bank holidays, pro-rated for part time colleagues).
  • Enhanced Company Maternity, Paternity and Adoption leave and pay.
  • Flexible working policies, including Hybrid Working.
  • Life assurance to the value of 4 times base salary
  • Opportunity to join the Applied Pension Plan
  • Company funded individual private healthcare with the opportunity to extend to partner or spouse and/or dependents at a discounted rate.
  • Electric car scheme – opportunity to drive a brand-new car in a more affordable way through this salary sacrifice scheme. Employees are eligible to join the scheme after successful competition of their probationary period.


Who we are


Motion Applied (formerly McLaren Applied) are a medium-sized tech firm spun out of McLaren Group. We’re looking for people who will thrive in a non-hierarchical, growth-orientated company, self-starters who are flexible and somewhat entrepreneurial in their approach.


Applied are committed to Diversity, Equality and Inclusion (DEI) and promote DEI in all we do. Motion Applied are also members of the UK Government Disability Confident Scheme

Apex Systems is currently hiring a Platform Network Engineer with a large federal client. This position will focus on designing, automating, securing, and maintaining the platform networking architecture that enables containerized workloads across distributed environments.

• Recommend improvements to security, scalability, reliability, performance, and manageability across Kubernetes network environments.

• Support the implementation and maintenance of enterprise networking, firewalling, and secure connectivity solutions.

• Assist in designing resilient network architectures supporting highly available Kubernetes-hosted applications.


Qualified candidates will have the following experience and skills:


• Senior-level network engineering experience with at least five years of experience implementing, supporting, and troubleshooting enterprise infrastructure environments.

• Strong experience supporting Kubernetes networking, containerized workloads, and cloud-native networking architectures.

• Experience with overlay and underlay networking technologies such as VXLAN, GENEVE, SD-WAN, and related networking concepts.

• Working knowledge of DoD STIGs, IAVM processes, RMF requirements, and/or industry-standard security hardening practices.
