If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role

We are seeking an Associate Salesforce Developer to support mission-critical Salesforce implementations for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). In this role, you will help lead the modernization and enhancement of enterprise systems that support call center operations, case management, and business process tracking across multiple VA departments.

Our teams deliver solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Omni-Channel routing, Agentforce, and Knowledge to enable efficient, scalable, and user-centered service delivery for Veterans and internal stakeholders.

You will work within an Agile project methodology and a DevSecOps environment alongside developers, administrators, architects, QA engineers, and product owners to design, build, and deliver secure and scalable solutions. This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders to translate mission needs into technical solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.

In addition, we are increasingly leveraging AI-driven capabilities within Salesforce. The ideal candidate will have experience or strong interest in configuring and applying Salesforce Agentforce and related AI tools to enable intelligent automation, improve case handling, and enhance user and agent experiences. You will contribute to identifying practical AI use cases and implementing them in alignment with enterprise standards and governance.


Responsibilities:

• Provide frontline support to Salesforce users, addressing inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and resolving user-reported problems.

• Assist in configuring Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, and other system components to meet business requirements.

• Assist in building and enhancing Salesforce solutions using Flows, Apex classes and triggers, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components, and Agentforce, following best practices and writing unit tests to meet code coverage requirements.

• Collaborate with other administrators and developers to implement customizations, integrations, and enhancements.

• Support data cleansing, deduplication, and migration activities to ensure data accuracy and integrity within Salesforce.

• Assist in creating and maintaining data reports, dashboards, and views to support business analytics and decision-making.

• Perform routine system maintenance tasks, including user provisioning, profile management, and permission set assignments.

• Monitor system performance, security, and compliance, addressing any issues or concerns as they arise.

• Document Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to maintain an up-to-date knowledge base.

• Stay informed about Salesforce updates, new features, and best practices, sharing insights with the team to drive continuous improvement.

title: Enterprise Cloud Security Architect
description:
Enterprise Cloud Security Architect

The Opportunity:

The Enterprise Cloud Security Architect provides architecture leadership across Booz Allen’s Enterprise. This role requires deep technical expertise across AWS, Azure, and GCP cloud platforms, shaping how engineering teams design and implement secure by design cloud and hybrid solutions. The architect develops and maintains enterprise security standards, cloud governance models, and multicloud reference architectures, ensuring alignment with Booz Allen’s global security strategy and multicloud vision. The position plays a critical role in advancing scalable, secure, and compliant cloud environments that support enterprise business objectives. We need you to help us develop cloud-based security architectures for some of the Intelligence Community (IC)’s most critical systems.

The Enterprise Cloud Security Architect will serve as a multicloud architecture SME across AWS, Azure, and GCP, providing design level leadership and guidance to engineering teams. Lead the interpretation and adoption of multicloud governance models, including AWS Control Tower, Azure Landing Zones, and GCP Organization Structures, to support secure and automated enterprise environments. Translate security strategies into cloud agnostic architectural patterns, standards, and reference architectures implemented across engineering teams. Contribute to shaping Booz Allen’s enterprise cloud and cybersecurity capabilities by developing converged multicloud architectural approaches aligned with innovation, governance, risk management, and modernization goals.


Lead architectural and design reviews to ensure alignment with reference architectures, enterprise security controls, and compliance frameworks. Communicate architectural direction across teams and stakeholders to support consistency, clarity, and secure-by-design decision making. Maintain deep understanding of cloud security, automation, networking, and identity to effectively evaluate and influence engineering solutions and technical implementations.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise security architecture, cloud architecture, or cybersecurity engineering roles, utilizing cloud-native functionality as well as COTs, GOTS, and open-source tools to meet objectives
  • Experience integrating cybersecurity tools and capabilities in an enterprise environment, modernizing cybersecurity capabilities by pushing functionality closer to the edge, closer to the workload, and operating in a distributed manner
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure code concepts such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep to provide architectural guidance
  • Knowledge of multicloud networking models, including segmentation, routing, and hybrid connectivity
  • Knowledge of Cloud security controls, compliance frameworks, and security telemetry ecosystems
  • Knowledge of modern cybersecurity frameworks, including Zero Trust principles and secure by design methodologies
  • Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
  • Associate’s degree and 10+ years of experience supporting IT projects and activities, Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience supporting IT projects and activities, or Master’s degree and 6+ years of experience supporting IT projects and activities
  • A DoD 8570 IAT Level III certification, as well as an IASAE Level II certification (Security X or CISSP fulfills both)
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 Cybersecurity Service Provider - Infrastructure Support Certification (CSSP-IS), including CEH, CySA+, GICSP, SSCP, CHFI, CFR, Cloud+, or CND Certification, within 30 days of start date

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience producing enterprise architecture artifacts such as reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and decision records
  • Experience with cloud modernization and multicloud strategy drivers such as innovation, portability, governance consolidation, and vendor variation
  • Knowledge of cloud native security, identity, and platform capabilities across cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP
  • Knowledge of multicloud governance and automation, such as AWS Control Tower, Azure Landing Zones, or GCP Org Policies
  • Ability to evaluate, guide, and improve architectural designs created by engineering and delivery teams and create and maintain realistic roadmaps of solution development and improvement activities

description:

  • Deploying supporting the E2E management of our data, including: ETL/ELT, DW/DL, data staging, data governance, and managing the different layers of data required to ensure a successful BI & Reporting for the PEC.

  • Lead technical initiatives and provide guidance on solution design, development standards, and code reviews.

  • Participate in data platform architecture decisions, including storage optimization, compute strategies, security, and performance tuning.
  • Other Procurement duties as assigned.
What are we looking for?
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field (Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or similar) 5+ years of relevant professional experience in BI Engineering, data modeling, data engineering, software engineering or other relevant roles.
  • Strong SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases.
  • Knowledge in DW/DL concepts, data marts, data modeling, ETL/ELT, data quality/stewardship, distributed systems and metadata management.
  • Experience building and optimizing data pipelines, architectures, and data sets.

  • Ability to resolve ETL/ELT problems by proposing and implementing tactical/Strategic solutions.
  • Strong project management and Organizational skills.
  • Experience with object-oriented function scripting languages: Python, Scala, R, etc.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone seeking greater responsibility and influence within a dynamic consultancy, with a clear opportunity to help build and develop an expanding environmental practice.


The successful candidate will have the opportunity to play a central role in shaping and growing the environmental division of the business, including developing new services, mentoring staff and contributing to the strategic direction of the company.


At Boylan Consulting, we offer:

1) Opportunity to play a leading role in the growth of an expanding environmental consultancy.

3) Opportunity to develop and mentor a growing environmental team.

4) Diverse project portfolio across planning, waste, environmental compliance and sustainability.

5) Direct access to senior decision-makers with the ability to influence company strategy.

6) Ongoing support for professional development and chartership.

7) Competitive salary and benefits package.

8) Flexible working arrangements.

• Strong working knowledge of Irish environmental and planning legislation.

• Demonstrated ability to manage projects independently from inception to completion.

• Experience preparing complex technical reports and regulatory submissions.

• Strong commercial awareness and client management skills.

• Excellent report writing and communication skills.

• Ability to mentor junior staff and contribute to team development.

• Proven ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

description:
The Client Service team acts as a guardian of the client experience within Asset Management. You will support the full client lifecycle, from requests for proposal (RFPs) and onboarding through to client reporting, relationship management and day-to-day servicing. The team supports institutional and selected wholesale clients with segregated mandates or investments in funds across all asset classes, including Alternatives and Global Liquidity. Above all, we believe in doing 'first-class business in a first-class way'. You should share our passion for exceptional client service and conducting business ethically, with strong controls and full compliance.

As a Client Account Manager (CAM) in the Client Service team, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional service to institutional and wholesale clients of J.P. Morgan Asset Management in Australia and New Zealand, with the potential to support clients across the broader Asia-Pacific region. As a key point of contact for clients’ day-to-day servicing needs, you will develop a deep understanding of their requirements across asset classes and champion those requirements within the firm.

You will partner with Client Advisors (Sales) and Investment and Product Specialists to form an integrated service team for each assigned client. You will demonstrate strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills, together with an organised approach and a sound risk and controls mindset. The role reports to a Client Account Manager based in Sydney.

Job responsibilities

  • Act as the day-to-day client service contact for an assigned group of clients on non-investment-related matters, proactively managing and developing those relationships.
  • Respond to requests from clients, auditors, consultants and other third parties, balancing client needs with a strong risk and controls mindset to protect the firm.
  • Ensure that client-impacting issues and relevant regulatory or business changes are communicated clearly to clients and appropriately escalated and documented for internal stakeholders.
  • Perform all required client service activities throughout the client lifecycle in accordance with internal policies, procedures and controls.
  • Partner with RFP and Client Advisor teams to provide information and responses to prospective-client questions, and participate in pitches when required.
  • Contribute to onboarding, including the negotiation of mutually acceptable Investment Management Agreements, account setup and communication with clients and other third parties.
  • Coordinate Know Your Customer (KYC) activities in partnership with Client Advisors and Anti-Money Laundering/KYC teams.
  • Respond to day-to-day client queries and deliver the agreed service offering, including coordinating client cash flows, following up on outstanding invoices and maintaining accurate client records.
  • Attend client meetings and events as appropriate, including pitches and due diligence meetings, and lead client service reviews.
  • Partner with global Client Service teams to support clients whose portfolios are managed across regions, primarily the United Kingdom, Hong Kong and the U.S.
  • Actively participate in and contribute to client-impacting business, technology and regulatory projects and initiatives, as well as Client Service and regional team meetings.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication, negotiation and influencing skills.

title: Experience & Interface Designer (HDB)
description:
About Us
Established in 2010, Vinova is a passion-driven and award-winning development company for mobile, web, and enterprise applications. Our clients span the globe and cover a wide range of projects including IoT, blockchain, banking, fintech, networking, and ecommerce. Vinova earns respect from customers by being committed to quality, flexibility, and speed. We strive to build great products by working with passion, working closely with our customers, and through open but disciplined collaboration. You will be working in an encouraging and challenging environment, taking advantage of the latest technology to deliver high-impact digital solutions for global clients. You will be engaging clients in both on-site and off-site capacities.

What you will be working on
Our client, a Singapore public sector agency, is building digital products and services that improve the lives of Singaporeans. The team believes great products start with a deep understanding of people, and is committed to building experiences that are intuitive, accessible and useful.

As an Experience & Interface Designer, you will own design for a product within a cross-functional team, from discovery through to delivery. You will work through complex problems and unclear requirements, and design services that residents and staff find easy to use. This role suits a designer who wants real ownership of the work and who leads by example.

Key responsibilities

Discovery & research

  • Plan and lead discovery for your product, with support from the UX Research team — including user interviews, contextual inquiry, synthesis, journey mapping and service blueprinting — so the team understands what users need and where the real opportunities lie.
  • Bring user insight into current and future processes so service and product decisions start from evidence.

End-to-end design

  • Own the design of your product from problem framing through interaction design, prototyping, usability testing and iteration after launch.
  • Design for complex enterprise and public-facing systems, refining your work through testing and feedback until the experience works for users.
  • Define success measures with your team, such as task completion, drop-off and support contacts, and use them to guide iteration.

Delivery with your team

  • Work closely with Product Owners, Technical Product Managers, Business Owners and Software Engineers to scope design work, estimate effort and keep design ahead of build.
  • Make sure design intent carries through to the shipped product, and that work meets agreed readiness and completion criteria.

Standards & quality

  • Apply the agency's Design Systems and meet the Whole-of-Government Digital Service Standards (DSS), including WCAG accessibility requirements.
  • Flag gaps in the systems and contribute patterns back to the central team.

Facilitation & influence

  • Plan and run workshops, design sprints and co-creation sessions that align stakeholders on problems and direction.
  • Present design decisions with clear rationale in terms of user outcomes, risk, effort and trade-offs.

AI in your design practice

  • Use AI tools in your daily work, such as research synthesis, content drafting, exploration and prototyping, and share what works with the team.

Raising the bar

  • Mentor other designers through critique, pairing and knowledge sharing, and help build a design community where people learn from each other.

What we are looking for

Education & experience

  • A degree in design, HCI or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in product design, UX design, interaction design or a related discipline.
  • Mandatory: proven end-to-end ownership — you have led design on a product from discovery and research through to delivery and iteration.
  • A portfolio showing shipped work, the process behind it and the outcomes it achieved. Anonymised case studies are acceptable.

Design craft

  • Strong interaction and visual design craft in Figma, with high-fidelity work that is technically feasible.
  • Strong grasp of design systems, accessibility and inclusive design, including WCAG.

Research & service design

  • Hands-on research and service design skills: planning studies, interviewing users, mapping journeys and service blueprints, and running usability tests.

AI tools

  • Competence in using AI tools in day-to-day design work, such as research synthesis, content drafting, exploration and prototyping.

Facilitation & stakeholders

  • Strong presentation, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including running workshops, design sprints or co-creation sessions with cross-functional teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing complex, multi-stakeholder products in government, enterprise or regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with the Digital Service Standards (DSS).
  • Built working prototypes with AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or Figma Make.
  • Designed AI-powered experiences, such as assistants or summarisation features, with an understanding of their trust and error-handling challenges.
  • Experience working in agile product teams and scrum ceremonies.
  • Mentored designers or helped a team improve its design practice.
  • Balances user needs, business objectives and technical constraints, and makes trade-offs with evidence.
  • Cares about the public good and will speak up for users when a decision works against them.
  • Collaborative, humble and generous with knowledge.

Personal attributes

  • Skill development through client projects using new technologies, plus workshops and seminars.
  • A clear path to leadership roles in a growing company.
  • Complimentary snacks and drinks in the office.

title: Fire Sprinkler Apprentice
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Performs basic fire sprinkler installation and service tasks under the supervision of a foreman or qualified technician while progressing through structured on-the-job training. Applies approved drawings and installation methods, safely operates authorized equipment, and develops the technical skills required to advance toward sprinkler fitter responsibilities.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES

· Report to work on time with required clothing and PPE; participate in daily pre-task planning, toolbox talks, training, and jobsite safety meetings.

· Follow foreman instructions and learn to interpret basic plan symbols, dimensions, elevations, details, manufacturer requirements, and approved installation procedures; never deviate from approved documents without direction.

· Measure, cut, thread, groove, join, hang, and install steel, CPVC, and other approved piping, fittings, valves, supports, sprinkler components, and system accessories under appropriate supervision.

· Learn the basic arrangement and operation of wet, dry, preaction, deluge, standpipe, and fire pump systems as applicable to assigned projects.

· Load, unload, stage, count, distribute, and protect pipe, fittings, equipment, and tools; keep materials organized and promptly report shortages, damage, or incorrect deliveries.

· Safely operate authorized hand tools, drills, saws, ladders, lifts, threading/grooving machines, and material-handling equipment after documented instruction; inspect equipment before use and report defects.

· Install hangers and supports, prepare penetrations, clean and assemble pipe, and assist qualified personnel with flushing, hydrostatic/air testing, alarm checks, inspections, punch lists, service calls, and repairs.

· Maintain clean and orderly work areas; protect finished surfaces and customer property; properly store tools and remove debris and scrap at the end of each shift.

· Accurately complete time records, training documentation, daily reports, photos, material counts, and other paperwork assigned by the foreman or project team.

· Follow OSHA, company, and site-specific requirements, including fall protection, lift safety, hot work, lockout/tagout, and PPE rules; immediately report hazards, injuries, near misses, damaged tools, or unsafe conditions.

· Complete assigned training and demonstrate measurable progression in safety, tools, materials, plan reading, installation quality, productivity, and system knowledge; support coworkers professionally and work alternate shifts, weekends, emergency calls, or regional jobs when required.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

· High school diploma or GED; genuine interest in building a career in fire protection. Prior experience as a sprinkler helper or in construction, mechanical work, plumbing, or pipefitting is preferred; equivalent demonstrated aptitude may be accepted.

· Mechanically inclined and able to learn measurements, basic construction math, tool operation, plan symbols, piping methods, and fire sprinkler system fundamentals.

· Dependable, safety-minded, and able to follow verbal and written directions, complete assigned work, communicate respectfully, and work effectively as part of a crew.

· Basic computer/mobile-device skills; valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record, reliable transportation, and required insurance. Must be authorized to work in the United States and complete job-related screening requirements.


PHYSICAL & WORK REQUIREMENTS

· Regularly lift/carry up to 75 lb.; climb ladders/scaffolds; work from lifts and in overhead, confined, elevated, hot, cold, wet, dusty, or otherwise difficult positions; stand, bend, kneel, reach, and perform repetitive physical work for extended periods.

· Wear required PPE and work safely around active construction, operating facilities, noise, moving equipment, and varying weather. Reasonable accommodations may be provided for qualified individuals with disabilities.


COMPENSATION

$18-$25 per hour


BENEFITS

Competitive pay | PTO | Paid holidays | 401(k) | Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable law.
